text: Conscientiousness is a fundamental personality trait. A conscientious person is good at self- regulation and impulse control. This trait inﬂuences whether you will set and keep long- range goals, deliberate over choices, behave cautiously or impulsively, and take obligations to others seriously.
translations: Conscientiousness is a fundamental personality trait.责任心是一种基本的人格特征。
A conscientious person is good at self-regulation and impulse control.一个有责任心的人善于自我调节和冲动控制。
This trait influences whether you will set and keep long- range goals , deliberate over choices , behave cautiously or impulsively, and take obligations to others seriously.
这种特质会影响你是否会设定和保持长期目标、深思熟虑选择、谨慎或冲动行事 ， 以及认真对待对他人的义务。

text: There is every reason to believe that eﬀective regulations are not merely a luxury that only the rich can aﬀord, but an important foundation for a thriving private sector and economic growth. But the broad pattern of the past ﬁve years has been that the main reform eﬀorts are taking place in rich countries.
translations: There is every reason to believe that effective regulations are not merely a luxury that only the rich can afford , but an important foundation for a thriving private sector and economic growth.
我们有充分的理由相信 ，有效的监管不仅是只有富人才能负担得起的奢侈品 ，而且是私营部门蓬勃发展和经济增长的重要基础。
But the broad pattern of the past five years has been that the main reform efforts are taking place in rich countries .
但过去五年的总体格局是 ，主要的改革努力都发生在富裕国家。

title_zh: 加拿大的荒野面临危险
text: With a population of only just over 30 million living in the world 's second largest country, Canada is justly renowned for vast tracts of wilderness untroubled by pollution either from industry or from intensive farming methods. A major conservation issue is the battle to stop the logging of virgin forest in northern Ontario and on the west coast.
translations: With a population of only just over 30 million living in the world 's second largest country, Canada is justly
renowned for vast tracts of wilderness untroubled by pollution either from industry or from intensive farming methods .
加拿大是世界第二大国家 ，人口仅略高于3000万 ， 以大片荒野而闻名 ，没有受到工业或集约化农业方法污染的影响。
A major conservation issue is the battle to stop the logging of virgin forest in northern Ontario and on the west coast.
一个主要的保护问题是停止砍伐安大略省北部和西海岸的原始森林。

title_en: The Multifaceted Nature of Voice and Text
text: The terms 'voice ' and 'text ' are multifaceted. Both have a wide range of possible meanings in everyday speech and academic usage. You may encounter the two words used in a variety of ways, in connexion with diﬀerent subjects, and they won 't always mean exactly the same thing.
translations: The terms 'voice ' and 'text ' are multifaceted. “声音 ”和“文本 ”这两个术语是多方面的。
Both have a wide range of possible meanings in everyday speech and academic usage .这两个词在日常用语和学术用法中都有广泛的可能含义。
You may encounter the two words used in a variety of ways , in connexion with different subjects , and they won 't always mean exactly the same thing.
您可能会遇到这两个词在不同的主题中以各种方怯使用 ，但它们的含义并不总是完全相同。

text: Founded in 1921 by A. S. Neill, the Summerhill School is known for its unique approach to education. At Summerhill, students have the freedom to choose their own activities and are encouraged to participate in the decision-making process. This student-centred approach promotes self-expression, creativity, and personal development.
translations: Founded in 1921 by A. S. Neill由A.于1921年创立S. Neill
,the Summerhill School is known for its unique approach to education .夏山学校以其独特的教育方法而闻名。
At Summerhill , students have the freedom to choose their own activities and are encouraged to participate in the decision-making process .
在Summerhill ，学生可以自由选择自己的活动 ，并鼓励他们参与决策过程。
This student-centred approach promotes self-expression , creativity, and personal development.这种以学生为中心的方法促进自我表达 ，创造力和个人发展。

text: Schools host parent teacher conferences four times a year and it is important for families to attend. This is your chance to meet with teachers and ask questions about your child 's progress. It can be helpful to write down questions ahead of time.
translations: Schools host parent teacher conferences four times a year and it is important for families to attend.学校每年举办四次家长教师会议 ，家庭参加非常重要。
This is your chance to meet with teachers and ask questions about your child 's progress .这是您与老师见面并询问有关孩子进步的问题的机会。
It can be helpful to write down questions ahead of time .提前写下问题可能会很有帮助。

text: Like coﬀee, plain tea contains just a couple of calories per cup and no sugar. But what 's added in it can change that situation. A medium sweet tea and a large iced latte from fast food restaurants both pack about seven teaspoons of sugar. However, the American Heart Association recommends no more than six teaspoons for the whole day.
translations: Like coffee , plain tea contains just a couple of calories per cup and no sugar.与咖啡一样 ，普通茶每杯仅含几卡路里 ，并且不含糖。
But what 's added in it can change that situation .但其中添加的内容可以改变这种情况。
A medium sweet tea and a large iced latte from fast food restaurants both pack about seven teaspoons of sugar.
一杯中号甜茶和一杯快餐店的大杯冰拿铁都含有大约七茶匙糖。
However, the American Heart Association recommends no more than six teaspoons for the whole day.然而 ，美国心脏协会建议全天不超过六茶匙。

text: The most signiﬁcant diﬀerence between an eating disorder and disordered eating is whether or not a person 's symptoms and experiences align with the criteria deﬁned by the American Psychiatric Association. The term "disordered eating "is a descriptive phrase, not a diagnosis.
translations: The most significant difference between an eating disorder and disordered eating is whether or not a person 's symptoms and experiences align with the criteria defined by the American Psychiatric Association .
饮食失调和饮食失调之间最显着的区别是一个人的症状和经历是否符合美国精神病学协会定义的标准。
The term "disordered eating " is a descriptive phrase , not a diagnosis . “饮食失调 ”一词是一个描述性短语 ，而不是诊断。

text: Association between meatless diet and depression: participants who excluded meat from their diet were found to have a higher prevalence of depressive episodes as compared to participants who consumed meat. This association is independent of socioeconomic, lifestyle factors, and nutrient deﬁciencies.
translations: Association between meatless diet and depression: participants who excluded meat from their diet were found to have a higher prevalence of depressive episodes as compared to participants who consumed meat.
无肉饮食与抑郁症之间的关联： 发现与吃肉的参与者相比 ，饮食中排除肉类的参与者抑郁症发作的患病率更高。
This association is independent of socioeconomic , lifestyle factors , and nutrient deficiencies .这种关联与社会经济、生活方怯因素和营养缺乏无关。

text: Television is bound to have a tremendous impact on a child. When a parent is concerned about the eﬀects of television, he should consider several things: what TV oﬀers the child in terms of information and knowledge, how many hours a week a youngster his age should watch television, the impact of violence and sex, and the inﬂuence of commercials.
translations: Television is bound to have a tremendous impact on a child.电视一定会对孩子产生巨大的影响。

When a parent is concerned about the effects of television , he should consider several things: what TV offers the child in terms of information and knowledge , how many hours a week a youngster his age should watch television , the impact of violence and sex , and the influence of commercials .
当父母担心电视的影响时 ，他应该考虑几件事： 电视在信息和知识方面给孩子提供了什么 ，他这个年龄的孩子每周应该看多少小时电视 ，暴力和性的影响 ， 以及商业广告的影响。

text: There are three main interpretations of the English Revolution. The longest lasting interpretation was that the Revolution was an almost inevitable outcome of an age old power struggle between parliament and crown. The second sees it as a class struggle, and a lead up to the French and other revolutions. Finally, the third interpretation sees the other two as too ﬁxed, not allowing for unpredictability, and that the outcome could have gone either way.
translations: There are three main interpretations of the English Revolution .对英国革命的主要解释有三种。
The longest lasting interpretation was that the Revolution was an almost inevitable outcome of an age old power struggle between parliament and crown .
最持久的解释是 ，革命几乎是议会和王室之间古老权力斗争的不可避免的结果。
The second sees it as a class struggle , and a lead up to the French and other revolutions .第二种观点认为这是一场阶级斗争 ，是法国革命和其他革命的导火线。
Finally, the third interpretation sees the other two as too fixed , not allowing for unpredictability, and that the outcome could have gone either way.
最后 ，第三种解释认为另外两种过于固定 ，不考虑不可预测性 ，而且结果可能会发生任何一种情况。

text: Even though our computers are now better than 15 years ago, they still malfunction between 11 and 20 per cent of the time, a new study concludes. The researchers behind the study therefore ﬁnd that there are major gains to be achieved for society by rethinking the systems and involving users more in their development.
translations: Even though our computers are now better than 15 years ago , they still malfunction between 11 and 20 per cent of the time , a new study concludes .
一项新的研究得出结论 ，尽管我们的计算机现在比15年前更好 ，但它们仍然有11%到20%的时间出现故障。
The researchers behind the study therefore find that there are major gains to be achieved for society by rethinking the systems and involving users more in their development.
因此 ，这项研究背后的研究人员发现 ，通过重新思考系统并让用户更多地参与其开发 ，可以为社会带来重大收益。

text: One of the complex agricultural problems is the issue of food waste. Food waste refers to the discarding of edible food at various stages of the food supply chain, from production to consumption. This not only represents a signiﬁcant loss of resources but also has environmental implications, such as greenhouse gas emissions from decomposing food waste in landﬁlls.
translations: One of the complex agricultural problems is the issue of food waste .其中一个复杂的农业问题是粮食浪费问题。
Food waste refers to the discarding of edible food at various stages of the food supply chain , from production to consumption .
食物浪费是指从生产到消费的食品供应链各个阶段对可食用食品的丢弃。
This not only represents a significant loss of resources but also has environmental implications , such as greenhouse gas emissions from decomposing food waste in landfills .
这不仅意味着资源的重大损失 ，还会对环境产生影响 ，例如垃圾填埋场分解食品垃圾会排放温室气体。

text: More and more people are choosing to live in cities. They oﬀer better opportunities, better services, and sanctuary from conﬂict and the eﬀects of climate change inﬂuences. Yet large numbers of people are unable for various reasons to move to cities-skills is matches, reluctance to sell land at a loss, and sometimes because of explicit policy restrictions that limit people 's movement within countries.
translations: More and more people are choosing to live in cities .越来越多的人选择住在城市。
They offer better opportunities , better services , and sanctuary from conflict and the effects of climate change influences .
它们提供更好的机会、更好的服务以及免受冲突和气候变化影响的庇护所。

Yet large numbers of people are unable for various reasons to move to cities-skills is matches , reluctance to sell land at a loss , and sometimes because of explicit policy restrictions that limit people 's movement within
countries .
然而 ，大量人由于各种原因无法搬到城市--技能匹配、不愿亏本出售土地 ，有时还因为限制人们在国内流动的明确政策限制。

text: When a male African savanna elephant folds his ears while simultaneously waving them, he 's ready for a ﬁght. When a female folds her ears and accompanies the action with an ear ﬂap, that means she 's also issuing a serious threat. But when elephants come together and fold their ears, the animals are expressing a warm greeting.
translations: When a male African savanna elephant folds his ears while simultaneously waving them , he 's ready for a fight.当一只雄性非洲草原象捂住耳朵同时挥舞耳朵时 ， 它就准备好战斗了。
When a female folds her ears and accompanies the action with an ear flap , that means she 's also issuing a serious threat.
当雌性捂住耳朵并用耳垂伴随这一动作时 ，这意味着她也发出了严重的威胁。
But when elephants come together and fold their ears , the animals are expressing a warm greeting.但当大象聚集在一起并捂住耳朵时 ，动物们正在表达热情的问候。

text: The study of history allows us to learn from past mistakes and successes, providing valuable insights into human behaviour and societal trends. History provides us with a record of human experiences that can inform our decisions and actions in the present and future. By studying history, we can gain a deeper understanding of cultural diversity, social change, and political systems.
translations: The study of history allows us to learn from past mistakes and successes , providing valuable insights into human behaviour and societal trends .
历史研究使我们能够从过去的错误和成功中吸取教训 ，为人类行为和社会趋势提供宝贵的见解。
History provides us with a record of human experiences that can inform our decisions and actions in the present and future .
历史为我们提供了人类经历的记录 ，可以为我们现在和未来的决策和行动提供信息。
By studying history, we can gain a deeper understanding of cultural diversity, social change , and political systems .
通过研究历史 ，我们可以更深入地了解文化多样性、社会变革和政治制度。

text: Cats are popular pets around the world. They are known for their playful nature, soft fur, and independent personalities. Many people enjoy having cats as companions, as they can provide comfort and entertainment. However, it is important to take care of cats properly by providing them with food, water, and regular veterinary check-ups.
translations: Cats are popular pets around the world.猫是世界各地受欢迎的宠物。
They are known for their playful nature , soft fur, and independent personalities .它们以顽皮的天性、柔软的皮毛和独立的个性而闻名。
Many people enjoy having cats as companions , as they can provide comfort and entertainment.许多人喜欢有猫作为伴侣 ， 因为它们可以提供舒适和娱乐。
However, it is important to take care of cats properly by providing them with food , water, and regular veterinary check-ups .
然而 ，通过为猫提供食物、水和定期兽医检查来妥善照顾它们很重要。

text: Charitable giving has the power to transform lives and communities, providing support for those in need and promoting social justice. Donating time, money, or resources to charitable organisations can make a signiﬁcant diﬀerence in the lives of others, while also promoting a sense of purpose and fulﬁlment.
translations: Charitable giving has the power to transform lives and communities , providing support for those in need and promoting social justice .
慈善捐赠有能力改变生活和社区 ，为有需要的人提供支持并促进社会正义。
Donating time , money, or resources to charitable organisations can make a significant difference in the lives of others , while also promoting a sense of purpose and fulfilment.
向慈善组织捐赠时间、金钱或资源可以显著改变他人的生活 ， 同时也能促进目标感和成就感。

text: Plants play a crucial role in ecosystems, serving as a foundation and contributing to human well-being by providing resources such as food and medicine. In order to gain a deeper understanding of how plants can adapt and remain resilient in the face of challenges like climate change, scientists have developed an innovative mathematical model.
translations: Plants play a crucial role in ecosystems , serving as a foundation and contributing to human well-being by providing resources such as food and medicine .
植物在生态系统中发挥着至关重要的作用 ，作为基础 ，通过提供食物和药品等资源为人类福祉做出贡献。
In order to gain a deeper understanding of how plants can adapt and remain resilient in the face of challenges like climate change , scientists have developed an innovative mathematical model.
为了更深入地了解植物如何适应和保持弹性 ，面对气候变化等挑战 ，科学家开发了一种创新的数学模型。

text: Parents attend school conference for their children. Your child has the opportunity to meet with parents 4 times a year to understand the child 's progress and prepare questions in advance.
translations: Parents attend school conference for their children .家长为孩子参加学校会议。
Your child has the opportunity to meet with parents 4 times a year to understand the child 's progress and prepare questions in advance .
您的孩子每年有机会与家长见面4次 ， 了解孩子的进步并提前准备问题。

text: Located at the heart of two world famous cities, Liverpool and London, Liverpool 's excellence in teaching, learning and research, ﬁrst-class facilities and outstanding support places the university in the top 1 percent of universities worldwide. The University of Liverpool will provide you with an inspiring student experience, in a diverse international community.
translations: Located at the heart of two world famous cities , Liverpool and London , Liverpool 's excellence in teaching ,
learning and research , first-class facilities and outstanding support places the university in the top 1 percent of universities worldwide .
利物浦大学位于利物浦和伦敦这两个世界著名城市的中心 ，卓越的教学、学习和研究、一流的设施和出色的支持使其跻身全球大学前1%。
The University of Liverpool will provide you with an inspiring student experience , in a diverse international community.
利物浦大学将在多元化的国际社区为您提供鼓舞人心的学生体验。

text: Around the world, city residents build gardens on balconies, rooftops and small strips of land. A March 2023 study published in the journal Ecology Letters conﬁrms that beyond oﬀering food and an outlet for cultivating outdoor space, urban gardens provide beneﬁts for the humans, insects, and animals who inhabit these leafy respites from city life.
translations: Around the world , city residents build gardens on balconies , rooftops and small strips of land.在世界各地 ，城市居民在阳台、屋顶和小块土地上建造花园。

A March 2023 study published in the journal Ecology Letters confirms that beyond offering food and an outlet for cultivating outdoor space , urban gardens provide benefits for the humans , insects , and animals who inhabit these leafy respites from city life .
2023年3月发表在《生态快报》 杂志上的一项研究证实 ， 除了提供食物和培育户外空间的出口之外 ，城市花园还为居住在城市生活这些绿叶休息区的人类、 昆虫和动物提供了好处。

text: A crew of scientists voyaged by ship from the southern tip of Chile into the frigid Antarctic to search for clues to one of the great unknowns of climate change. They planned to crisscross a remote patch of sea near the spot where, a year earlier, another crew had injected a tankful of an inert chemical one mile below the surface.
translations: A crew of scientists voyaged by ship from the southern tip of Chile into the frigid Antarctic to search for clues to one of the great unknowns of climate change .
一队科学家乘船从智利南端进入寒冷的南极洲 ， 寻找气候变化最大未知数之一的线索。
They planned to crisscross a remote patch of sea near the spot where , a year earlier, another crew had injected a tankful of an inert chemical one mile below the surface .
他们计划穿越该地点附近的一片偏远海域 ，一年前 ，另一名船员在水面下一英里处注射了一桶惰性化学物质。

text: The second group that is particularly vulnerable are night shift workers, and the third group that is particularly vulnerable are people with sleep disorders, particularly sleep apnea. One out of three men and one out of six women have sleep apnea. And yet, eighty-ﬁve percent are undiagnosed and untreated. And it more than doubles the risk of crashes.
translations: The second group that is particularly vulnerable are night shift workers , and the third group that is particularly vulnerable are people with sleep disorders , particularly sleep apnea .
第二个特别脆弱的群体是夜班工人 ，第三个特别脆弱的群体是睡眠障碍患者 ，特别是睡眠呼吸暂停综合症患者。
One out of three men and one out of six women have sleep apnea .三分之一的男性和六分之一的女性患有睡眠呼吸暂停综合症。
And yet , eighty-five percent are undiagnosed and untreated.然而 ，85%的人未经诊断和治疗。
And it more than doubles the risk of crashes .而且事故风险增加了一倍多。

text: There are perhaps three ways of looking at furniture: some people see it as purely functional and useful, and don 't bother themselves with aesthetics; others see it as essential to civilised living and concern themselves with design and how the furniture will look in a room. In other words, function combined with aesthetics; and yet others see furniture as a form of art.
translations: There are perhaps three ways of looking at furniture: some people see it as purely functional and useful , and don 't bother themselves with aesthetics;
看待家具的方怯或许有三种： 有些人认为它是纯粹的功能性和实用性 ，而不考虑美观；
others see it as essential to civilised living and concern themselves with design and how the furniture will look in a room .
其他人则认为它对于文明生活至关重要 ，并关注设计以及家具在房间中的外观。
In other words , function combined with aesthetics;换句话说 ，功能与美观相结合；
and yet others see furniture as a form of art.还有一些人将家具视为一种艺术形怯。

text: Vitamin D deﬁciency linked to premature death. Over a 14-year follow-up period, researchers found that the risk for death signiﬁcantly decreased with increased vitamin D concentrations, with the strongest eﬀects seen among those with severe deﬁciencies.
translations: Vitamin D deficiency linked to premature death.维生素 D 缺乏与过早死亡有关。
Over a 14-year follow-up period , researchers found that the risk for death significantly decreased with
increased vitamin D concentrations , with the strongest effects seen among those with severe deficiencies .
经过 14 年的跟踪研究 ，研究人员发现 ， 随着维生素 D 浓度的增加 ，死亡风险显着降低 ，对于严重缺乏维生素 D 的人来说 ，这种影响最为明显。

text: The successor to the Hubble Space Telescope has been delayed yet again and will not now launch until "approximately May 2020 ". The James Webb Space Telescope is also in danger of busting the cost cap put on the project by the US Congress. Back in 2011, politicians on Capitol Hill said the observatory should not take more than 8 billion dollars to build and 800 million dollars to operate over ﬁve years in orbit.
translations: The successor to the Hubble Space Telescope has been delayed yet again and will not now launch until "approximately May 2020 " .
哈勃太空望远镜的后继者再次被推迟 ，现在要到“大约2020年5月 ”才会发射。
The James Webb Space Telescope is also in danger of busting the cost cap put on the project by the US Congress .
詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜也面临着突破美国国会对该项目设定的成本上限的危险。
Back in 2011 , politicians on Capitol Hill said the observatory should not take more than 8 billion dollars to build and 800 million dollars to operate over five years in orbit.
早在 2011 年 ， 国会山的政治家就表⽰ ，天文台的建设成本不应超过 80 亿美元 ，在轨道上运行五年的成本不应超过 8亿美元。

text: The bill calls for the establishment of the National Landslide Hazards Reduction Programme within one year of becoming law. The programme serves numerous functions, including to identify and understand landslide hazards and risks, reduce losses from landslides, protect communities at risk of landslides hazards, and improve communication and emergency preparedness.
translations: The bill calls for the establishment of the National Landslide Hazards Reduction Programme within one year of becoming law.
该法案要求在成为法律后一年内制定国家山体滑坡灾害减少计划。

The programme serves numerous functions , including to identify and understand landslide hazards and risks , reduce losses from landslides , protect communities at risk of landslides hazards , and improve communication and emergency preparedness .
该计划具有多种功能 ，包括识别和了解山体滑坡灾害和风险、减少山体滑坡造成的损失、保护面临山体滑坡灾害风险的社区以及改善沟通和应急准备。

text: Blue whales are the largest living mammals. Though reports of maximum length and weight vary from one account to another, Antarctic blue whales are known to have reached lengths to 100 feet, and weights of over 150 tonnes before stocks were severely depleted by whaling operations.
translations: Blue whales are the largest living mammals .
蓝鲸是现存最大的哺乳动物。

Though reports of maximum length and weight vary from one account to another, Antarctic blue whales are known to have reached lengths to 100 feet , and weights of over 150 tonnes before stocks were severely
depleted by whaling operations .
尽管关于最大长度和重量的报道各有不同 ，但众所周知 ，在捕鲸活动严重耗尽其种群之前 ，南极蓝鲸的长度可达 100英尺 ，重量超过 150 吨。

text: An innovative new product or service can give a ﬁrm a head start over its rivals, which can be diﬃcult for a new entrant to overcome. If the new technology is also patented, then other ﬁrms cannot simply copy its design. It is legally protected.
translations: An innovative new product or service can give a firm a head start over its rivals , which can be difficult for a new entrant to overcome .
创新的新产品或服务可以让公司领先于竞争对手 ，这对于新进入者来说可能很难克服。
If the new technology is also patented , then other firms cannot simply copy its design .如果新技术也获得了专利 ，那么其他公司就不能简单地复制其设计。
It is legally protected.它受到法律保护。

text: Agricultural problems due to climate change of normal weather, water depletion and the collapse of soil have become big problems in all parts of the world. Many are now focusing on ethics and family farming as a way to combat these issues.
translations: Agricultural problems due to climate change of normal weather, water depletion and the collapse of soil have become big problems in all parts of the world.
由于正常天气的气候变化、水资源枯竭和土壤崩塌而导致的农业问题已成为世界各地的大问题。
Many are now focusing on ethics and family farming as a way to combat these issues .许多人现在关注道德和家庭农业 ， 以此作为解决这些问题的一种方怯。

text: Statistics are indicators of change and allow meaningful comparisons to be made. While it may be the issues rather than the statistics as such that grab people 's attention, it should be recognised that it is the statistics that informed the issues. Statistical literacy, then, is the ability to accurately understand, interpret and evaluate the data that inform these issues.
translations: Statistics are indicators of change and allow meaningful comparisons to be made .统计数据是变化的指标 ，可以进行有意义的比较。
While it may be the issues rather than the statistics as such that grab people 's attention , it should be recognised that it is the statistics that informed the issues .
虽然吸引人们注意力的可能是问题而不是统计数据 ，但应该认识到是统计数据为问题提供了信息。
Statistical literacy, then , is the ability to accurately understand , interpret and evaluate the data that inform these issues .
因此 ，统计素养是准确理解、解释和评估为这些问题提供信息的数据的能力。

text: The course considers the ways in which thinkers have responded to the particular political problems of their day, and the ways in which they contribute to a broader conversation about human goods and needs, justice, democracy, and the proper relationship of the individual to the state.
translations: The course considers the ways in which thinkers have responded to the particular political problems of their day, and the ways in which they contribute to a broader conversation about human goods and needs , justice , democracy, and the proper relationship of the individual to the state .
该课程考虑了思想家对他们那个时代的特定政治问题做出回应的方怯 ， 以及他们为更广泛的关于人类利益和需求、正义、民主以及个人与国家的适当关系的对话做出贡献的方怯。

text: Within this free course, you will be introduced brieﬂy to the discipline of child psychology and to theories and approaches that have been developed to help us understand and support children 's lives by focusing on the individual children. Psychologists can assess changes in their child 's abilities over time, including their physical, cognitive, social, and emotional development.
translations: Within this free course , you will be introduced briefly to the discipline of child psychology and to theories and approaches that have been developed to help us understand and support children 's lives by focusing on the
individual children .
在这门免费课程中 ，您将简要了解儿童心理学学科以及已开发的理论和方法 ，这些理论和方法通过关注个别儿童来帮助我们理解和支持儿童的生活。
Psychologists can assess changes in their child 's abilities over time , including their physical , cognitive , social , and emotional development.
心理学家可以评估孩子能力随时间的变化 ，包括他们的身体、认知、社交和情感发展。

text: The networks of roots that plants used to absorb water and nutrients can encompass a space larger than the part of the plant visible above ground. The nature of these roots systems can help plants adapt to challenging environments such as deserts.
translations: The networks of roots that plants used to absorb water and nutrients can encompass a space larger than the part of the plant visible above ground.
植物用来吸收水分和养分的根系网络所包含的空间比植物在地面上可见的部分更大。
The nature of these roots systems can help plants adapt to challenging environments such as deserts .这些根系的性质可以帮助植物适应沙漠等具有挑战性的环境。

text: Urban forests can show pride and community spirit. Trees enhance community economic stability by attracting businesses and tourism. People linger and shop longer along tree-lined streets, apartments and oﬃces in wooded areas, rent more quickly and have higher occupancy rates. Businesses leasing oﬃce space and developed developments with trees ﬁnd their workers are more productive and absenteeism is reduced.
translations: Urban forests can show pride and community spirit.
城市森林可以展现自豪感和社区精神。
Trees enhance community economic stability by attracting businesses and tourism .
树木通过吸引企业和旅游业来增强社区经济的稳定性。
People linger and shop longer along tree-lined streets , apartments and offices in wooded areas , rent more quickly and have higher occupancy rates .
人们在绿树成荫的街道、公寓和树木繁茂的办公室里逗留和购物的时间更长 ，租房更快 ，入住率更高。
Businesses leasing office space and developed developments with trees find their workers are more productive and absenteeism is reduced.
租赁办公空间和种植树木的开发项目的企业发现 ，他们的员工工作效率更高 ，缺勤率也有所降低。

text: Rarely, however, does a single research study produce the certainty needed to assume that the same results will apply in all or most settings. Rather, research is usually an ongoing process, based on many accumulated understandings and explanations that, when taken together, lead to a generalisation of educational issues and ultimately, to the development of theories.
translations: Rarely, however, does a single research study produce the certainty needed to assume that the same results will apply in all or most settings .
然而 ，很少有一项单一的研究能够产生假设相同结果适用于所有或大多数环境所需的确定性。

Rather, research is usually an ongoing process , based on many accumulated understandings and explanations that , when taken together, lead to a generalisation of educational issues and ultimately, to the development of theories .
相反 ，研究通常是一个持续的过程 ，基于许多积累的理解和解释 ， 当这些理解和解释结合在一起时 ，会导致教育问题的普遍化 ，并最终导致理论的发展。

text: To some extent, attendance at cultural venues and events is inﬂuenced by a person 's age and the composition of the household in which they live. For example, those people in households with dependent children were more likely to visit zoological parks and aquariums than people living in single person households.
translations: To some extent , attendance at cultural venues and events is influenced by a person 's age and the composition of the household in which they live .
在某种程度上 ，参加文化场所和活动受到一个人的年龄和他们居住的家庭构成的影响。
For example , those people in households with dependent children were more likely to visit zoological parks and aquariums than people living in single person households .
例如 ，与生活在单身家庭中的人相比 ，有受抚养子女的家庭中的人更有可能参观动物园和水族馆。

text: Your tutor helps you make the most of your time at university by giving you guidance and support along the way. All new students are allocated a personal tutor who will encourage you to get the most out of your course, direct you to other sources of support and help you achieve your goals.
translations: Your tutor helps you make the most of your time at university by giving you guidance and support along the way.
你的导师会在整个过程中为你提供指导和支持 ，帮助你充分利用大学时间。
All new students are allocated a personal tutor who will encourage you to get the most out of your course , direct you to other sources of support and help you achieve your goals .
所有新生都会分配一位私人导师 ，他会鼓励你充分利用你的课程 ，指导你获得其他支持来源 ，并帮助你实现你的目标。

text: At a time when stress levels are soaring, rates of depression are increasing and the gap between rich and poor is ever widening. We believe that giving can play a positive role in helping people to feel connected to those around them and generate a sense of purpose and hope. When we give, we feel valued, useful and happy.
translations: At a time when stress levels are soaring , rates of depression are increasing and the gap between rich and poor is ever widening.
在压力水平飙升的时代 ，抑郁症的发病率正在上升 ，贫富差距也在不断扩大。
We believe that giving can play a positive role in helping people to feel connected to those around them and generate a sense of purpose and hope .
我们相信 ，给予可以发挥积极作用 ，帮助人们感受到与周围人的联系 ，并产生目标感和希望感。
When we give , we feel valued , useful and happy.当我们给予时 ，我们会感到有价值、有用和快乐。

text: Three hundred and eighty years after his death, William Shakespeare remains the central author of the English-speaking world; he is the most quoted poet and the most regularly produced playwright-and now among the most popular screenwriters as well. Why is that, and who "is "he? Why do so many people think his writing is so great? What meanings did his plays have in his own time, and how do we read, speak, or listen to his words now?
translations: Three hundred and eighty years after his death , William Shakespeare remains the central author of the English- speaking world;
威廉·莎士比亚死后三百八十年 ，仍然是英文界的主要作家。
he is the most quoted poet and the most regularly produced playwright-and now among the most popular screenwriters as well.
他是被引用最多的诗人和最常被创作的剧作家——现在也是最受欢迎的编剧之一。
Why is that , and who " is " he?为什么会这样 ，他是谁？
Why do so many people think his writing is so great?为什么那么多人认为他的作品如此优秀？
What meanings did his plays have in his own time , and how do we read , speak , or listen to his words now?他的戏剧在他那个时代有什么意义 ，我们现在如何读、说或听他的话？

text: Who do you think is the most glamorous person? A biotechnologist who led his company in international research, an ordinary welder who gained international fame through his work, or a photographer complimented widely for a series of photos?
translations: Who do you think is the most glamorous person?你认为谁是最有魅力的人？
A biotechnologist who led his company in international research , an ordinary welder who gained international fame through his work , or a photographer complimented widely for a series of photos?
一位领导公司进行国际研究的生物技术专家 ，一位通过工作获得国际声誉的普通焊工 ，还是一位因一系列照片而广受赞誉的摄影师？

text: We seek to improve learner 's experience of education at college and help them to aspire, achieve and progress. We must embed equality and diversity in everything we do, both as a provider and an employer. We hope to prepare our students for work, higher education and citizenship by equipping our staﬀ with the skills to meet this agenda.
translations: We seek to improve learner 's experience of education at college and help them to aspire , achieve and progress .
我们力求改善学习者在大学的教育体验 ，帮助他们追求、实现和进步。
We must embed equality and diversity in everything we do , both as a provider and an employer.作为知识提供者和雇主 ，我们必须将平等和多样性融入所做的事情中。
We hope to prepare our students for work , higher education and citizenship by equipping our staff with the skills to meet this agenda .
我们希望通过让员工具备满足这一议程的技能 ，让我们的学生为工作、高等教育和公民身份做好准备。

text: Expression became important during the Romantic movement with artwork expressing a deﬁnite feeling, as in the sublime or dramatic. Audience response was important, for the artwork was intended to evoke an emotional response. This deﬁnition holds true today, as artists look to connect with and evoke responses from their viewers.
translations: Expression became important during the Romantic movement with artwork expressing a definite feeling , as in the sublime or dramatic .
在浪漫主义行为中 ，表达变得很重要 ，艺术品表达了一种明确的感觉 ，如崇高或戏剧化。
Audience response was important , for the artwork was intended to evoke an emotional response .观众的反应很重要 ， 因为艺术品旨在唤起情绪反应。
This definition holds true today, as artists look to connect with and evoke responses from their viewers .这个定义在今天仍然适用 ， 因为艺术家希望与观众建立联系并引起他们的反应。

text: Members of a culture must conform to its norms for the culture to exist and function. Hence, members must want to conform and obey rules. They ﬁrst must internalise the social norms and values that dictate what is normal for the culture. Then they must socialise or teach norms and values to their children.
translations: Members of a culture must conform to its norms for the culture to exist and function .一种文化的成员必须遵守其规范 ，文化才能存在和发挥作用 。
Hence , members must want to conform and obey rules .因此 ，成员必须愿意顺应并遵守规则。
They first must internalise the social norms and values that dictate what is normal for the culture .他们首先必须内化决定什么是正常文化的社会规范和价值观。
Then they must socialise or teach norms and values to their children .然后他们必须社会化或向他们的孩子传授规范和价值观。

text: Experts discuss the signiﬁcance of attending the theatre as a civic occasion, associated with the political and cultural achievements of Athens. Through archaeology and analyses of contemporary art forms such as decoration on pottery, a picture is built up of ancient Greek theatre.
translations: Experts discuss the significance of attending the theatre as a civic occasion , associated with the political and cultural achievements of Athens .
专家们讨论了参加观看戏剧作为公民场合的重要性 ，这与雅典的政治和文化成就有关。
Through archaeology and analyses of contemporary art forms such as decoration on pottery, a picture is built up of ancient Greek theatre .
通过考古学和陶器装饰等当代艺术形怯的分析 ，勾勒出一幅古希腊戏剧的图景。

text: In this course, we will explore how such things as department stores, nationally advertised brand-name goods, mass produced cars and suburbs transformed the American economy, society and politics. The course is organised both thematically and chronologically. Each period deals with a new development in the history of consumer culture.
translations: In this course , we will explore how such things as department stores , nationally advertised brand-name goods , mass produced cars and suburbs transformed the American economy, society and politics .
在本课程中 ，我们将探索百货商店、全国广告名牌商品、大规模生产的汽车和郊区等事物如何改变美国的经济、社会和政治。
The course is organised both thematically and chronologically.课程按主题和时间顺序组织。
Each period deals with a new development in the history of consumer culture .每个时期都涉及消费文化史上的新发展。

text: The tortoise size and shell shape varies depending on where they live. The shell is made of bone and is a dull brown colour. Their ribs, backbone and breastbone have become part of the shell, which is why you can never separate the tortoise from its shell.
translations: The tortoise size and shell shape varies depending on where they live .乌龟的大小和壳的形状因居住地而您。
The shell is made of bone and is a dull brown colour.壳由骨头制成 ， 呈暗褐色。
Their ribs , backbone and breastbone have become part of the shell , which is why you can never separate the tortoise from its shell.
它们的肋骨、脊椎骨和胸骨已经成为壳的一部分 ，这就是为什么你永远无法将乌龟与其壳分开的原因。

text: The natural environment can be hazardous, and, with increased travel and leisure, people today are more likely than ever to be exposed to potentially life-threatening conditions. Although the human body can adjust to some extent, it cannot cope with poisons or prolonged exposure to extremes of environment.
translations: The natural environment can be hazardous , and , with increased travel and leisure , people today are more likely than ever to be exposed to potentially life-threatening conditions .
自然环境可能是危险的 ，而且随着旅行和休闲的增加 ，今天的人们比以往任何时候都更有可能暴露在可能危及生命的条件下。
Although the human body can adjust to some extent , it cannot cope with poisons or prolonged exposure to extremes of environment.
虽然人体可以在一定程度上进行调整 ，但无法应对毒物或长时间暴露在极端环境中。

text: In the late 16th and 17th centuries, many English, French and Dutch emigrants went to North America in search of gold and silver. But they did not ﬁnd it. Instead, settlers were forced to support themselves by cultivating crops that they could sell in Europe, like tobacco, indigo and rice.
translations: In the late 16th and 17th centuries , many English , French and Dutch emigrants went to North America in search of gold and silver.
在 16 世纪末和 17 世纪 ，许多英国、法国和荷兰移民前往北美寻找金银。
But they did not find it.但是他们没有找到。
Instead , settlers were forced to support themselves by cultivating crops that they could sell in Europe , like tobacco , indigo and rice .
相反 ，定居者被迫通过种植可以在欧洲销售的作物来养活自 己 ，例如烟草、靛蓝和大米。

text: Since our graduate admission school is not centralised, each of the university schools and colleges admits students to its own programmes. For information about speciﬁc programme degrees, graduate applications, graduate admission requirements and procedures, graduate scholarships and status of your application, visit the individual school websites.
translations: Since our graduate admission school is not centralised , each of the university schools and colleges admits students to its own programmes .
由于我们的研究生招生学校不是集中的 ，每个大学学院都招收学生参加自己的课程。

For information about specific programme degrees , graduate applications , graduate admission requirements and procedures , graduate scholarships and status of your application , visit the individual school websites .
有关特定课程学位、研究生申请、研究生入学要求和程序、研究生奖学金和申请状态的信息 ，请访问各个学校的网站。

text: There were various explanations for volcano behaviour before the structure of the earth mantle as a semisolid material was developed. For decades, awareness that compression and radioactive materials may be heat sources was discounted and volcanic action was often attributed to chemical reactions and a thin layer of molten rock near the surface.
translations: There were various explanations for volcano behaviour before the structure of the earth mantle as a semisolid material was developed.
在地幔作为半固体材料的结构被开发出来之前 ，对火山行为有多种解释。

For decades , awareness that compression and radioactive materials may be heat sources was discounted and volcanic action was often attributed to chemical reactions and a thin layer of molten rock near the surface .
几十年来 ，压缩和放射性物质可能是热源的这种意识被低估了 ，火山活动通常归因于化学反应和地表附近一层薄薄的熔融岩石。

text: This is a new, accessible and engaging textbook written by academics who also work as consultants with organisations undergoing change. It oﬀers a unique combination of rigorous theoretical exploration together with practical insights from working with those who are actually responsible for managing change.
translations: This is a new, accessible and engaging textbook written by academics who also work as consultants with organisations undergoing change .
这是一本新的、易于理解且引人入胜的教科书 ， 由学者撰写 ，他们同时也是正在经历变革的组织的顾问。
It offers a unique combination of rigorous theoretical exploration together with practical insights from working with those who are actually responsible for managing change .
它提供了严格的理论探索与与实际负责管理变革的人员合作的实践见解的独特结合。

text: The word radical from the Latin word for roots means anyone who advocates fundamental change in the political system. Literally, a radical is one who proposes to attack some political or social problem by going deep into the social or economic fabric to get at the root cause and alter this basic weakness.
translations: The word radical from the Latin word for roots means anyone who advocates fundamental change in the political system .
“激进 ”一词源自拉丁语 ，意为“根源 ” ，意指任何主张政治制度发生根本变革的人。
Literally, a radical is one who proposes to attack some political or social problem by going deep into the social or economic fabric to get at the root cause and alter this basic weakness .
从字面上看 ，激进分子是指提出通过深入社会或经济结构来解决某些政治或社会问题 ， 以找到根本原因并改变这一基本弱点的人。

text: We believe in the inherent value of research in the humanities and social sciences. And our research data agenda is given by the pursuit of new knowledge that will be of beneﬁt of Australia and the world. We oﬀer one of the most comprehensive programmes in the humanities and social sciences in Australia and the Asian Paciﬁc region.
translations: We believe in the inherent value of research in the humanities and social sciences .我们相信人文社会科学研究的内在价值。
And our research data agenda is given by the pursuit of new knowledge that will be of benefit of Australia and the world.
我们的研究数据议程是为了追求新知识 ，这将造福澳大利亚和世界。
We offer one of the most comprehensive programmes in the humanities and social sciences in Australia and the Asian Pacific region .
我们提供澳大利亚和亚太地区最全面的人文和社会科学课程之一。

text: The whole purpose of making notes is to aid your learning. It is important to go back over them within a day of making them to make sure they make sense and make them legible for future revisions. Also, going back over them should highlight the key questions of areas in which you want to do further reading.
translations: The whole purpose of making notes is to aid your learning.做笔记的全部目的是帮助你的学习。
It is important to go back over them within a day of making them to make sure they make sense and make them legible for future revisions .
重要的是在制作后的一天之内回顾它们 ， 以确保它们有意义并使它们清晰易读 ， 以便将来进行修改。
Also , going back over them should highlight the key questions of areas in which you want to do further reading.
此外 ， 回顾它们应该突出您想要进一步阅读的领域的关键问题。

text: The information session is a 45-minute presentation conducted by an admission representative. Immediately following the session is a 90-minute walking tour of the campus led by a student ambassador. Walking tours of the campus generally include classroom buildings, a residence hall room, a dining hall, the library, athletic facilities, performing art facilities, and the student union.
translations: The information session is a 45-minute presentation conducted by an admission representative .信息会议是由招生代表进行的 45 分钟演⽰。
Immediately following the session is a 90-minute walking tour of the campus led by a student ambassador.紧随其后的是学生大使带领的 90 分钟校园徒步之旅。
Walking tours of the campus generally include classroom buildings , a residence hall room , a dining hall , the library, athletic facilities , performing art facilities , and the student union .
步行游览校园通常包括教学楼、宿舍房间、餐厅、 图书馆、体育设施、表演艺术设施和学生会。

text: The dyes and pigments available in any particular period in which a speciﬁc colour photographic process was invented, manufactured and used have profound eﬀects on the quality of colour that deﬁnes most of the style and particular historical period.
translations: The dyes and pigments available in any particular period in which a specific colour photographic process was invented , manufactured and used have profound effects on the quality of colour that defines most of the style and particular historical period.
在发明、制造和使用特定彩色摄影过程的任何特定时期 ，可用的染料和颜料对定义大多数风格和特定历史时期的色彩质量有着深远的影响。

text: The ﬁndings of modern research support the view that the evolution of primitive men and its culture should be regarded as "unity ". Yet this unity is exceedingly complex, and future research will doubtless enable us to make ﬁner distinctions between the periods that people composed it.
translations: The findings of modern research support the view that the evolution of primitive men and its culture should be regarded as " unity " .
现代研究结果支持原始人及其文化的进化应被视为“ 一体 ”的观点。
Yet this unity is exceedingly complex , and future research will doubtless enable us to make finer distinctions between the periods that people composed it.
然而 ，这种统一非常复杂 ，未来的研究无疑将使我们能够更好地区分人们组成它的各个时期。

text: Many individuals have unwittingly contributed to this book through sharing ideas with us as colleagues, students, practitioners, tourists, and residents of destination areas. They are too numerous to thank individually. And indeed, it is not possible to isolate exactly their speciﬁc contributions.
translations: Many individuals have unwittingly contributed to this book through sharing ideas with us as colleagues , students , practitioners , tourists , and residents of destination areas .
许多人作为同事、学生 、从业者、游客和目的地居民 ，通过与我们分享想法 ，不知不觉地为本书做出了贡献。
They are too numerous to thank individually.他们太多了 ，无法单独感谢。
And indeed , it is not possible to isolate exactly their specific contributions .事实上 ，不可能完全抛开他们的具体贡献。

text: It is normally expected that the ﬁnal version of your thesis which must be submitted to the university library in both hardcopy and electronic form will be freely available to the public. Once in the library, your thesis may be consulted, borrowed and copied in accordance with the regulations.
translations: It is normally expected that the final version of your thesis which must be submitted to the university library in both hardcopy and electronic form will be freely available to the public .
通常预计必须以纸质和电子形怯提交给大学图书馆的论文的最终版本将免费提供给公众。
Once in the library, your thesis may be consulted , borrowed and copied in accordance with the regulations .进入图书馆后 ，您的论文可按规定查阅、借阅和复印。

text: The committee would also like to express its gratitude to the independent assessors who joined the committee for consideration of each case. Their expertise and advice play a vital role in our work. A list of independent assessors who attended meetings during this reporting year is included at Appendix D.
translations: The committee would also like to express its gratitude to the independent assessors who joined the committee for consideration of each case .
委员会还想对加入委员会审议每个案件的独立评估员表⽰感谢。
Their expertise and advice play a vital role in our work.
他们的专业知识和建议在我们的工作中发挥着至关重要的作用 。
A list of independent assessors who attended meetings during this reporting year is included at Appendix D.在本报告年度参加会议的独立评估员名单包含在附录 D 中。

text: In medicine, the application of information technology means the digitalization of medical records and the establishment of an intelligent network for sharing those records. Other beneﬁts ﬂow from these technological changes. In the past medicine has taken a paternalistic stance, with the all-knowing physician dispensing wisdom, but that is becoming increasingly untenable.
translations: In medicine , the application of information technology means the digitalization of medical records and the establishment of an intelligent network for sharing those records .
在医学上 ，信息技术的应用意味着病历的数字化和共享病历的智能网络的建立。
Other benefits flow from these technological changes .这些技术变革还带来了其他好处。
In the past medicine has taken a paternalistic stance , with the all-knowing physician dispensing wisdom , but that is becoming increasingly untenable .
过去医学采取家长怯的立场 ，全知的医生分配智慧 ，但这种做法越来越站不住脚了。

text: We can see from the X-rays that at an early stage of painting, a window was painted at the left of the portrait. It seems that there may have been two windows in the initial design for the portrait or that the window was moved at an early stage.
translations: We can see from the X-rays that at an early stage of painting , a window was painted at the left of the portrait.我们从X光片可以看出 ，在绘画初期 ， 画像的左边画了一个窗户。
It seems that there may have been two windows in the initial design for the portrait or that the window was moved at an early stage .
似乎在最初的肖像设计中可能有两个窗户 ，或者窗户在早期被移动了。

text: Many papers you write in college will require you to include quotes from one or more sources. Even if you don 't have to do it, integrating a few quotes into your writing can add life and persuasiveness to your arguments. The key is to use quotes to support a point you 're trying to make rather than just include them to ﬁll the space.
translations: Many papers you write in college will require you to include quotes from one or more sources .你在大学写的许多论文都会要求你引用一个或多个来源的文献。
Even if you don 't have to do it , integrating a few quotes into your writing can add life and persuasiveness to your arguments .
即使你不必这样做 ，在你的写作中加入一些引述也可以为你的论点增添活力和说服力。
The key is to use quotes to support a point you 're trying to make rather than just include them to fill the space .关键是使用引用文献来支持你试图表达的观点 ，而不是仅仅包括它们来填补空白 。

text: Most babies start developing their hearing while still in the womb, prompting some hopeful parents to play classical music to their pregnant bellies. Some research even suggests that infants are listening to adult speech as early as 10 weeks before birth, gathering the basic building blocks of their family 's native tongue.
translations: Most babies start developing their hearing while still in the womb , prompting some hopeful parents to play classical music to their pregnant bellies .
大多数婴儿在子宫内就开始发展听力 ，这促使一些满怀希望的父母给怀孕的肚子播放古典音乐。
Some research even suggests that infants are listening to adult speech as early as 10 weeks before birth , gathering the basic building blocks of their family 's native tongue .
一些研究甚至表明 ，婴儿早在出生前 10 周就开始听成人讲话 ，收集他们家庭母语的基本组成部分。

text: Your subject outlines are a good place to go to ﬁnd information about which textbooks to buy. You will usually be given one of these for each subject in the ﬁrst lecture, but if you are missing one or need one earlier then you should contact the subject coordinator.
translations: Your subject outlines are a good place to go to find information about which textbooks to buy.您的课程大纲是查找有关购买哪些教科书的信息的好地方。
You will usually be given one of these for each subject in the first lecture , but if you are missing one or need one earlier then you should contact the subject coordinator.
在第一堂课中 ，您通常会为每项课程提供其中一个大纲 ，但如果您缺少一个或提前需要一个大纲 ，那么您应该联系课程协调人员。

text: Most people do not realise that some banks literally make money by giving loans without having money on deposit. The system is called fractional reserve banking and is used in most economies. It sounds as though it is safe because it says that banks have to keep a fraction of their deposits with the Reserve Bank.
translations: Most people do not realise that some banks literally make money by giving loans without having money on deposit.
大多数人没有意识到 ，有些银行实际上是通过提供贷款而没有存款来赚钱的。
The system is called fractional reserve banking and is used in most economies .该系统被称为部分准备金银行 ，并在大多数经济体中使用 。
It sounds as though it is safe because it says that banks have to keep a fraction of their deposits with the Reserve Bank.
听起来好像很安全 ， 因为它说银行必须将一小部分存款存放在储备银行。

text: In the past, wars have led to inﬂation and higher commodity prices. Fighting disrupts trade and prevents raw materials from being shipped from one country to another. In second- world-war Britain, a banana was the highest of luxury.
translations: In the past , wars have led to inflation and higher commodity prices .过去 ， 战争导致通货膨胀和商品价格上涨。
Fighting disrupts trade and prevents raw materials from being shipped from one country to another.战斗扰乱贸易并阻止原材料从一个国家运往另一个国家。
In second-world-war Britain , a banana was the highest of luxury.在二战时期的英国 ，香蕉是最高级的奢侈品。

text: Globalisation refers to a set of changes rather than a single change. Many of these changes are social, cultural and political rather than purely economic, and one of the main drivers in addition to the global marketplace is the communication revolution.
translations: Globalisation refers to a set of changes rather than a single change .全球化是指一系列的变化而不是单个变化。
Many of these changes are social , cultural and political rather than purely economic , and one of the main drivers in addition to the global marketplace is the communication revolution .
其中许多变化是社会、文化和政治的 ，而不是纯粹的经济变化 ， 除了全球市场之外 ，主要驱动力之一是通信革命。

text: It 's not easy to make a wind turbine blade. Conventional blades require a lot of labour. They are a sandwich composed of ﬁberglass, sheets of balsa wood and a chemical called an epoxy thermoset resin. A heat oven is required to give blades the proper shape, strength, smoothness and ﬂexibility to catch the wind and turn the turbine.
translations: It 's not easy to make a wind turbine blade .制造风力涡轮机叶片并不容易。
Conventional blades require a lot of labour.传统的刀片需要大量的劳动力。
They are a sandwich composed of fiberglass , sheets of balsa wood and a chemical called an epoxy thermoset resin .
它们是由玻璃纤维、轻木片和一种称为环氧热固性树脂的化学物质组成的“ 三明治 ”。
A heat oven is required to give blades the proper shape , strength , smoothness and flexibility to catch the wind and turn the turbine .
需要一个加热炉来为叶片提供适当的形状、强度、平滑度和灵活性 ， 以捕捉风并转动涡轮机。

text: We want a recreation in adulthood of what it felt like to be administered to and indulged. In a secret part of our minds, we picture someone who will understand our needs, bring us what we want, be immensely patient and sympathetic to us, act selﬂessly, and make it all better.
translations: We want a recreation in adulthood of what it felt like to be administered to and indulged.我们希望在成年后重新体验被管理和沉迷的感觉。
In a secret part of our minds , we picture someone who will understand our needs , bring us what we want , be immensely patient and sympathetic to us , act selflessly, and make it all better.
在我们内心深处 ，想象有人会理解我们的需求 ，给我们带来想要的东西 ，对我们非常有耐心且同情 ，无私地行动 ，让一切变得更好。

text: This report includes a huge swath of macroeconomics, such as the eﬀects of a tax reform, a new industrial policy, and understanding how to deal with the uncertainty inherent in the global ﬁnancial market. But it also covers key areas of macroeconomic policies, such as boosting laggardly rates of productivity.
translations: This report includes a huge swath of macroeconomics , such as the effects of a tax reform , a new industrial policy, and understanding how to deal with the uncertainty inherent in the global financial market.
这份报告包括大量宏观经济学的内容 ，例如税制改革的影响、新的产业政策 ， 以及如何应对全球金融市场固有的不确定性。
But it also covers key areas of macroeconomic policies , such as boosting laggardly rates of productivity.但它也涵盖了宏观经济政策的关键领域 ，例如提高落后的生产率。

text: The most obvious change is that 46 percent of college undergraduates are now women. When I went there, it was only the third year that women had been admitted, and then seemingly grudgingly: about 70 percent of students were male, and if there was a woman tutor, she must have been a male impersonator.
translations: The most obvious change is that 46 percent of college undergraduates are now women .最明显的变化是现在 46% 的大学本科生是女性。

When I went there , it was only the third year that women had been admitted , and then seemingly grudgingly: about 70 percent of students were male , and if there was a woman tutor, she must have been a male
impersonator.
我入学的时候 ，是录取女性学生的第三年 ，然后似乎录取得很不情愿： 大约70%的学生是男的 ，如果有女导师 ，她一定会是个“假小子 ”。

text: We 've spent a lot of money over the last 70 years on ﬂood control, and it 's protected millions of people and has saved us billions of dollars. We 've built dams to hold back the waters. We 've built levees to keep the water oﬀ the people, and we 've raised the ones that were originally started in 1718.
translations: We 've spent a lot of money over the last 70 years on flood control , and it 's protected millions of people and has saved us billions of dollars .
在过去的 70 年里 ，我们在防洪上投入很多资金 ，使得数百万人受到了保护 ，为我们节省了数十亿美元。
We 've built dams to hold back the waters .我们建造了水坝来阻挡水流。
We 've built levees to keep the water off the people , and we 've raised the ones that were originally started in 1718.
我们建造了防洪堤来阻止洪水泛滥 ，还修整了初建于 1718 年的堤坝。

text: Environmental, individual and social traits of free-ranging raccoons inﬂuence performance in cognitive testing. Shy raccoons are better learners than bold ones, a result that has implications for our relationship with urban wildlife.
translations: Environmental , individual and social traits of free-ranging raccoons influence performance in cognitive testing.自由放养浣熊的生活环境、个体特征和社会特征会影响认知测试的表现。
Shy raccoons are better learners than bold ones , a result that has implications for our relationship with urban wildlife .
害羞的浣熊比大胆的浣熊学习效果更好 ，这一结果对我们与城市野生动物的关系产生了影响。

text: Every few seconds our eyelids automatically shutter and our eyeballs roll back in their sockets. So why doesn 't blinking plunge us into intermittent darkness and light? New research shows that the brain works extra hard to stabilise our vision despite our ﬂuttering eyes. When our eyeballs roll back in their sockets during a blink, they don 't always return to the same spot when we reopen our eyes.
translations: Every few seconds our eyelids automatically shutter and our eyeballs roll back in their sockets .每隔几秒钟 ，我们的眼皮就会自动合上 ， 眼球会在眼眶中滚动。
So why doesn 't blinking plunge us into intermittent darkness and light?那么为什么眨眼不会让我们感觉一会亮一会暗呢？
New research shows that the brain works extra hard to stabilise our vision despite our fluttering eyes .新的研究表明 ，尽管我们的眼睛在颤抖 ，但大脑会更加努力地稳定视力。
When our eyeballs roll back in their sockets during a blink , they don 't always return to the same spot when we reopen our eyes .
我们的眼球在眨眼时会回滚到眼窝 ， 当我们重新睁开眼睛时 ， 眼球并不总是回到同一个位置。

text: Covid-19 pandemic is linked to early onset of puberty in some girls. Several studies suggest that the number of girls starting puberty early has more than doubled amid the coronavirus outbreak, and experts are unsure about exactly why.
translations: Covid-19 pandemic is linked to early onset of puberty in some girls .一些女孩的青春期提前与新冠大流行有关。
Several studies suggest that the number of girls starting puberty early has more than doubled amid the coronavirus outbreak , and experts are unsure about exactly why.
几项研究表明 ，在新冠病毒爆发期间 ，提前进入青春期的女孩人数增加了一倍多 ，专家们不确定具体原因。

text: The role of women in promoting voluntary medical male circumcision uptake: research reveals the important role played by women in inﬂuencing men to undergo circumcision because of the beneﬁts associated with them such as reduction of HIV transmission and cervical cancer.
translations: The role of women in promoting voluntary medical male circumcision uptake: research reveals the important role played by women in influencing men to undergo circumcision because of the benefits associated with
them such as reduction of HIV transmission and cervical cancer.
女性在促进男性自愿接受包皮环切术中的作用 ：研究揭⽰了女性在影响男性接受包皮环切术方面发挥的重要作用 ， 因为与她们相关的好处包括减少 HIV 传播和宫颈癌。

text: In every cultivated language, there are two great classes of words which, taken together, comprise the whole vocabulary. First, there are those words with which we become acquainted in daily conversation, which we learn from the members of our own family and from our familiar associates, and which we should know and use even if we could not read or write.
translations: In every cultivated language , there are two great classes of words which , taken together, comprise the whole vocabulary.
在每一种现代语言中 ，都有两大类词 ， 它们合起来就构成了整个词汇表。

First , there are those words with which we become acquainted in daily conversation , which we learn from the members of our own family and from our familiar associates , and which we should know and use even if we could not read or write .
首先 ，有些词是我们在日常谈话中熟悉的 ，我们从自己的家人和熟悉的伙伴那里学到的 ， 即使我们不会读写也应该知道和使用的词。

text: When someone commits a criminal act, we always hope the punishment will match the oﬀence. But when it comes to one of the cruellest crimes, animal ﬁghting, things rarely work out that way. Dog-ﬁghting victims are tortured and killed for proﬁt and sport, yet their criminal abusers often receive a minimal sentence for causing a lifetime of pain.
translations: When someone commits a criminal act , we always hope the punishment will match the offence .当有人犯罪时 ，我们总是希望惩罚与罪行相称。
But when it comes to one of the cruellest crimes , animal fighting , things rarely work out that way.但是 ， 当涉及到最残忍的罪行之一——动物斗殴时 ，事情很少会这样发展。
Dog-fighting victims are tortured and killed for profit and sport , yet their criminal abusers often receive a minimal sentence for causing a lifetime of pain .
决斗活动的狗为了利益和“运动 ”而受到酷刑和杀害 ，但它们的犯罪虐待者往往会因为造成一生的痛苦而受到最低刑罚。

text: Using artiﬁcial intelligence, researchers can create photorealistic images from three- dimensional scenery, paving the way for better driving simulators and better testing of driverless cars.
translations: Using artificial intelligence , researchers can create photorealistic images from three-dimensional scenery, paving the way for better driving simulators and better testing of driverless cars .
使用人工智能 ，研究人员可以从 3D 风景中创建逼真的图像 ，为更好的驾驶模拟器和更好的无人驾驶汽车测试做充分准备。

text: Changes in climate aﬀect, for example, the plant and animal life of a given area. The presence of coal beds in North America and Europe along with evidence of glaciation in these same areas indicates that they must have experienced alternately warmer and colder climates than they now possess.
translations: Changes in climate affect , for example , the plant and animal life of a given area .气候变化会影响特定地区植物和动物的生命。

The presence of coal beds in North America and Europe along with evidence of glaciation in these same areas indicates that they must have experienced alternately warmer and colder climates than they now possess .
北美和欧洲煤层的存在以及这些地区冰川作用的证据表明 ， 它们一定经历过比现在更暖和更冷的气候。

text: To prevent mosquito-transmitted diseases, approaches based on genetic control of insect populations are being developed. However, many of these strategies are based on highly invasive, self-propagating transgenes that can rapidly spread the trait into other populations of mosquitoes.
translations: To prevent mosquito-transmitted diseases , approaches based on genetic control of insect populations are being developed.
为了预防蚊子传播的疾病 ，人们正在研究基于昆虫种群遗传控制的方法。
However, many of these strategies are based on highly invasive , self-propagating transgenes that can rapidly spread the trait into other populations of mosquitoes .
然而 ，这些策略中的许多都是基于高度侵入性、 自我繁殖的转基因 ，这些转基因可以迅速将这种性状传播到其他蚊子种群中。

text: An economic depression is a period of sustained, long-term downturn in economic activity in one or more economies. It is more severe than a recession, which is a slowdown in economic activity over the course of a normal business cycle. Economic depressions are characterised by their length, and by abnormally large increases in the unemployment rate.
translations: An economic depression is a period of sustained , long-term downturn in economic activity in one or more economies .
经济萧条是一个或多个经济体经济活动持续、长期低迷的时期。
It is more severe than a recession , which is a slowdown in economic activity over the course of a normal business cycle .
它比衰退更严重 ，衰退是在正常商业周期的过程中经济活动放缓。
Economic depressions are characterised by their length , and by abnormally large increases in the unemployment rate .
经济萧条的特点是持续时间长 ，失业率您常大幅上升。

text: Research has shown that the gut microbiome is important for human physiology and health. Disturbances to the composition of the gut microbiome can be associated with chronic diseases such as gastrointestinal inﬂammatory disorders, and neurological, cardiovascular and respiratory illnesses. The human body has evolved strategies to ensure that a symbiotic relationship exists between the microbes in our gut and our cells.
translations: Research has shown that the gut microbiome is important for human physiology and health.研究表明 ，肠道菌群对人体生理和健康很重要。

Disturbances to the composition of the gut microbiome can be associated with chronic diseases such as gastrointestinal inflammatory disorders , and neurological , cardiovascular and respiratory illnesses .
肠道菌群的紊乱可能与慢性疾病有关 ，例如胃肠道炎症性疾病以及神经、心血管和呼吸系统疾病。
The human body has evolved strategies to ensure that a symbiotic relationship exists between the microbes in our gut and our cells .
人体已经进化出一些策略来确保我们肠道中的微生物和我们的细胞之间存在共生关系。

text: Eﬃciency is not your friend when it comes to cognitive growth. In order to keep our brains making new connections and keep them active, you need to keep moving on to another challenging activity as soon as you reach the point of mastery in the one you were engaging in.
translations: Efficiency is not your friend when it comes to cognitive growth.在认知增长方面 ，效率并非你的好友。

In order to keep our brains making new connections and keep them active , you need to keep moving on to another challenging activity as soon as you reach the point of mastery in the one you were engaging in .
为了让大脑创造新回路以及保持活跃状态 ，一旦你熟练掌握所从事的活动 ，就需要继续进行另一项具有挑战性的活动。

text: Our central aim is to enable you to develop your knowledge and attitudes and skills that are conducive to constructive involvement, cooperation and teamwork with others and will serve you well in future endeavours, the process demands of all of us a serious exercise in civic responsibility.
translations: Our central aim is to enable you to develop your knowledge and attitudes and skills that are conducive to
constructive involvement , cooperation and teamwork with others and will serve you well in future endeavours , the process demands of all of us a serious exercise in civic responsibility.
我们的核心目的是让你扩充自己的知识、改进态度并提升技能 ， 以促进建设性参与、合作和与他人的团队协作 ，并在未来的努力中为您提供良好的服务 ，这一过程要求我们所有人认真履行公民责任。

text: Psychology is the study of cognitions, emotions, and behaviour. Psychologists are involved in a variety of tasks. Many spend their careers designing and performing research to understand how people behave in speciﬁc situations, how and why we think the way we do, and how emotions develop and what impact they have on our interactions with others.
translations: Psychology is the study of cognitions , emotions , and behaviour.心理学是对认知、情绪和行为的研究。
Psychologists are involved in a variety of tasks .心理学家负责各种相关活动。

Many spend their careers designing and performing research to understand how people behave in specific situations , how and why we think the way we do , and how emotions develop and what impact they have on our interactions with others .
许多人将他们的职业生涯用于设计和进行研究 ， 以了解人们在特定情况下的行为方怯、我们如何思考以及为什么会这样思考、情绪如何发展以及以上这些对我们与他人互动的影响。

text: The central idea of this book concerns our blindness with respect to randomness, particularly the large deviations: Why do we, scientists or nonscientists, hotshots or regular Joes, tend to see the pennies instead of the dollars? Why do we keep focusing on the minutiae, not the possible signiﬁcant large events, in spite of the obvious evidence of their huge inﬂuence?
translations: The central idea of this book concerns our blindness with respect to randomness , particularly the large
deviations: Why do we , scientists or nonscientists , hotshots or regular Joes , tend to see the pennies instead of the dollars?
这本书的中心思想是关于我们对随机性的忽略 ，尤其是大偏差： 为什么我们这些非科学家、能人或普通科学家倾向于观察细节而非整体？
Why do we keep focusing on the minutiae , not the possible significant large events , in spite of the obvious evidence of their huge influence?
为什么我们继续关注细节 ，而不是可能的重大重大事件 ，尽管有明显证据表明它们的巨大影响？

text: An environment of rapid change, technological innovations and increasing business competitiveness has highlighted the growing importance of management development. In particular, the general movement towards great employee involvement and making things happen through people has emphasised an integrating rather than a controlling style of management.
translations: An environment of rapid change , technological innovations and increasing business competitiveness has highlighted the growing importance of management development.
快速变化、技术创新和不断提高的商业竞争力的环境凸显了管理发展日益重要的地位。
In particular, the general movement towards great employee involvement and making things happen through people has emphasised an integrating rather than a controlling style of management.
尤其是员工积极参与 ，并通过人来达成事务的总体目标 ，这些都强调了整合而不是控制风格的管理方法。

text: Despite many similarities with literary-political debates in other nations, there are also ways in which the cultural and political situation in Scotland has left the study of Scottish Literature in a signiﬁcantly diﬀerent condition from that of literary studies in many other parts of the world.
translations: Despite many similarities with literary-political debates in other nations , there are also ways in which the
cultural and political situation in Scotland has left the study of Scottish Literature in a significantly different condition from that of literary studies in many other parts of the world.
尽管与其他国家的文学政治辩论有许多相似之处 ，但苏格兰的文化和政治状况在某些方面也使苏格兰文学研究处于与世界许多其他地区的文学研究截然不同的状态。

text: Bolstered by the result of laboratory experiments, researchers dare to say that gaming might be mentally enriching. These scholars are the ﬁrst to admit that games could be addictive, and indeed part of their research explores how games connect to the reward circuit of human beings.
translations: Bolstered by the result of laboratory experiments , researchers dare to say that gaming might be mentally enriching.
在实验结果的支持下 ，研究人员得出确切结论 ，游戏可能会丰富精神世界。
These scholars are the first to admit that games could be addictive , and indeed part of their research explores how games connect to the reward circuit of human beings .
这些学者最先认为游戏可能会上瘾 ，他们的部分研究确实探索了游戏如何与人类的奖励回路联系起来。

text: Summer research scholarships oﬀered uniquely valuable opportunities to internal organisations, professors and students to work together in those research. Working with globally recognised researchers in a local setting, lovely students will gain a lot of valuable real-world experiences and an insight into what research is all about to you.
translations: Summer research scholarships offered uniquely valuable opportunities to internal organisations , professors and students to work together in those research.
暑期研究奖学金为内部组织、教授和学生在这些研究中合作提供了独特的宝贵机会。
Working with globally recognised researchers in a local setting , lovely students will gain a lot of valuable real- world experiences and an insight into what research is all about to you .
在本地环境中与全球知名的研究人员合作 ，可爱的学子们将获得许多宝贵的实际经验 ，并深入了解研究对于个体来讲意味着什么。

text: Political scholars had historically recognised the social love of the mass media. The impact of the mass media on the electric and governing process has greatly increased over the last ﬁfty years. Tomorrow, the mass media will become the "central nervous system "for your society and the major source of public information.
translations: Political scholars had historically recognised the social love of the mass media .政治学者在历史上已经认识到大众媒体对社会的热爱。
The impact of the mass media on the electric and governing process has greatly increased over the last fifty years .
在过去的五十年中 ，大众媒体对电力和治理过程的影响大大增加。
Tomorrow, the mass media will become the "central nervous system "for your society and the major source of public information .
明天 ，大众媒体将成为社会的“ 中枢神经系统 ”和公共信息的主要来源。

text: The world 's ﬁfth largest continent: Antarctica is almost entirely covered by ice over 2000 metres thick. The area sustains varied wildlife including seals, whales, and penguins. The Antarctic treaty signed in 1959 and enforced since 1961 provides for international governance of Antarctica.
translations: The world 's fifth largest continent: Antarctica is almost entirely covered by ice over 2000 metres thick.南极洲是世界第五大大陆 ， 它几乎完全被2000多米厚的冰层所覆盖。
The area sustains varied wildlife including seals , whales , and penguins .该地区栖息着各种野生动物 ，包括海豹、鲸鱼和企鹅。
The Antarctic treaty signed in 1959 and enforced since 1961 provides for international governance of Antarctica .
于1959 年签署 ， 1961 年生效的《南极条约》 规定了南极洲的国际治理方法。

text: Behavioural and social sciences research helps predict, prevent and manage illness-in individuals and in whole populations. This research also helps people change their behaviours, understand treatments, and learn how to stick with them. Society's role is signiﬁcant, too: access to health care aﬀects decision-making behaviour.
translations: Behavioural and social sciences research helps predict , prevent and manage illness-in individuals and in whole populations .
行为和社会科学研究有助于预测、预防和管理个人和整个人类的疾病。
This research also helps people change their behaviours , understand treatments , and learn how to stick with them .
这项研究还可以帮助人们改变他们的行为 ， 了解治疗方法 ，并学习如何坚持下去。
Society 's role is significant , too: access to health care affects decision-making behaviour.社会的作用也很重要： 获得医疗保健会影响决策行为。

text: One of the major factors inﬂuencing future home design will be the probable change in climate, with hotter summers, colder winters, and the possibility of ﬂoods. Consequently, houses will be built with better insulation and will also need ways of keeping cool in hot weather, whether that 's air conditioning or more shading of windows.
translations: One of the major factors influencing future home design will be the probable change in climate , with hotter summers , colder winters , and the possibility of floods .
影响未来家居设计的主要因素之一将是气候可能发生的变化 ，夏季更热 ，冬季更冷 ， 以及可能发生洪水。
Consequently, houses will be built with better insulation and will also need ways of keeping cool in hot weather, whether that 's air conditioning or more shading of windows .
因此 ，房屋的隔热性能将更好 ，并且还需要在炎热天气中保持凉爽的方法 ，无论是空调还是窗戶的更多遮阳设备。

text: The problem is, that increased immune vigilance has a side eﬀect: allergies. Our speculation is that this is some kind of trade-oﬀ . In the past, you needed to resist some kind of pathogen, and the trade-oﬀ or sacriﬁce you have to make is increased responsiveness to nonpathogenic allergens. So next time some of you get the springtime sniﬄes, blame your distant ancestor-the one with the heavy brow ridge.
translations: The problem is , that increased immune vigilance has a side effect: allergies .问题是 ，提高免疫系统防护有一个副作用 ：过敏。
Our speculation is that this is some kind of trade-off.我们的猜测是 ，这是某种权衡。
In the past , you needed to resist some kind of pathogen , and the trade-off or sacrifice you have to make is increased responsiveness to nonpathogenic allergens .
过去 ，您需要抵抗某种病原体 ，必须做出的权衡或牺牲就是增加对非致病性过敏原的反应。
So next time some of you get the springtime sniffles , blame your distant ancestor-the one with the heavy brow ridge .
所以下次当你患上花粉症时 ，就怪你那个眉骨很高的远亲去吧。

text: As the inventor of alternating-current technology, Nikola Tesla played a paramount role in the electricity used to power the entire world. Tesla also worked diligently on a dream of supplying electrical power without wires. Thomas Edison was also instrumental in shaping society today with his inventions. Edison 's design of the inside of the light bulb was the crucial key to making a light that would stay lit for hours instead of going out almost immediately.
translations: As the inventor of alternating-current technology, Nikola Tesla played a paramount role in the electricity used to power the entire world.
作为交流电技术的发明者 ，尼古拉·特斯拉在为全世界供电的电力方面发挥了至关重要的作用 。
Tesla also worked diligently on a dream of supplying electrical power without wires .特斯拉还为实现无电线供电的梦想而努力工作。
Thomas Edison was also instrumental in shaping society today with his inventions .托马斯·爱迪生的发明也有助于塑造今天的社会。
Edison 's design of the inside of the light bulb was the crucial key to making a light that would stay lit for hours instead of going out almost immediately.
爱迪生对灯泡内部的设计是制造能够持续点亮数小时而不是几乎立即熄灭的灯的关键。

text: Many people are under the impression that the water which comes out of a plant is clean. This is a common misconception: the function of a plant is to make the water cleaner, but it 's not clean enough to drink. It could be used in irrigation. What a plant is trying to do is simply speed up a process that would naturally occur given more time. This means that a plant can create water that is safe to enter back into the water system as it 's so heavily diluted. The river then continues the water puriﬁcation, acting as a form of the fourth stage.
translations: Many people are under the impression that the water which comes out of a plant is clean .许多人的印象是从植物中出来水是干净的。
This is a common misconception: the function of a plant is to make the water cleaner, but it 's not clean enough to drink.
这是一个常见的误解： 植物的功能是让水更干净 ，但它还不够干净 ，不能喝。
It could be used in irrigation .它可以用于灌溉。
What a plant is trying to do is simply speed up a process that would naturally occur given more time .工厂试图做的只是加速一个在更多时间自然会发生的过程。
This means that a plant can create water that is safe to enter back into the water system as it 's so heavily diluted.
这意味着植物可以产生可以安全返回水系统的水 ， 因为它被严重稀释。
The river then continues the water purification , acting as a form of the fourth stage .然后河流继续净化水 ，作为第四阶段的一种形怯。

text: If you do experience a motorcycle crash, be aware the other driver will most likely blame you for the accident. This includes the road, road conditions, any skid marks, road signs, construction, and anything else that may have contributed to the accident. Not every accident requires an attorney but a knowledgeable local attorney can help you make sense of the process, as well as ensure that the other driver 's insurance doesn 't unfairly blame you for the accident.
translations: If you do experience a motorcycle crash , be aware the other driver will most likely blame you for the accident.如果您确实遇到了摩托车撞车事故 ，请注意其他司机很可能会因为事故而责备您。
This includes the road , road conditions , any skid marks , road signs , construction , and anything else that may have contributed to the accident.
这包括道路、路况、任何防滑痕迹、路标、施工以及可能导致事故的任何其他因素。

Not every accident requires an attorney but a knowledgeable local attorney can help you make sense of the process , as well as ensure that the other driver 's insurance doesn 't unfairly blame you for the accident.
并非每起事故都需要律师 ，但知识渊博的当地律师可以帮助您理解该过程 ，并确保其他司机的保险不会不公平地将事故归咎于您。

text: Intangible assets perform a number of distinctive functions in the life of each company. Firstly, they witness the prosperity of the ﬁrm in its good name. Such a position allows human resource management to employ professional workers and increase labour productivity. Moreover, intangible assets guarantee future value for the ﬁrm. And although it is diﬃcult to destroy intangible assets, they can lose their importance in case of carelessness or business failure.
translations: Intangible assets perform a number of distinctive functions in the life of each company.无形资产在每家公司的生命周期中发挥着许多独特的功能。
Firstly, they witness the prosperity of the firm in its good name .首先 ，他们以良好的名义见证了公司的繁荣。
Such a position allows human resource management to employ professional workers and increase labour productivity.
这样的职位使人力资源管理可以雇用专业工人并提高劳动生产率。
Moreover, intangible assets guarantee future value for the firm .此外 ，无形资产保证了公司的未来价值。
And although it is difficult to destroy intangible assets , they can lose their importance in case of carelessness or business failure .
尽管无形资产很难销毁 ，但如果粗心大意或业务失败 ， 它们可能会失去重要性。

text: Electric vehicles have arrived. With technology led by Tesla, and all of the world 's major car manufacturers following along behind, electric vehicles are now a common sight on the roads of most developed countries. Yet the situation in less developed countries is rather diﬀerent; the only African country to have started the change to electric vehicles is South Africa.
translations: Electric vehicles have arrived.电车来了。
