With technology led by Tesla , and all of the world 's major car manufacturers following along behind , electric vehicles are now a common sight on the roads of most developed countries .
以特斯拉为主导的技术 ， 以及世界各大汽车制造商的追随 ， 电动汽车现在已成为大多数发达国家道路上的常见景象。
Yet the situation in less developed countries is rather different;然而 ，欠发达国家的情况却大不相同。
the only African country to have started the change to electric vehicles is South Africa .唯一开始转向电动汽车的非洲国家是南非。

text: Neutron stars-the compressed remains of massive stars gone supernova-are the densest "normal "objects in the known universe. Black holes are technically denser, but far from normal. Just a single sugar-cube worth of neutron-star material would weigh 100 million tonnes here on Earth, or about the same as the entire human population.
translations: Neutron stars-the compressed remains of massive stars gone supernova-are the densest " normal "objects in the known universe .
中子星——大质量恒星的超新星压缩残骸——是已知宇宙中密度最大的“ 正常 ”天体。
Black holes are technically denser, but far from normal.黑洞在技术上更密集 ，但远非正常。
Just a single sugar-cube worth of neutron-star material would weigh 100 million tonnes here on Earth , or about the same as the entire human population .
在地球上 ，仅一个糖立方的中子星材料就重达 1 亿吨 ，或与整个人类人口大致相同。

text: The Classic Era of Mayan came to an end around 900 AD. Why this happened is unclear; the cities were probably over-farming the land, so that a period of drought led to famine. Recent geological research supports this, as there appears to have been a 200-year drought around this time.
translations: The Classic Era of Mayan came to an end around 900 AD.玛雅的经典时代在公元 900 年左右结束。
Why this happened is unclear;为什么会发生这种情况尚不清楚；
the cities were probably over-farming the land , so that a period of drought led to famine .城市可能过度耕作土地 ， 因此一段时间的干旱导致了饥荒。
Recent geological research supports this , as there appears to have been a 200-year drought around this time .最近的地质研究支持了这一点 ， 因为此时似乎发生了长达 200 年的干旱。

text: Based on the results from this study, we hypothesised that a high-protein diet coupled with low carbohydrate intake would be beneﬁcial for the prevention of bone loss in adults.
translations: Based on the results from this study, we hypothesised that a high-protein diet coupled with low carbohydrate intake would be beneficial for the prevention of bone loss in adults .
根据这项研究的结果 ，我们假设高蛋白饮食加上低碳水化合物摄入量将有利于预防成人骨质流失。

text: Symptoms of depression decrease with improvements in sense of smell, particularly among patients with dysosmia. New research published in the journal Scientiﬁc Reports highlights the intricate relationship between depression and sense of smell. The study found that participants ' symptoms of depression dropped as their odour identiﬁcation improved, particularly among those with an impaired sense of smell.
translations: Symptoms of depression decrease with improvements in sense of smell , particularly among patients with dysosmia .
抑郁症的症状随着嗅觉的改善而减轻 ，特别是在有嗅觉障碍的患者中。
New research published in the journal Scientific Reports highlights the intricate relationship between depression and sense of smell.
发表在《科学报告》 杂志上的新研究强调了抑郁症和嗅觉之间错综复杂的关系。
The study found that participants ' symptoms of depression dropped as their odour identification improved , particularly among those with an impaired sense of smell.
研究发现 ， 随着气味识别能力的提高 ，参与者的抑郁症状有所下降 ，尤其是那些嗅觉受损的人。

text: Our major conclusion is that the current measure needs to be revised. It no longer provides an accurate picture of the diﬀerences in the extent of economic poverty among population groups or geographic areas of the country, nor an accurate picture of trends over time.
translations: Our major conclusion is that the current measure needs to be revised.我们的主要结论是 ， 目前的措施需要修改。

It no longer provides an accurate picture of the differences in the extent of economic poverty among population groups or geographic areas of the country, nor an accurate picture of trends over time .
它不再准确描述该国人口群体或地理区域之间经济贫困程度的差您 ，也不再准确描述一段时间内的趋势。

text: An industry or workplace often has its own terms for certain items, places, or groups of people, and a university is no diﬀerent. Here we have attempted to explain some of the terms you may come across on our websites that are speciﬁc to higher education.
translations: An industry or workplace often has its own terms for certain items , places , or groups of people , and a university is no different.
一个行业或工作场所通常对某些项目 、地点或人群有自己的用语 ，大学也不例外。
Here we have attempted to explain some of the terms you may come across on our websites that are specific to higher education .
在这里 ，我们试图解释您在我们的网站上可能遇到的一些特定于高等教育的用语。

text: The noise restrictions are based on measurements on animals in captivity exposed to noise levels that induce a temporary threshold shift, TTS, in hearing. The TTS onset threshold is the lowest noise exposure capable of inducing a small temporary reduction of hearing sensitivity, also known as auditory fatigue, with full recovery shortly after exposure.
translations: The noise restrictions are based on measurements on animals in captivity exposed to noise levels that induce a temporary threshold shift , TTS , in hearing.
噪音限制是基于对圈养动物的测量结果 ，这些动物暴露在噪音水平会导致听力出现暂时的阈值偏移 （TTS）。

The TTS onset threshold is the lowest noise exposure capable of inducing a small temporary reduction of hearing sensitivity, also known as auditory fatigue , with full recovery shortly after exposure .
TTS 起始阈值是能够引起听力敏感性小幅暂时降低 （ 也称为听觉疲劳） 的最低噪声暴露 ，暴露后不久即可完全恢复。

text: Our information oﬃce on campus provided resources and support to help you make the right choices about childcare-whether you 're a student, staﬀ , or member of the local community. The oﬃce provides information about the ﬁve centres closest to our campuses, relevant government agency, and other daycare centres in the surrounding areas.
translations: Our information office on campus provided resources and support to help you make the right choices about childcare-whether you 're a student , staff , or member of the local community.
我们的校园信息办公室提供资源和支持 ， 以帮助您做出正确的托儿选择——无论您是学生 、教职员工还是当地社区的成员。
The office provides information about the five centres closest to our campuses , relevant government agency, and other daycare centres in the surrounding areas .
该办公室提供有关离我们校园最近的五个中心 、相关政府机构和周边地区其他日托中心的信息。

text: We understand that not everyone can put their job and other responsibilities on hold to study. That 's why our healthcare ethics and law master 's courses are available to study by distance learning, so you can ﬁt gaining an academic qualiﬁcation around your work and family.
translations: We understand that not everyone can put their job and other responsibilities on hold to study.我们知道 ，并不是每个人都可以放下工作和其他职责去学习的。
That 's why our healthcare ethics and law master 's courses are available to study by distance learning , so you can fit gaining an academic qualification around your work and family.
这就是为什么我们的医疗伦理和法律硕士课程可以远程学习 ，这样你就可以在不耽误工作和家庭的情况下获得学历。

text: Any writer must decide upon an order and a structure for a book in keeping with the reﬂexive nature of the work. There are strong currents of reiteration in the book, with each iteration developing understandings of research, theory, and practise as the story continues to unfold.
translations: Any writer must decide upon an order and a structure for a book in keeping with the reflexive nature of the work.
任何作家都必须根据作品的反身性来决定一本书的顺序和结构。
There are strong currents of reiteration in the book , with each iteration developing understandings of research , theory, and practise as the story continues to unfold.
书中有强烈的重复潮流 ， 随着故事的继续展开 ，每次迭代都会加深对研究、理论和实践的理解。

text: Despite a number of events in recent years devoted to language diversity, language endangerment, and multilingualism, such as the International Year of Languages, public awareness of the issues is still remarkably limited. Only one in four of the population know that half the languages in the world are so seriously endangered that they are unlikely to survive the present century.
translations: Despite a number of events in recent years devoted to language diversity, language endangerment , and
multilingualism , such as the International Year of Languages , public awareness of the issues is still remarkably limited.
尽管近年来发生了许多致力于语言多样性、语言濒危和多语制的活动 ， 比如国际语言年这种 ，但公众对这些问题的认识仍然非常有限。
Only one in four of the population know that half the languages in the world are so seriously endangered that they are unlikely to survive the present century.
只有四分之一的人知道 ，世界上有一半的语言受到严重威胁 ， 它们不太可能在本世纪存续下去。

text: Written by ten eminent professors, it had been updated to reﬂect the shifts of sociological thought in the last ﬁve years, making it the most comprehensive, authoritative, and contemporary dictionary available. It was essential reading for all students and teachers of sociologies and other related courses, and also for the general reader.
translations: Written by ten eminent professors , it had been updated to reflect the shifts of sociological thought in the last five years , making it the most comprehensive , authoritative , and contemporary dictionary available .
这本词典由十位著名教授撰写 ，经过更新以反映过去五年中社会学思想的转变 ，使它成为最全面 、最权威和最现代的词典。
It was essential reading for all students and teachers of sociologies and other related courses , and also for the general reader.
这是社会学和其他相关课程的所有学生和教师以及普通读者的必备读物。

text: Surprisingly, despite what appear to be inﬁnite variations, all diﬃcult conversations share a common structure. When you 're caught up in the details and anxiety of a particularly diﬃcult conversation, this structure is hard to see. But understanding that structure is essential to improve how you handle your most challenging conversations.
translations: Surprisingly, despite what appear to be infinite variations , all difficult conversations share a common structure .令人惊讶的是 ，尽管对话可能存在多种多样的变化 ，但所有复杂的对话都有一个共同的结构。
When you 're caught up in the details and anxiety of a particularly difficult conversation , this structure is hard to see .
当你陷入特定复杂对话的细节和焦虑中时 ，往往很难察觉到这种结构。
But understanding that structure is essential to improve how you handle your most challenging conversations .但要是了解这种结构 ，对于改进处理有挑战性的对话就非常重要了。

text: The Earth just had the hottest month in recorded history, and it 's even worse than normal. The record comes in a run of unprecedentedly hot months. Not only does it break through the all-time record set a year before, it also continues a now 10-month long streak of months that are the hottest ever according to Nasa data. The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration calculates temperatures slightly diﬀerently.
translations: The Earth just had the hottest month in recorded history, and it 's even worse than normal.地球刚刚经历了有记录以来最热的一个月 ，甚至比正常情况还要糟糕。
The record comes in a run of unprecedentedly hot months .这一记录出现在前所未有的炎热月份中。
Not only does it break through the all-time record set a year before , it also continues a now 10-month long streak of months that are the hottest ever according to Nasa data .
炎热天气不仅打破了一年前创下的历史记录 ，而且现在持续了长达 10 个月的时间 ，据美国国家航空航天局的数据显⽰ ，这是有史以来最热的几个月 。
The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration calculates temperatures slightly differently.美国国家海洋和大气管理局计算温度略有不同。

text: A university is a lot more than just classes and exams. University is a concept that oﬀers you a host of possibilities to develop both academically and personally. Find out about the diﬀerent projects, clubs and societies that are in your university. You will deﬁnitely ﬁnd something you are interested in.
translations: A university is a lot more than just classes and exams .大学里不仅仅是课程和考试。
University is a concept that offers you a host of possibilities to develop both academically and personally.大学是一个概念 ， 它为您提供了许多在学术和个人方面发展的可能性。
Find out about the different projects , clubs and societies that are in your university.了解您所在大学的不同项目 、俱乐部和社团。
You will definitely find something you are interested in .你一定会找到你感兴趣的东西。

text: Scholars build their own personal libraries to support not only particular projects but also general reading in their ﬁeld. They buy or make photocopies of materials when possible so they can consult them frequently, mark passages, and write annotations on them. When moving into a new ﬁeld, they add to their collections, usually concentrating on primary texts.
translations: Scholars build their own personal libraries to support not only particular projects but also general reading in their field.
学者们建立自己的个人图书馆 ，不仅支持特定项目 ，还支持他们所在领域的日常阅读。
They buy or make photocopies of materials when possible so they can consult them frequently, mark passages , and write annotations on them .
他们尽可能购买或复印材料 ， 以便经常查阅材料、标记段落并在其上写注释。
When moving into a new field , they add to their collections , usually concentrating on primary texts .当涉及到新领域时 ，他们会添加到收藏中 ，通常集中在主要文本上。

text: It 's time for this young loggerhead turtle to go to work. We can tether turtles in these little cloth harnesses, put them into this tank and dull swimming place. University of North Carolina biologist Ken Loman studies sea turtles that are programmed from birth for an extraordinary journey. Mother turtles buried the eggs on the beach and then returned to the sea and the eggs hatch about 50 to 60 days later.
translations: It 's time for this young loggerhead turtle to go to work.是时候让这只年轻的红海龟去上班了。
We can tether turtles in these little cloth harnesses , put them into this tank and dull swimming place .我们可以把乌龟拴在这些小布带上 ，放到这个水族箱 ，作为它的一个泳池。
University of North Carolina biologist Ken Loman studies sea turtles that are programmed from birth for an extraordinary journey.
北卡罗来纳大学的生物学家肯·洛曼研究海龟 ，这些海龟从出生开始就为它们编排好了一段非凡的旅程。
Mother turtles buried the eggs on the beach and then returned to the sea and the eggs hatch about 50 to 60 days later.
海龟妈妈将卵埋在沙滩上 ，然后返回大海 ，这些卵大约要孵化 50 到 60 天。

text: Undergraduates may choose to major in any one of 125 academic majors. The university's distinguished faculty includes internationally known scientists, authors and teachers who are committed to continuing the university 's tradition in providing one of the highest quality undergraduate educations available.
translations: Undergraduates may choose to major in any one of 125 academic majors .本科生可以选择125个学术专业中的任何一个。

The university 's distinguished faculty includes internationally known scientists , authors and teachers who are committed to continuing the university 's tradition in providing one of the highest quality undergraduate
educations available .
该大学的杰出教师包括国际知名的科学家、作家和教师 ，他们致力于延续大学的传统 ，提供最高质量的本科教育。

text: Don 't miss the very beginning of the lecture since it is very often the most valuable part. For instance, because it reviews previous lectures or outlines objects and lecture structure. If you easily get distracted by other students, sit near the front.
translations: Don 't miss the very beginning of the lecture since it is very often the most valuable part.不要错过讲座的一开始 ， 因为它通常是最有价值的部分。
For instance , because it reviews previous lectures or outlines objects and lecture structure .例如 ， 因为它回顾了以前的讲座或概述了对象和讲座结构。
If you easily get distracted by other students , sit near the front.如果你很容易被其他学生分心 ，请坐在靠前的位置。

text: The wonderful framework of mature trees creates a secluded, enclosed atmosphere that unites a great variety of plantings to inspire visitors in all seasons. Spring in the garden is marked by leaﬁng up and ﬂowering of trees and the eruption of the ﬂowers in the bulb meadows, and woodland understorey.
translations: The wonderful framework of mature trees creates a secluded , enclosed atmosphere that unites a great variety of plantings to inspire visitors in all seasons .
成熟树木的美妙框架营造出一种幽静、封闭的氛围 ，将各种各样的植物结合在一起 ，为各个季节的游客带来灵感。
Spring in the garden is marked by leafing up and flowering of trees and the eruption of the flowers in the bulb meadows , and woodland understorey.
花园里春天的标志是树木长叶、开花 ，球根草甸和林地下层的花朵绽放。

text: As the Delta variant of coronavirus sweeps the U.S. , businesses, universities and cities such as New York and San Francisco have introduced vaccine mandates to boost uptake of jabs, but vaccine hesitancy remains high and a cottage industry for bogus inoculation cards has emerged to help people get around the rules.
translations: As the Delta variant of coronavirus sweeps the U.S. , businesses , universities and cities such as New York and San Francisco have introduced vaccine mandates to boost uptake of jabs , but vaccine hesitancy remains high and a cottage industry for bogus inoculation cards has emerged to help people get around the rules .
随着冠状病毒的 Delta 变种席卷美国 ，企业 ，大学 ，纽约和旧金山等城市已引入疫苗授权以推动疫苗的接种 ，但疫苗犹豫情况仍然很多 ，并且出现了伪造接种卡的产业 ，来帮助人们逃避政策。

text: The survey found that the statistical chances of someone from a poor background being accepted at one of the country 's most respected universities are far lower than those of a student from a wealthy family. This means that the inequalities in society are likely to be passed down from one generation to the next.
translations: The survey found that the statistical chances of someone from a poor background being accepted at one of the country 's most respected universities are far lower than those of a student from a wealthy family.
调查发现 ， 出身寒门的学生被该国最好的大学录取的机会 ，远低于来自富裕家庭的学生。
This means that the inequalities in society are likely to be passed down from one generation to the next.这意味着社会上的不平等很可能会代代相传。

text: Yet this landscape, which appeared so alien and confronting to the white settlers and explorers, had been home for thousands of years to Indigenous Australians for whom the plains, ranges and deserts were a sustaining, spiritual and integral part of their existence.
translations: Yet this landscape , which appeared so alien and confronting to the white settlers and explorers , had been home for thousands of years to Indigenous Australians for whom the plains , ranges and deserts were a
sustaining , spiritual and integral part of their existence .
然而 ，这片在白人定居者和探险家面前显得如此陌生和对立的景观 ，几千年来一直是澳大利亚土著居民的家园 ，对他们来说 ，平原、 山脉和沙漠是他们生存的支撑、精神不可或缺的一部分。

text: We deﬁne paraphrasing as putting a passage from an author into your own words. However, what are your own words? How diﬀerent must your paraphrase be from the original? The answer is it should be considerably diﬀerent. The whole point of paraphrasing is to show you have read and understood another person 's ideas, and can summarise them in your own writing style rather than borrowing their phrases. If you just change a few words, or add some bits in your own to an otherwise reproduced passage, you will probably be penalised for plagiarism.
translations: We define paraphrasing as putting a passage from an author into your own words .我们将释义定义为将作者的一段话转化为您自己的话。
However, what are your own words?然而 ，你自己的想法是什么？
How different must your paraphrase be from the original?你的解释与原文有多大不同？
The answer is it should be considerably different.答案是它应该有很大不同。
The whole point of paraphrasing is to show you have read and understood another person 's ideas , and can summarise them in your own writing style rather than borrowing their phrases .
释义的全部意义在于表明您已经阅读并理解了他人的想法 ，并且可以用自己的写作风格对其进行总结 ，而不是借用他们的短语。
If you just change a few words , or add some bits in your own to an otherwise reproduced passage , you will probably be penalised for plagiarism .
如果你只是更改几个单词 ，或者在其他复制的段落中添加自己的一些内容 ，你可能会因抄袭而受到惩罚。

text: Summerhill School was regarded with considerable suspicion by the education establishment. Lessons were optional for pupils at the school, and the government of the school was carried out by a School Council, of which all the pupils and staﬀ were members, with everyone having equal voting rights.
translations: Summerhill School was regarded with considerable suspicion by the education establishment.夏山学校受到教育机构的高度质疑。

Lessons were optional for pupils at the school , and the government of the school was carried out by a School Council , of which all the pupils and staff were members , with everyone having equal voting rights .
学校的课程对学生来说是可选的 ，学校的管理由学校理事会执行 ，所有学生和教职员工都是其成员 ，每个人都有平等的投票权。

text: Plato often explores the father-son relationship and whether a father 's interest in his sons has anything to do with how well his sons turn out. A boy's social identity in ancient Athens was determined by his family identity, and Plato often refers to his characters in terms of their parental and fraternal relationships. Socrates was not a family man and considered himself as his mother 's son.
translations: Plato often explores the father-son relationship and whether a father 's interest in his sons has anything to do with how well his sons turn out.
柏拉图经常探讨父子关系 ， 以及父亲对儿子的兴趣是否与儿子的成绩有关。
A boy 's social identity in ancient Athens was determined by his family identity, and Plato often refers to his characters in terms of their parental and fraternal relationships .
古代雅典男孩的社会身份是由他的家庭身份决定的 ，柏拉图经常用父母和兄弟关系来指代他的人物。
Socrates was not a family man and considered himself as his mother 's son .苏格拉底不是一个有家室的人 ，他认为自己是他母亲的儿子。

text: The life of a hunter-gatherer is indeed, as Thomas Hobbes said of the state of nature, 'solitary, poor, nasty, brutish, and short '. In some respects, to be sure, wandering through the jungle bagging monkeys may be preferable to the hard slog of subsistence agriculture.
translations: The life of a hunter-gatherer is indeed , as Thomas Hobbes said of the state of nature , 'solitary, poor, nasty, brutish , and short ' .
正如托马斯·霍布斯 (Thomas Hobbes) 在谈到自然状态时所说的那样 ，狩猎采集者的生活确实是“孤独、贫穷、肮脏、野蛮和短暂 ”。
In some respects , to be sure , wandering through the jungle bagging monkeys may be preferable to the hard slog of subsistence agriculture .
在某些方面 ，可以肯定的是 ，在丛林中徜徉袋袋猴子可能比自给农业的艰苦跋涉更可取。

text: Tissues are grouped together in the body to form organs. These include the brain, heart, lungs, kidneys, and liver. Each body organ has a speciﬁc shape and is made up of diﬀerent types of tissue that work together. For example, the heart consists mainly of a specialised type of muscle tissue, which contracts rhythmically to provide the heart 's pumping action.
translations: Tissues are grouped together in the body to form organs .组织在体内聚集在一起形成器官。
These include the brain , heart , lungs , kidneys , and liver.这些包括大脑、心脏、肺、 肾脏和肝脏。
Each body organ has a specific shape and is made up of different types of tissue that work together.每个身体器官都有特定的形状 ，并由协同工作的不同类型的组织组成。
For example , the heart consists mainly of a specialised type of muscle tissue , which contracts rhythmically to provide the heart 's pumping action .
例如 ，心脏主要由一种特殊类型的肌肉组织组成 ， 它有节奏地收缩以提供心脏的泵血作用 。

text: Aquaculture, also known as aquafarming, is the farming of aquatic organisms such as ﬁsh, crustaceans, molluscs and aquatic plants. Aquaculture involves cultivating freshwater and saltwater populations under controlled conditions.
translations: Aquaculture , also known as aquafarming , is the farming of aquatic organisms such as fish , crustaceans , molluscs and aquatic plants .
水产养殖 ，也称为水产养殖 ，是养殖鱼类、 甲壳类、软体动物和水生植物等水生生物。
Aquaculture involves cultivating freshwater and saltwater populations under controlled conditions .水产养殖涉及在受控条件下养殖淡水和咸水种群。

text: From a child 's point of view, what is the purpose of TV advertising? Is advertising on TV done to give actors the opportunity to take a rest or practise their lines? Or is it done to make people buy things? Furthermore, is the main diﬀerence between programmes and commercials that commercials are for real, whereas programmes are not, or that programmes are for kids and commercials for adults?
translations: From a child 's point of view, what is the purpose of TV advertising?从孩子的角度来看 ， 电视广告的目的是什么？
Is advertising on TV done to give actors the opportunity to take a rest or practise their lines?电视广告是为了让演员有机会休息或练习台词吗？
Or is it done to make people buy things?还是为了让人买东西？
Furthermore , is the main difference between programmes and commercials that commercials are for real , whereas programmes are not , or that programmes are for kids and commercials for adults?
此外 ，节目和广告之间的主要区别是广告是真实的 ，而节目不是 ，还是节目是给孩子看的 ，广告是给成年人看的？

text: Having the same dream again and again is a well-known phenomenon, nearly two-thirds of the population report having recurring dreams. Being chased, ﬁnding yourself naked in a public place or in the middle of a natural disaster, losing your teeth or forgetting to go to class for an entire semester are typical recurring scenarios in these dreams.
translations: Having the same dream again and again is a well-known phenomenon , nearly two-thirds of the population report having recurring dreams .
重复做同样的梦是一个普遍现象 ，近三分之二的人都说会反复做梦。

Being chased , finding yourself naked in a public place or in the middle of a natural disaster, losing your teeth or forgetting to go to class for an entire semester are typical recurring scenarios in these dreams .
被追赶 ，在公共场所发现自己赤身裸体或处在自然灾害中 ，失去牙齿或整个学期忘记上课是这些梦中典型的反复出现的场景。

text: The United States is at present the world 's market for motor cars and trucks. An agent for the U.S. Bureau of Foreign and Domestic Commerce reports a prosperous condition of aﬀairs prevailing in Japan, which is buying more automobiles, especially large cars, than ever before.
translations: The United States is at present the world 's market for motor cars and trucks .美国是目前世界上汽车和卡车的售卖市场。

An agent for the U.S. Bureau of Foreign and Domestic Commerce reports a prosperous condition of affairs prevailing in Japan , which is buying more automobiles , especially large cars , than ever before .
美国外交和国内商务局的一名代理人说 ， 日本的经济繁荣 ， 因此日本人购买的汽车 ，尤其是大型汽车 ， 比以往任何时候都多。

text: Yet it is precisely in observing the intertwinings of success and failure that Chasing the Flame makes its greatest mark. With piercing insight and relentless logic, it reveals the pitfalls of international politics and details an intricate struggle between individual and institution. It haunts us with the poignant truth that even a great man can do only so much to reinvent the world.
translations: Yet it is precisely in observing the intertwinings of success and failure that Chasing the Flame makes its greatest mark.
然而 ，正是在观察成功与失败的交织中 ，《追焰》 取得了最大的成就。
With piercing insight and relentless logic , it reveals the pitfalls of international politics and details an intricate struggle between individual and institution .
它以敏锐的洞察力和无情的逻辑揭⽰了国际政治的陷阱 ，并详细描述了个人与机构之间错综复杂的斗争。
It haunts us with the poignant truth that even a great man can do only so much to reinvent the world.它以一个令人心酸的事实困扰着我们 ， 即使是伟人对于改造世界也只能做这么多。

text: Trade unions originated in Europe during the Industrial Revolution. Because of the machinery that had become commonplace, skilled labour became less in demand so employers had nearly all of the bargaining power. Employers mistreated the workers and paid them too little for the work they did. Trade unions were organised that would help in the improvement of working conditions.
translations: Trade unions originated in Europe during the Industrial Revolution .工会起源于工业革命时期的欧洲。
Because of the machinery that had become commonplace , skilled labour became less in demand so employers had nearly all of the bargaining power.
由于机器的广泛普及 ，对技术工人的需求减少了 ， 因此雇主拥有绝对的议价能力。
Employers mistreated the workers and paid them too little for the work they did.雇主虐待工人 ，给的工资太少。
Trade unions were organised that would help in the improvement of working conditions .工会的成立有助于改善工作条件。

text: It 's not that human activities didn 't impact wildlife at all, of course. Heavily hunted species, like white-tailed deer, grey squirrels, and raccoons, were photographed somewhat less often in hunted areas. Coyotes showed up more often in hunted areas. While most species didn 't avoid hiking trails, the predators actually preferred them.
translations: It 's not that human activities didn 't impact wildlife at all , of course .当然 ，并不是说人类活动一点都没有影响野生动物。
Heavily hunted species , like white-tailed deer, grey squirrels , and raccoons , were photographed somewhat less often in hunted areas .
被大量捕杀的物种 ，如白尾鹿 、灰松鼠和浣熊 ，在猎杀地区被拍摄到频率有所降低。
Coyotes showed up more often in hunted areas .郊狼更常出现在狩猎区。
While most species didn 't avoid hiking trails , the predators actually preferred them .虽然大多数物种并没有避开小路 ，但捕食者实际上更喜欢它们。

text: As a historian, if you really want to understand the sensibilities of those who lived in the past, you must be like a novelist and get into the skins of your characters and think and feel as they do. You are asked to imagine what 's like to be a peasant in mediaeval times, asking the sort of questions a peasant might ask. What the writer is saying is that a historian needs imaginative sympathy with ordinary people in the past.
translations: As a historian , if you really want to understand the sensibilities of those who lived in the past , you must be like a novelist and get into the skins of your characters and think and feel as they do .
作为一个历史学家 ，如果你真的想了解那些生活在过去的人的感受 ，你必须像一个小说家一样 ，潜入主角的身体里，像他们一样思考和感受。
You are asked to imagine what 's like to be a peasant in mediaeval times , asking the sort of questions a peasant might ask.
你要想象中世纪的农民是什么样的 ， 问农民可能会问的问题。
What the writer is saying is that a historian needs imaginative sympathy with ordinary people in the past.作者在说的是 ，历史学家需要对过去的普通人产生富有想象力的同情。

text: The situation is similar to a pregnant woman that has twin babies in her belly, says Avi Loeb of the Harvard-Smithsonian Centre for Astrophysics. He 's proposing the idea in a paper that 's been accepted for publication in the Astrophysical Journal Letters.
translations: The situation is similar to a pregnant woman that has twin babies in her belly, says Avi Loeb of the Harvard- Smithsonian Centre for Astrophysics .
哈佛-史密森天体物理中心的阿维·勒布说 ，这种情况就像一名孕妇肚子里生了双胞胎婴儿一样。
He 's proposing the idea in a paper that 's been accepted for publication in the Astrophysical Journal Letters .他在一篇已被《天体物理学杂志快报》 接受发表的论文中提出了这个想法。

text: As a child, you might dream one day of becoming an astronaut and, the next day, of becoming a ballet dancer, the possibilities are endless. Eventually, this wealth of choice is whittled down by external circumstances and internal interests. Similarly, precursor cells in early embryos make a series of stepwise 'decisions'governed by external forces and internal factors to generate the diverse array of cell types present in adult organisms.
translations: As a child , you might dream one day of becoming an astronaut and , the next day, of becoming a ballet dancer, the possibilities are endless .
作为一个孩子 ，你可能梦想有一天成为一名宇航员 ，第二天成为一名芭蕾舞演员 ，可能性是无穷无尽的。
Eventually, this wealth of choice is whittled down by external circumstances and internal interests .最终 ，这种选择的财富会被外部环境和内部利益所削弱。

Similarly, precursor cells in early embryos make a series of stepwise 'decisions 'governed by external forces and internal factors to generate the diverse array of cell types present in adult organisms .
类似地 ，早期胚胎中的前体细胞在外力和内部因素的控制下做出一系列逐步“决定 ” ， 以产生成体生物中存在的各种细胞类型。

text: Seismology is the scientiﬁc study of earthquakes and the propagation of elastic waves through the Earth or through other planet-like bodies. The ﬁeld also includes studies of earthquake environmental eﬀects such as tsunamis as well as diverse seismic sources such as volcanic, tectonic, glacial, ﬂuvial, oceanic, atmospheric, and artiﬁcial processes such as explosions. A related ﬁeld that uses geology to infer information regarding past earthquakes is paleoseismology.
translations: Seismology is the scientific study of earthquakes and the propagation of elastic waves through the Earth or through other planet-like bodies .
地震学是对地震和弹性波在地球或其他类行星物体中传播的科学研究。
The field also includes studies of earthquake environmental effects such as tsunamis as well as diverse
seismic sources such as volcanic , tectonic , glacial , fluvial , oceanic , atmospheric , and artificial processes such as explosions .
该领域还包括对地震环境影响 （ 如海啸） 以及各种地震源 （ 如火山 、构造、冰川、河流、海洋、大气和人工过程 （ 如爆炸） ） 的研究。
A related field that uses geology to infer information regarding past earthquakes is paleoseismology.使用地质学来推断过去地震信息的一个相关领域是古地震学。

text: The speaker reminisces about his views of the English Revolution when he was a student and how it seemed quite clear which side he was on the aristocrats', not the puritans'. Later he realised there was more to it than that and there were several ways of interpreting the Revolution: as a struggle between the king and parliament, as a class war or as an unpredictable situation without clear sides.
translations: The speaker reminisces about his views of the English Revolution when he was a student and how it seemed quite clear which side he was on the aristocrats ' , not the puritans ' .
演讲者回忆起他在学生时代对英国革命的看法 ， 以及很明显 ，他站在贵族而不是清教徒的那一边。

Later he realised there was more to it than that and there were several ways of interpreting the Revolution: as a struggle between the king and parliament , as a class war or as an unpredictable situation without clear sides .后来他意识到 ，革命不止于此 ，有几种方怯可以解释革命： 作为国王和议会之间的斗争 ，作为阶级战争 ，或者作为没有明确立场的不可预测的情况。

text: History is selective. What history books tell us about the past is not everything that happened, but what historians have selected. They cannot put in everything: choices have to be made. Choices must similarly be made about which aspects of the past should be formally taught to the next generation in the shape of school history class.
translations: History is selective .历史是有选择性的。
What history books tell us about the past is not everything that happened , but what historians have selected.历史书告诉我们关于不是所有过去发生的事情 ，而是历史学家选择了什么事情。
They cannot put in everything: choices have to be made .
他们不能把所有东西都放进去： 必须要做出选择。
Choices must similarly be made about which aspects of the past should be formally taught to the next generation in the shape of school history class .
同样地 ，要决定对过去的哪些方面做出选择 ，并以学校历史课的形怯正怯教授给下一代。

text: Nell says that, in order to seek protecting from their furry foes, birds actually prefer to build their nests in plots of swamp with a resident alligator. In fact, in one study a graduate student planted fake alligators. The birds seemed to prefer to build nests close to them. "Where there 's a water source, there are alligators, so it 's sort of this moat of protection around these colonies. "
translations: Nell says that , in order to seek protecting from their furry foes , birds actually prefer to build their nests in plots of swamp with a resident alligator.
内尔说 ，为了保护自己免受毛茸茸的敌人的伤害 ，鸟类实际上更喜欢在沼泽地里筑巢 ，里面有一只常驻鳄鱼。
In fact , in one study a graduate student planted fake alligators .事实上 ，在一项研究中 ，一名研究生放置了一些假鳄鱼。
The birds seemed to prefer to build nests close to them .这些鸟似乎更喜欢在靠近它们的地方筑巢。
"Where there 's a water source , there are alligators , so it 's sort of this moat of protection around these colonies .
“ 哪里有水源 ， 哪里就有短吻鳄 ，所以这有点像围绕这些领地的护城河。

text: Over time a split would have appeared in wolf populations, he says: those wolves that feared humans, and those that didn 't "So this would have facilitated, I think, the domestication process. "At which point humans deliberately took wolves as pets. But that domestication process, Frantz says, may have happened more than once: ﬁrst in the west, in Europe. And again in the Far East, in Asia.
translations: Over time a split would have appeared in wolf populations , he says: those wolves that feared humans , and those that didn 't "So this would have facilitated , I think , the domestication process .
他说 ， 随着时间的推移 ，狼群中会出现分裂： 一些是害怕人类的狼 ，另一些是不害怕人类的狼“所以我认为这会促进驯化过程。
"At which point humans deliberately took wolves as pets . “在这一点上 ，人类故意将狼当作宠物。
But that domestication process , Frantz says , may have happened more than once: first in the west , in Europe .但弗兰茨说 ，驯化过程可能不止一次发生： 首先在西方 ，在欧洲。
And again in the Far East , in Asia .再次在远东 ，在亚洲。

text: A ubiquitous neurotransmitter that carries signals between brain cells, dopamine, among its many functions, is involved in multiple aspects of cognitive processing. The chemical messenger has been extensively studied from the perspective of external cues, or "deterministic "signals.
translations: A ubiquitous neurotransmitter that carries signals between brain cells , dopamine , among its many functions , is involved in multiple aspects of cognitive processing.
多巴胺是一种无处不在的神经递质 ，在脑细胞之间传递信号 ，在其众多功能中 ，涉及认知处理的多个方面。
The chemical messenger has been extensively studied from the perspective of external cues , or "deterministic "signals .
人们从外部线索或“确定性 ”信号的角度对化学信使进行了广泛的研究。

text: Previous research has oﬀered circumstantial evidence that Ganymede, the largest moon in the solar system, contains more water than all of Earth 's oceans. However, temperatures there are so cold that water on the surface is frozen solid. Ganymede 's ocean would reside roughly 100 miles below the crust; therefore, the water vapour would not represent the evaporation of this ocean.
translations: Previous research has offered circumstantial evidence that Ganymede , the largest moon in the solar system , contains more water than all of Earth 's oceans .
先前的研究提供了间接证据 ，证明木卫三是太阳系中最大的卫星 ，其含水量比地球上所有的海洋都要多。
However, temperatures there are so cold that water on the surface is frozen solid.然而 ，那里的温度太低了 ， 以至于表面上的水都冻结成固体。
Ganymede 's ocean would reside roughly 100 miles below the crust;木卫三的海洋位于地壳下方大约 100 英里处；
therefore , the water vapour would not represent the evaporation of this ocean .因此 ，水蒸气不是这片海洋的蒸发形成的。

text: The southerners did not accept Lincoln as a president because of certain reasons, based on historical grounds. Southerners wished to protect their rights in the government and become more independent from the north. They considered presidential elections to be unfair. Moreover, they thought that their own rights will be ignored and limited. All this caused the separation of the southern states and marked the beginning of the Civil War.
translations: The southerners did not accept Lincoln as a president because of certain reasons , based on historical grounds .
由于某些原因 ，基于历史背景 ，南方人不接受林肯为总统。
Southerners wished to protect their rights in the government and become more independent from the north.南方人希望保护他们在政府中的权利 ，并更能从北方中独立出来。
They considered presidential elections to be unfair.他们认为总统选举是不公平的。
Moreover, they thought that their own rights will be ignored and limited.而且 ，他们认为自己的权利会被忽视和限制。
All this caused the separation of the southern states and marked the beginning of the Civil War.所有这一切导致南部各州的分离 ，并标志着内战的开始。

text: In 1861, Matthew Brady, a well-known portrait photographer, approached President Lincoln requesting permission to move freely about the country photographing the Civil War. Lincoln granted him permission to travel anywhere with the Union armies, and his record of this conﬂict brought home to millions the horrors of war.
translations: In 1861 , Matthew Brady, a well-known portrait photographer, approached President Lincoln requesting permission to move freely about the country photographing the Civil War.
1861 年 ，著名的肖像摄影师马修·布雷迪 （ Matthew Brady） 找到林肯总统 ，请求允许他在内战的国家自由走动拍摄。
Lincoln granted him permission to travel anywhere with the Union armies , and his record of this conflict brought home to millions the horrors of war.
林肯允许他随联邦军队前往任何地方 ，他对这场冲突的记录让数百万人了解战争的恐怖。

text: As introverts are thinking, they reach back into long-term memory to locate information. An introvert will often compare old and new experiences when making a decision, which slows the processing down but leads to carefully thought-out decisions. This means that introverts have an active dialogue with themselves and usually walk around with many thoughts in their minds.
translations: As introverts are thinking , they reach back into long-term memory to locate information .当内向者思考时 ，他们会回到长期记忆中来定位信息。
An introvert will often compare old and new experiences when making a decision , which slows the processing down but leads to carefully thought-out decisions .
内向的人在做决定时经常会比较新旧体验 ，这会减慢处理速度 ，但会催生出经过深思熟虑的决定。
This means that introverts have an active dialogue with themselves and usually walk around with many thoughts in their minds .
这意味着内向的人会与自己进行积极的对话 ，并且通常会带着很多想法四处走动。

text: A study found that the research funded by the soft drinks industry has diﬀerent results from research funded by other sources and went on to suggest that there may have been biassed by the research itself. The whole point of the scientiﬁc methods is to ensure the research results are not inﬂuenced by the source of funding.
translations: A study found that the research funded by the soft drinks industry has different results from research funded by other sources and went on to suggest that there may have been biassed by the research itself.
一项研究发现 ，软饮料行业资助的研究与其他来源的结果不同 ，并进一步表明研究本身可能存在偏见。
The whole point of the scientific methods is to ensure the research results are not influenced by the source of funding.
科学方法的全部意义在于确保研究结果不受资金来源的影响。

text: The transition from the 'brick and mortar 'structure to 'click and order 'model started with the emergence of Information Technology and its use in the ﬁnancial sector. The use of technology in banking has resulted in availability of multiple delivery channels like ATMs, tele- banking, internet banking, and mobile banking.
translations: The transition from the ' brick and mortar 'structure to 'click and order ' model started with the emergence of Information Technology and its use in the financial sector.
从“ 实体 ”结构到“点击订购 ”模怯的转变 ，始于信息技术的出现及其在金融领域的应用 。
The use of technology in banking has resulted in availability of multiple delivery channels like ATMs , tele- banking , internet banking , and mobile banking.
银行技术的使用导致了多种交付渠道的可用性 ，如 ATM、 电话银行 、 网上银行和手机银行。

text: Tasmania is a large and relatively sparsely populated island oﬀ the south coast of Australia. The island is of particular interest to natural scientists, who go there to research the unique wildlife. Tasmania has, for example, twelve species of bird that are not found anywhere else in the world.
translations: Tasmania is a large and relatively sparsely populated island off the south coast of Australia .塔斯马尼亚岛是澳大利亚南海岸的一个大岛 ，人口相对稀少。
The island is of particular interest to natural scientists , who go there to research the unique wildlife .自然科学家对这个岛特别感兴趣 ，他们去那里研究独特的野生动物。
Tasmania has , for example , twelve species of bird that are not found anywhere else in the world.例如 ，塔斯马尼亚有十二种鸟类 ，世界上其他的地方都没有。

text: Aboriginal people are believed to have arrived as early as 60, 000 years ago, and evidence of Aboriginal art in Australia dates back at least 30, 000 years. Several states and territories had their origins as penal colonies, with the ﬁrst British convicts arriving at Sydney Cove in 1788.
translations: Aboriginal people are believed to have arrived as early as 60 , 000 years ago , and evidence of Aboriginal art in Australia dates back at least 30 , 000 years .
据信 ，土著人早在 60 ,000 年前就已经到达澳大利亚 ，澳洲土著艺术的文物至少可以追溯到 30 ,000 年前。

text: The sad truth is that happy sounds are infectious. Now comes research that at least partly explains why. It was published this week in the journal of Neuroscience. A British research team played various sounds including laughter to people who are having their brains scanned by a functional MRI machine. All the sounds activated the premotor cortical region of the brain, an area preparing facial muscles to move.
translations: The sad truth is that happy sounds are infectious .可悲的事实是 ，快乐的声音具有感染力。
Now comes research that at least partly explains why.现在的研究至少解释了一部分的原因。
It was published this week in the journal of Neuroscience .它于本周发表在《神经科学》 杂志上。
A British research team played various sounds including laughter to people who are having their brains scanned by a functional MRI machine .
一个英国研究小组向正在使用功能性 MRI 机器扫描大脑的人播放各种声音 ，包括笑声。
All the sounds activated the premotor cortical region of the brain , an area preparing facial muscles to move .所有的声音都激活了大脑的运动前皮质区域 ，这是一个负责面部肌肉运动的区域。

text: The scientists say this is the ﬁrst documented instance of nectar that attracts a particular animal assistant being produced outside of a nectary. In fact, the observed nectar bleeding might actually be an early system that evolved to include the nectaries found in other plants today.
translations: The scientists say this is the first documented instance of nectar that attracts a particular animal assistant being produced outside of a nectary.
科学家们说 ，这是第一个记录在案的花蜜实例 ， 它吸引了蜜腺外特别的动物助手。
In fact , the observed nectar bleeding might actually be an early system that evolved to include the nectaries found in other plants today.
事实上 ，观察到的花蜜流血实际上可能是一个早期系统 ， 它进化到包括如今其他植物也有的蜜腺。

text: Surgical site infections are caused by bacteria that get in through incisions made during surgery. They threaten the lives of millions of patients each year and contribute to the spread of antibiotic resistance. In low-and middle-income countries, 11 percent of patients who undergo surgery are infected in the process.
translations: Surgical site infections are caused by bacteria that get in through incisions made during surgery.手术部位感染是由从手术中的切口入侵的细菌引起的。
They threaten the lives of millions of patients each year and contribute to the spread of antibiotic resistance .它们每年威胁着数百万患者的生命 ，并助长了抗生素耐药性的传播。
In low-and middle-income countries , 11 percent of patients who undergo surgery are infected in the process .在低收入和中等收入国家 ， 11 % 接受手术的患者在此过程中被感染。

text: The Roman state was tested almost to destruction by the defeat at Cannae by the Carthaginians led by Hannibal and according to the historian Polybius, it was only what he called the "peculiar virtues "of the Roman constitution that allowed it to survive this crisis.
translations: The Roman state was tested almost to destruction by the defeat at Cannae by the Carthaginians led by
Hannibal and according to the historian Polybius , it was only what he called the " peculiar virtues "of the Roman constitution that allowed it to survive this crisis .
由于汉尼拔领导的迦太基人在坎尼 (Cannae) 的失败 ， 罗马国家几乎面临毁灭的考验 ，根据历史学家波利比乌斯(Polybius) 的说法 ，只有他所谓的罗马宪法的“特殊美德 ”才使其能够在这场危机中幸存下来。

text: Nell and his colleagues took to the Everglades at night, hunting for gators near and far from nests. 'You have to use a spotlight and you see the little demon eyes shining out of the marsh. 'They lassoed the gators, pulled them into the airboat, and took blood samples and body measurements.
translations: Nell and his colleagues took to the Everglades at night , hunting for gators near and far from nests . Nell和他的同事在晚上前往大沼泽地 ，巢穴附近寻找鳄鱼。
'You have to use a spotlight and you see the little demon eyes shining out of the marsh. '你必须使用聚光灯 ，才能看到这些小恶魔的眼睛在沼泽中闪耀。
'They lassoed the gators , pulled them into the airboat , and took blood samples and body measurements . '他们用套索套住鳄鱼 ，把它们拉进汽艇 ，采集血样并进行身体测量。

text: Early in the 19 th century, Wordsworth opposed the coming of the steam train to the Lake District, saying it would destroy its natural character. Meanwhile, Blake denounced the "dark satanic mills "of the Industrial Revolution. The conservation of the natural environment, however, did not become a major theme in politics until quite recently.
translations: Early in the 19 th century, Wordsworth opposed the coming of the steam train to the Lake District , saying it would destroy its natural character.
19世纪初 ，华兹华斯反对蒸汽火车开进湖区 ，称这会破坏湖区的自然风貌。
Meanwhile , Blake denounced the "dark satanic mills "of the Industrial Revolution .与此同时 ，布莱克谴责工业革命的“ 暗黑恶魔工厂 ”。
The conservation of the natural environment , however, did not become a major theme in politics until quite recently.
然而 ，保护自然环境直到近些年才成为政治的主要事项。

text: English colonies emerged along the eastern seaboard for a variety of reasons. People, primarily men, originally migrated to Virginia to ﬁnd gold and silver to make a quick proﬁt. After it became evident that there were no precious metals in the area, men came to Virginia to start cultivating cash crops like tobacco.
translations: English colonies emerged along the eastern seaboard for a variety of reasons .由于各种原因 ，英国殖民地出现在了东海岸。
People , primarily men , originally migrated to Virginia to find gold and silver to make a quick profit.人们 ，主要是男性 ，最初迁移到弗吉尼亚寻找黄金和白银以快速获利。
After it became evident that there were no precious metals in the area , men came to Virginia to start cultivating cash crops like tobacco .
在该地区明显没有贵金属之后 ，人们来到弗吉尼亚开始种植烟草等经济作物。

text: Participating regularly in physical activity has been shown to beneﬁt an individual 's health and wellbeing. Regular physical activity is important in reducing the risk of chronic diseases, such as heart diseases and stroke, obesity, diabetes and some forms of cancer. The National Physical Activity Guidelines for Adults recommend at least 30 minutes of moderate-intensity physical activity, preferably every day of the week, to obtain health beneﬁts.
translations: Participating regularly in physical activity has been shown to benefit an individual 's health and wellbeing.事实证明 ，定期参加体育活动有益于个人的健康和幸福。
Regular physical activity is important in reducing the risk of chronic diseases , such as heart diseases and stroke , obesity, diabetes and some forms of cancer.
定期体育锻炼对于降低慢性疾病的风险来说很重要 ，例如心脏病和中风、肥胖症、糖尿病和某些癌症。
The National Physical Activity Guidelines for Adults recommend at least 30 minutes of moderate-intensity physical activity, preferably every day of the week , to obtain health benefits .
全国成人体育活动指南建议 ，人们最好每周一天进行至少 30 分钟中等强度的体育活动 ， 以获得健康益处。

text: Straddling Asia and Europe across the strait, the old city of Istanbul, Turkey, has embraced diverse cultural inﬂuences. Known for its monumental architecture, Istanbul has become a cherished travel destination.
translations: Straddling Asia and Europe across the strait , the old city of Istanbul , Turkey, has embraced diverse cultural influences .
伊斯坦布尔老城土耳其 ，横跨海峡两岸 ，横跨亚欧大陆 ，受到多元文化的影响。
Known for its monumental architecture , Istanbul has become a cherished travel destination .伊斯坦布尔以其不朽的建筑而闻名 ， 已成为一个宝贵的旅游胜地。

text: Charlie Chaplin and his brother Sydney were placed in an orphanage at a very early age. Becoming a vaudeville performer, he joined Fred Karno 's company in 1906. He made his ﬁlm debut in Making a Living, 1914 and introduced the famous seedy and soft-hearted gentleman-tramp routine, which became his hallmark. Numerous ﬁlms for various studios brought him world fame, all based on his mastery of pathos and slapstick acrobatics.
translations: Charlie Chaplin and his brother Sydney were placed in an orphanage at a very early age .查理卓别林和他的兄弟悉尼在很小的时候就被安置在孤儿院。
Becoming a vaudeville performer, he joined Fred Karno 's company in 1906.成为杂耍表演者后 ，他于 1906 年加入了 Fred Karno 的公司。
He made his film debut in Making a Living , 1914 and introduced the famous seedy and soft-hearted gentleman-tramp routine , which became his hallmark.
他在 1914 年的电影《谋生》 中首次亮相 ，并引入了著名的破烂又心软的绅士流浪汉形象 ，这成为了他的标志。
Numerous films for various studios brought him world fame , all based on his mastery of pathos and slapstick acrobatics .
为各种工作室拍电影让他享誉世界 ，这一切都基于他对悲情和闹剧杂技的掌握。

text: Artiﬁcial neural networks have recently become the state-of-the-art technique for crucial signal processing applications, such as speciﬁc frequencies classiﬁcation, structural health monitoring, diseases detection in power electronics circuitry and motor-fault detection. This is an expected outcome as there are numerous advantages of using adaptive and compact deep counterparts, which particularly it can be eﬃciently trained with a limited dataset of signals, besides requiring data transformation.
translations: Artificial neural networks have recently become the state-of-the-art technique for crucial signal processing applications , such as specific frequencies classification , structural health monitoring , diseases detection in power electronics circuitry and motor-fault detection .
人工神经网络最近已成为关键信号处理应用的先进技术 ，例如特定频率分类、结构健康监测、 电力电子电路中的疾病检测和电机故障检测。
This is an expected outcome as there are numerous advantages of using adaptive and compact deep
counterparts , which particularly it can be efficiently trained with a limited dataset of signals , besides requiring data transformation .
结果不出所料 ， 因为使用自适应和紧凑深度对应物有许多优点 ，尤其是除了需要数据转换外 ， 它可以用有限的信号数据集进行有效训练。

text: Biology is the natural science that studies life and living organisms, including their physical structure, chemical processes, physiological mechanisms and evolution. Certain unifying concepts consolidate it into a single and coherent ﬁeld that recognises genes as the basic unit of heredity, and evolution as the engine that propels the creation and extinction.
translations: Biology is the natural science that studies life and living organisms , including their physical structure , chemical processes , physiological mechanisms and evolution .
生物学是研究生命和生物体的自然科学 ，包括它们的物理结构、化学过程、生理机制和进化。
Certain unifying concepts consolidate it into a single and coherent field that recognises genes as the basic unit of heredity, and evolution as the engine that propels the creation and extinction .
某些统一的概念将其整合为一个单一且连贯的领域 ，将基因视为遗传的基本单位 ，将进化视为推动创造和灭绝的引擎。

text: The legislation which Democrats hope to push through the Senate by the weekend, remains among the largest federal relief packages in modern American history. It would deliver hundreds of billions of dollars for vaccine distribution, hospitals, state and local governments and families struggling to recover from the economic toll of the coronavirus pandemic.
translations: The legislation which Democrats hope to push through the Senate by the weekend , remains among the largest federal relief packages in modern American history.
民主党希望在周末之前在参议院获得通过的这项立法仍然是美国现代历史上最大的联邦救助计划之一。

It would deliver hundreds of billions of dollars for vaccine distribution , hospitals , state and local governments and families struggling to recover from the economic toll of the coronavirus pandemic .
它将为疫苗分发、 医院、州和地方政府以及努力从冠状病毒大流行的经济损失中恢复的家庭提供数千亿美元的资金。

text: The Mars 2020 Perseverance Rover will search for signs of ancient microbial life, which will advance NASA 's quest to explore the past habitability of Mars. The rover has a drill to collect core samples of Martian rock and soil, then store them in sealed tubes for pickup by a future mission that would ferry them back to Earth for detailed analysis. Perseverance will also test technologies to help pave the way for future human exploration of Mars.
translations: The Mars 2020 Perseverance Rover will search for signs of ancient microbial life , which will advance NASA 's quest to explore the past habitability of Mars .
“ 火星2020年毅力漫游者 ”将寻找古代微生物生命的迹象 ，这将推进 NASA 探索过去火星宜居性的探索。
The rover has a drill to collect core samples of Martian rock and soil , then store them in sealed tubes for pickup by a future mission that would ferry them back to Earth for detailed analysis .
火星车有一个钻头来收集火星岩石和土壤的核心样本 ，然后将它们储存在密封管中 ，用作未来的任务——将它们运回地球进行详细分析。
Perseverance will also test technologies to help pave the way for future human exploration of Mars .毅力号还将进行技术测试 ，为人类探索火星开辟道路。

text: Humans need to use energy in order to exist. So it is unsurprising that the way people have been producing energy is largely responsible for current environmental problems. Pollution comes in many forms, but those that are most concerning, because of their impact on health, resulting from the combustion of fuels in power stations and cars.
translations: Humans need to use energy in order to exist.人类需要使用能量才能生存。
So it is unsurprising that the way people have been producing energy is largely responsible for current environmental problems .
因此 ，人们生产能源的方怯主要是造成当前环境问题的原因也就不足为奇了。
Pollution comes in many forms , but those that are most concerning , because of their impact on health , resulting from the combustion of fuels in power stations and cars .
污染有多种形怯 ，但最令人担忧的形怯是发电站和汽车燃料燃烧对健康的影响。

text: These decisions are highly nuanced. Of course we use a lot of data to inform our decisions, but we also rely very heavily on iteration, research, testing, intuition and human empathy. Now, sometimes the designers who work on these products are called "data-driven, "which is a term that totally drives us bonkers. The fact is, it would be irresponsible of us not to rigorously test our designs when so many people are counting on us to get it right.
translations: These decisions are highly nuanced.这些决定非常微妙。
Of course we use a lot of data to inform our decisions , but we also rely very heavily on iteration , research , testing , intuition and human empathy.
当然 ，我们使用大量数据来为我们的决策提供信息 ，但我们也非常依赖迭代、研究、测试、直觉和人类同理心。
Now, sometimes the designers who work on these products are called "data-driven , "which is a term that totally drives us bonkers .
现在 ，有时为这些产品工作的设计师被称为“数据驱动 ” ，这是一个完全让我们发疯的术语。
The fact is , it would be irresponsible of us not to rigorously test our designs when so many people are counting on us to get it right.
事实上 ， 当太多人指望我们把设计做好时 ，我们要是不严格测试设计就是不负责任。

text: Conservation scientists have long tried to map how much of the planet remains undegraded by human activity. Previous estimates using satellite imagery or raw demographic data found anywhere from 20 to 40 percent of the globe was free from obvious human incursions, such as roads, light pollution or the gaping scars of deforestation. But an intact forest canopy can hide an emptied-out ecosystem below.
translations: Conservation scientists have long tried to map how much of the planet remains undegraded by human activity.长期以来 ，保护学家一直试图绘制出地球上人类没有涉足的地图。

Previous estimates using satellite imagery or raw demographic data found anywhere from 20 to 40 percent of the globe was free from obvious human incursions , such as roads , light pollution or the gaping scars of
deforestation .
之前使用卫星图像或原始人口统计数据进行的估计发现 ，在全球 20% 到 40% 的地方都没有明显的人类入侵痕迹 ，例如道路、光污染或森林砍伐留下的巨大疤痕。
But an intact forest canopy can hide an emptied-out ecosystem below.但是一个完整的森林屏障可以隐藏其下面一个空荡荡的生态系统。

text: A total of ﬁve ozone ascents were taken at Bharati station, Indian mission, Antarctica from April to June two thousand and sixteen. As stratospheric temperatures reduced to minus eighty-two point two four degrees on the twentieth June two thousand and sixteen indicating the formation of stratospheric clouds, leading scientists at Bharati station feared that Montreal Accord has not succeeded to control the emission of ozone-depleting gases in the atmosphere.
translations: A total of five ozone ascents were taken at Bharati station , Indian mission , Antarctica from April to June two thousand and sixteen .
2016 年 4 月至 6 月 ，在南极洲印度代表团的巴拉蒂站发生了五次臭氧量上升。

As stratospheric temperatures reduced to minus eighty-two point two four degrees on the twentieth June two thousand and sixteen indicating the formation of stratospheric clouds , leading scientists at Bharati station
feared that Montreal Accord has not succeeded to control the emission of ozone-depleting gases in the atmosphere .
随着平流层温度在 2016 年6 月 20 日 降至负82 .24度 ，表明平流层云的形成 ， 巴拉蒂站的主要科学家担心蒙特利尔协议未能成功控制消耗臭氧层气体在大气中的排放

text: Sleep behaviour is also known as a sleep disorder. People with sleep disorders often talk or walk in their sleep. They are not aware of what they are talking about or where they are going. There aren 't any serious eﬀects on the body in general but it may be connected to mental health. People with childhood trauma, unspeakable problems or depression are the ones with diﬀerent sleep behaviours.
translations: Sleep behaviour is also known as a sleep disorder.睡眠行为也称为睡眠障碍。
People with sleep disorders often talk or walk in their sleep.有睡眠障碍的人经常在睡梦中说话或行走。
They are not aware of what they are talking about or where they are going.他们不知道自己在说什么或要去哪里。
There aren 't any serious effects on the body in general but it may be connected to mental health.一般对身体没有什么严重影响 ，但可能与心理健康有关。
People with childhood trauma , unspeakable problems or depression are the ones with different sleep behaviours .
有童年创伤、难言之隐或抑郁症的人睡眠行为也各不相同。

text: How quickly this occurs depends on the dynamics of fertility, mortality and overseas migration. While a moderate pace of demographic change allows for gradual adjustment of the economy and policies to the changing population demographics, rapid changes are more diﬃcult to manage. As a result, governments and society as a whole may need to take actions to address these issues.
translations: How quickly this occurs depends on the dynamics of fertility, mortality and overseas migration .这种情况发生的速度取决于生育率、死亡率和海外移民的动态。
While a moderate pace of demographic change allows for gradual adjustment of the economy and policies to the changing population demographics , rapid changes are more difficult to manage .
虽然适当的人口变化使得经济和政策逐步调整以适应不断变化的人口结构 ，但变化过快则更难以管理。
As a result , governments and society as a whole may need to take actions to address these issues .因此 ，政府和整个社会可能要采取行动来解决这些问题。

text: Researchers have found a way to convert the aromatic substance vanillin into a redox-active electrolyte material for liquid batteries. The technology is an important step towards ecologically sustainable energy storage.
translations: Researchers have found a way to convert the aromatic substance vanillin into a redox-active electrolyte material for liquid batteries .
研究人员找到了一种方法 ，可以将芳香族香兰素转化为液体电池的氧化还原活性电解质材料。
The technology is an important step towards ecologically sustainable energy storage .该技术是朝着生态可持续的能源存储迈出的重要一步。

text: University of Adelaide researchers have uncovered fundamental new information about the malting characteristics of barley grains. They say their ﬁnding could pave the way to more stable brewing processes or new malts for craft brewers. Published in the Nature publication scientiﬁc reports, the researchers discovered a new link between one of the key enzymes involved in malt production for the brewing and a speciﬁc tissue layer within the barley grain.
translations: University of Adelaide researchers have uncovered fundamental new information about the malting characteristics of barley grains .
阿德莱德大学的研究人员发现了有关大麦谷物麦芽特性的基本新信息。
They say their finding could pave the way to more stable brewing processes or new malts for craft brewers .他们声称自己的发现可以为精酿酒商或新种麦芽铺平一条更稳定的酿造之路。
Published in the Nature publication scientific reports , the researchers discovered a new link between one of
the key enzymes involved in malt production for the brewing and a specific tissue layer within the barley grain .研究发表在《自然》 刊物上的科学报告中 ，研究人员发现了酿酒用麦芽生产中的一种关键酶与大麦粒内的一种特殊组织层之间的新联系。

text: The slight decline in drug overdose deaths in 2018 coincides with Chinese regulations on the powerful opioid carfentanil, rather than the result of domestic U. S. eﬀorts to curb the epidemic, a new analysis reveals. What many, including President Donald Trump, perceived as a decline in overdose deaths in 2018, appears to be a return to the historic exponential curve.
translations: The slight decline in drug overdose deaths in 2018 coincides with Chinese regulations on the powerful opioid carfentanil , rather than the result of domestic U. S. efforts to curb the epidemic , a new analysis reveals .
一项新的分析显⽰ ，2018年药物过量死亡人数略有下降 ，这与中国对强效阿片类药物卡芬太尼的规定相吻合 ，而不是美国国内努力遏制疫情的结果。
What many, including President Donald Trump , perceived as a decline in overdose deaths in 2018 , appears to be a return to the historic exponential curve .
包括唐纳德·特朗普总统在内的许多人认为 ，2018年用药过量死亡人数有所下降 ，但似乎是回到了历史性的指数曲线。

text: The terms summary and abstract are often used interchangeably resulting in some confusion. This problem arises because there are two distinct types of abstracts, descriptive and informative. The informative abstract is sometimes called summary; the descriptive abstract is usually only two or three sentences in length, hence it is not a summary or very informative.
translations: The terms summary and abstract are often used interchangeably resulting in some confusion .术语summary和abstract经常互换使用 ，从而造成混淆。
This problem arises because there are two distinct types of abstracts , descriptive and informative .出现此问题是因为摘要有两种不同的类型： 描述性的和信息性的。
The informative abstract is sometimes called summary;内容丰富的摘要有时称为summary。
the descriptive abstract is usually only two or three sentences in length , hence it is not a summary or very informative .
描述性摘要的长度通常只有两到三个句子 ， 因此它不是summary ，也不是很有启发性。

text: Deaf children learning a language could certainly pursue the development of listening and spoken language skills if desired, and doing so would carry much less risk knowing the child would have mastery in at least one language. If a child does not succeed in mastering either a spoken language or a sign language, we must then ask how much beneﬁt the child derived from interventions in each language relative to the amount of time and resources dedicated to those interventions.
translations: Deaf children learning a language could certainly pursue the development of listening and spoken language
skills if desired , and doing so would carry much less risk knowing the child would have mastery in at least one language .
如果有需要的话 ，学习语言的聋哑儿童当然可以追求听力和口语技能的发展 ，并且在知晓该儿童至少掌握一种语言的情况下 ，这样做会降低风险。

If a child does not succeed in mastering either a spoken language or a sign language , we must then ask how much benefit the child derived from interventions in each language relative to the amount of time and
resources dedicated to those interventions .
如果孩子未能熟练掌握口语或手语 ，那么我们必须问一问 ，相对于用于这些干预的时间和资源 ，孩子从每种语言的干预中获得了多少收益。

text: The asteroid that slammed into the moon 3.8 billion years ago creating the Imbrium Basin may have had a diameter of at least 150 miles, according to a new estimate. The work helps explain puzzling geological features on the moon 's near side, and has implications for understanding the evolution of the early solar system.
translations: The asteroid that slammed into the moon 3.8 billion years ago creating the Imbrium Basin may have had a diameter of at least 150 miles , according to a new estimate .
38亿年前撞击到月球小行星在80亿年前形成了雨海盆地 ，根据最新估计 ，其直径至少为150英里。
The work helps explain puzzling geological features on the moon 's near side , and has implications for understanding the evolution of the early solar system .
这项工作有助于解释月球近侧令人费解的地质特征 ，并对理解早期太阳系的演变有所帮助。

text: Scientists have recommended actions the government of Madagascar 's recently elected president Andry should take to turn around the precipitous decline of biodiversity and help put Madagascar on a trajectory towards sustainable growth. Madagascar 's protected areas, some of the most important for biodiversity in the world, have suﬀered terribly in recent years from illegal mining, logging, and collection of threatened species for the pet trade.
translations: Scientists have recommended actions the government of Madagascar 's recently elected president Andry should take to turn around the precipitous decline of biodiversity and help put Madagascar on a trajectory towards sustainable growth.
科学家建议马达加斯加最近当选总统安德里 ，扭转生物多样性急剧下降的趋势 ，帮助马达加斯加走上可持续发展的道路。

Madagascar 's protected areas , some of the most important for biodiversity in the world , have suffered terribly in recent years from illegal mining , logging , and collection of threatened species for the pet trade .
马达加斯加的保护区 ，是世界上最具生物多样性保护区 ，近年来由于非法采矿 ，伐木以及为宠物贸易收集濒危物种等行为而遭受了极大打击。

text: The Royal Institution is an organisation that has been around for 209 years. Many of the people that have worked here have been scientists themselves, including Michael Faraday. He made the discoveries that may be generating using electricity much easier, making it possible for us all to switch on lights, cook for dinner, play games consoles much more.
translations: The Royal Institution is an organisation that has been around for 209 years .皇家学会已有209年的历史了。
Many of the people that have worked here have been scientists themselves , including Michael Faraday.在这里工作的许多人本身就是科学家 ，包括迈克尔·法拉第。
He made the discoveries that may be generating using electricity much easier, making it possible for us all to switch on lights , cook for dinner, play games consoles much more .
他使产生可用电的方怯变得容易得多 ，这使我们所有人都有能打开电灯 ，做饭做饭 ，玩游戏机。

text: A thesis is a claim that you can argue for or against. It should be something that you can present persuasively and clearly. The scope of your paper, so keep in mind that page count. If possible, your thesis should be somewhat original.
translations: A thesis is a claim that you can argue for or against.论文是一种可以支持或反对的主张。
It should be something that you can present persuasively and clearly.你应该能够有说服力地且清晰地去呈现它。
The scope of your paper, so keep in mind that page count.你论文的范围 ， 因此请记住该页数。
If possible , your thesis should be somewhat original.如果可能的话 ，你的论文应该是原创的。

text: Today, telecommunication is widespread and devices that assist the progress are common in many parts of the world. There is also a vast array of networks that connect these devices, including computer, telephone and cable networks. Computer communication across the Internet, such as e-mail and instant messaging, is just one of many examples of telecommunication.
translations: Today, telecommunication is widespread and devices that assist the progress are common in many parts of the world.
如今 ， 电信业已广泛普及 ，推动社会进步的设备在世界许多地方都很普遍。
There is also a vast array of networks that connect these devices , including computer, telephone and cable networks .
还有大量连接这些设备的网络 ，包括计算机 ， 电话和电网。
Computer communication across the Internet , such as e-mail and instant messaging , is just one of many examples of telecommunication .
跨网络的计算机通信 （ 例如电子邮件和即时消息传输） 只是许多电信⽰例之一。

text: There is a tendency, especially in the popular press to concentrate on the negative eﬀects of immigration. In that context, this lecture listing the beneﬁts it brings to more developed nations is much more welcome. Also, it is delivered in a lively and amusing style.
translations: There is a tendency, especially in the popular press to concentrate on the negative effects of immigration .有一种趋势 ，尤其是在大众媒体中 ，集中于移民的负面影响。
In that context , this lecture listing the benefits it brings to more developed nations is much more welcome .在这种情况下 ，这次讲座列出了它给更多发达国家带来的好处 ，这是非常受欢迎的。
Also , it is delivered in a lively and amusing style .而且 ， 它以生动有趣的风格来传递。

text: The fact is that those diﬀerent types of services aﬀect many diﬀerent dimensions of well- being of people. And deﬁning the human well-being is also extremely challenging. However, we identiﬁed that there are certain items providing basic materials for life, whether it be food, shelter or happiness.
translations: The fact is that those different types of services affect many different dimensions of well-being of people .事实是 ，这些不同类型的服务会在许多不同方面影响人们的幸福感。
And defining the human well-being is also extremely challenging.定义人类的幸福也极具挑战性。
However, we identified that there are certain items providing basic materials for life , whether it be food , shelter or happiness .
但是 ，我们确定某些食物为生活提供了基本物质 ，无论它们是食物 ，住所还是幸福。

text: Nature oﬀers no greater splendour than the starry sky on a clear, dark night. Silent and jewelled with the constellations of ancient myth and legend, the night sky has inspired wonder throughout the ages, a wonder that leads our imaginations far from the conﬁnes of Earth and the pace of the present day, and out into the distant reaches of space and cosmic time itself.
translations: Nature offers no greater splendour than the starry sky on a clear, dark night.在晴朗漆黑的夜晚 ，大自然里没有比星空更耀眼的光了。
Silent and jewelled with the constellations of ancient myth and legend , the night sky has inspired wonder
throughout the ages , a wonder that leads our imaginations far from the confines of Earth and the pace of the present day, and out into the distant reaches of space and cosmic time itself.
寂静无声又点缀着古老神话传说的星座的夜空 ，在各个世纪以来一直激发着奇迹 ，这一奇迹使我们的想象力远离地球和当今步伐 ，进入遥远的太空和宇宙时间本身。

text: A young man from a small provincial town, a man without independent wealth, without powerful family connexions and without a university education, moves to London in the 1580 's and becomes a remarkable playwright of all time. How is an achievement of magnitude made? How does Shakespeare become Shakespeare?
translations: A young man from a small provincial town , a man without independent wealth , without powerful family
connexions and without a university education , moves to London in the 1580 's and becomes a remarkable playwright of all time .
一个来自省级小镇的年轻人 ，一个没有独立财富 ，没有强大的家庭关系 ，也没有大学学历的男人 ，在1580年代移居伦敦 ，成为有史以来杰出的剧作家。
How is an achievement of magnitude made?他是如何取得成就的？
How does Shakespeare become Shakespeare?莎士比亚又是如何成为莎翁的呢？

text: We all know about bacteria, viruses and microscopic protozoa. We can watch the way that these tiny agents move into our bodies and damage our organs. We have a growing understanding of how our body mounts defensive strategies that ﬁght oﬀ these invaders, and have built some clever chemical that can help mount an assault on these bio-villains.
translations: We all know about bacteria , viruses and microscopic protozoa .我们都知道细菌 ，病毒和微观原生动物。
We can watch the way that these tiny agents move into our bodies and damage our organs .我们可以观察到这些微小的物质以何种方怯进入我们的身体 ，损害我们的器官。
We have a growing understanding of how our body mounts defensive strategies that fight off these invaders , and have built some clever chemical that can help mount an assault on these bio-villains .
我们越来越了解身体是如何制定防御策略来抵御这些入侵者 ，并已经建立了一些灵敏的化学物质 ，有助于对这些生物性恶性动物发起攻击。

text: There are two main types of market research. Quantitative research involves collecting a lot of information by using techniques such as questionnaires and other forms of survey. Qualitative research involves working with smaller samples of consumers, often asking them to discuss products and services while researchers take notes about what they have to say.
translations: There are two main types of market research.市场研究有两种主要类型。
Quantitative research involves collecting a lot of information by using techniques such as questionnaires and other forms of survey.
定量研究涉及使用问卷和其他形怯的调查技术收集大量信息。
Qualitative research involves working with smaller samples of consumers , often asking them to discuss products and services while researchers take notes about what they have to say.
定性研究涉及与较小的消费者样本合作 ，通常要求他们讨论产品和服务 ，而研究人员则记录他们所说的话。

text: The coronavirus pandemic has shifted many of our interactions online, with Zoom video calls replacing in-person classes, work meetings, conferences and other events. Will all that screen time damage our vision? Maybe not. It turns out that our visual perception is highly adaptable, according to new research.
translations: The coronavirus pandemic has shifted many of our interactions online , with Zoom video calls replacing in- person classes , work meetings , conferences and other events .
冠状病毒大流行已使我们在网上的许多互动发生了变化 ，Zoom视频通话取代了现场授课 ，工作会议和其他活动。
Will all that screen time damage our vision?那些屏幕使用都会损害我们的视力吗？
Maybe not.也许不会。
It turns out that our visual perception is highly adaptable , according to new research.事实上 ，据最新研究显⽰ ，我们的视觉感知具有高度适应性。

text: Researchers have conducted a study that has determined the role that a critical protein plays in the development of hair cells. These hair cells are vital for hearing. Some of these cells amplify sounds that come into the ear, and others transform sound waves into electrical signals that travel to the brain.
translations: Researchers have conducted a study that has determined the role that a critical protein plays in the development of hair cells .
研究人员进行了一项研究 ，确定了一种关键蛋白在毛细胞发育中的作用 。
These hair cells are vital for hearing.这些毛细胞对于听力至关重要。
Some of these cells amplify sounds that come into the ear, and others transform sound waves into electrical signals that travel to the brain .
这些细胞中的一些会放大进入耳朵的声音 ，而其他一些则会将声波转换成电信号 ，并传播到大脑。

text: Women who deliver their ﬁrst child by caesarean section, C-section, are less likely to conceive a second child than those who deliver vaginally, despite being just as likely to plan a subsequent pregnancy, according to researchers. The team followed more than 2, 000 women for three years after they delivered their ﬁrst child.
translations: Women who deliver their first child by caesarean section , C-section , are less likely to conceive a second child than those who deliver vaginally, despite being just as likely to plan a subsequent pregnancy, according to
researchers .
研究人员称 ，通过剖宫产 （ 剖腹产） 分娩第一个孩子的妇女比经阴道分娩的妇女受孕的可能性要低 ，尽管她们有可能计划之后再要孕育一个生命。
The team followed more than 2 , 000 women for three years after they delivered their first child.在分娩第一个孩子后的三年中 ，该团队追踪了超过2 ,000名妇女。

text: Researchers have found that a mutant strain of sake yeast produces high levels of the amino acid ornithine. Ornithine has been found to reduce fatigue and improve sleep quality, and the non-genetically modiﬁed mutant yeast strain discovered in this study could be easily applied to brewing sake, a traditional Japanese alcoholic beverage, as well as wine and beer.
translations: Researchers have found that a mutant strain of sake yeast produces high levels of the amino acid ornithine .研究人员发现 ，清酒酵母的突变菌株可产生高水平的氨基酸鸟氨酸。

Ornithine has been found to reduce fatigue and improve sleep quality, and the non-genetically modified mutant yeast strain discovered in this study could be easily applied to brewing sake , a traditional Japanese alcoholic beverage , as well as wine and beer.
鸟氨酸可减轻疲劳并改善睡眠质量 ，并且该研究中发现的非基因修饰的突变酵母菌株可应用于酿造清酒 ，传统的日本酒精饮料以及葡萄酒和啤酒。

text: A research team has systematically investigated the cognitive abilities of lemurs, which have relatively small brains compared to other primates. Conducting systematic tests with identical methods revealed that cognitive abilities of lemurs hardly diﬀer from those of monkeys and great apes. Instead, this study revealed that the relationship between brain size and cognitive abilities cannot be generalised and it provides new insights into the evolution of primates.
translations: A research team has systematically investigated the cognitive abilities of lemurs , which have relatively small brains compared to other primates .
一个研究小组系统地研究了狐猴的认知能力 ，与其他灵长类动物相比 ， 它们的大脑较小。
Conducting systematic tests with identical methods revealed that cognitive abilities of lemurs hardly differ from those of monkeys and great apes .
用相同的方法进行系统的测试表明 ，狐猴的认知能力与猴子和类人猿几乎没有区别。
Instead , this study revealed that the relationship between brain size and cognitive abilities cannot be generalised and it provides new insights into the evolution of primates .
取而代之的是 ，这项研究揭⽰了大脑大小与认知能力之间的关系无法得到概括 ，并且为灵长类动物的进化提供了新的见解。

text: Modern humans arrived in western Europe forty-one thousand to thirty-eight thousand years ago, about ﬁve thousand years earlier than previously known, according to an international team of researchers that discovered stone tools used by modern humans dated to the earlier time period in a cave near the Atlantic coast of central Portugal. The tools document the presence of modern humans at a time when Neanderthals were thought to be present in the region.
translations: Modern humans arrived in western Europe forty-one thousand to thirty-eight thousand years ago , about five thousand years earlier than previously known , according to an international team of researchers that
discovered stone tools used by modern humans dated to the earlier time period in a cave near the Atlantic coast of central Portugal.
根据一个国际研究人员小组的研究 ，现代人类到达西欧的时间是四万一千至三万八千年前 ， 比以前已知的早了五千年。 研究人员还发现现代人所用的石器可追溯到早期葡萄牙中部大西洋海岸附近的人类的洞穴中。
The tools document the presence of modern humans at a time when Neanderthals were thought to be present in the region .
这些工具记录了现代人类存在于有尼安德特人出现的时代。

text: Scientists studying brain scans of people who were asked to come up with inventive uses for everyday objects found a speciﬁc pattern of connectivity that correlated with the most creative responses. Researchers were then able to use that pattern to predict how creative other people 's responses would be based on their connexions in this network.
translations: Scientists studying brain scans of people who were asked to come up with inventive uses for everyday objects found a specific pattern of connectivity that correlated with the most creative responses .
研究人员要求受试者列出日常物品的激励用途并对他们进行脑部扫描的 ，然后发现 ，这种连接方怯与最有创意的反应有关。
Researchers were then able to use that pattern to predict how creative other people 's responses would be based on their connexions in this network.
然后 ，研究人员能够使用该模怯来预测其他人的反应是如何基于他们在该网络中的联系而具有创造力的。

text: Researchers have designed an artiﬁcial intelligence model that is better able to predict how much students are learning in educational games. The improved model makes use of an AI training concept called multi-task learning, and could be used to improve both instruction and learning outcomes.
translations: Researchers have designed an artificial intelligence model that is better able to predict how much students are learning in educational games .
研究人员设计了一种人工智能模型 ，可以更好地预测教育游戏中有多少学生正在学习。
The improved model makes use of an AI training concept called multi-task learning , and could be used to improve both instruction and learning outcomes .
改进的模型利用了多任务学习的AI培训概念 ，可用于改善教学和学习成果。
