text: Killer cosmic rays from nearby supernovae could be the culprit behind at least one mass extinction event, researchers said, and ﬁnding certain radioactive isotopes in Earth 's rock record could conﬁrm this scenario.
translations: Killer cosmic rays from nearby supernovae could be the culprit behind at least one mass extinction event ,
researchers said , and finding certain radioactive isotopes in Earth 's rock record could confirm this scenario .
研究人员说 ，来自附近超新星的杀手宇宙射线可能至少是一次大规模灭绝事件的罪魁祸首 ，在地球岩石记录中发现的某些放射性同位素可以证实这种情况。

text: Whether ﬂu or coronavirus, it can take several days for the body to ramp up an eﬀective response to a viral infection. New research describes how diﬀerent cells in the immune system work together, communicate, and, in the case of cells called neutrophils, bring about their own death to help ﬁght oﬀ infections. The ﬁndings could have important implications for the development of vaccines and anti-viral therapies.
translations: Whether flu or coronavirus , it can take several days for the body to ramp up an effective response to a viral infection .
无论是流感还是冠状病毒 ，人体可能需要几天的时间才能对病毒感染进行有效响应。
New research describes how different cells in the immune system work together, communicate , and , in the case of cells called neutrophils , bring about their own death to help fight off infections .
一项新的研究描述了免疫系统中的不同细胞如何协同工作 ，相互交流 ，并在名为嗜中性粒细胞的细胞中以自身死亡方怯来抵抗感染。
The findings could have important implications for the development of vaccines and anti-viral therapies .这些发现可能对疫苗和抗病毒疗法的发展具有重要意义。

text: Researchers have developed electronic blood vessels that can be actively tuned to address subtle changes in the body after implantation. The blood vessels, made of a metal, polymer conductor membrane that 's ﬂexible and biodegradable, mimic natural blood vessels, were conducive in vitro experiments, and were able to eﬀectively replace key arteries in rabbits.
translations: Researchers have developed electronic blood vessels that can be actively tuned to address subtle changes in the body after implantation .
研究人员已经研发出可以在植入后主动调节以解决体内细微变化的电子血管。
The blood vessels , made of a metal , polymer conductor membrane that 's flexible and biodegradable , mimic
natural blood vessels , were conducive in vitro experiments , and were able to effectively replace key arteries in rabbits .
血管由金属和聚合物导体膜制成 ，能弯曲且可生物降解 ，能模仿天然血管 ，有助于进行体外实验 ，并且能够有效替代兔子的关键动脉。

text: In twenty sixteen, the world 's largest-ever data leak dubbed "The Panama Papers"exposed a scandal, uncovering a vast global network of people, including celebrities and world leaders, who used oﬀshore tax havens, anonymous transactions through intermediaries and shell corporations to hide their wealth grow their fortunes and avoid taxes.
translations: In twenty sixteen , the world 's largest-ever data leak dubbed "The Panama Papers "exposed a scandal ,
uncovering a vast global network of people , including celebrities and world leaders , who used offshore tax
havens , anonymous transactions through intermediaries and shell corporations to hide their wealth grow their fortunes and avoid taxes .
2016年 ，有史以来最大的数据泄漏事件被称为“ 巴拿马文件 ” ， 它揭露了丑闻 ，揭露了包括各界名人和世界领导人在内的庞大的全球人脉 ，利用金融避税港 ，通过中介和空壳公司的匿名交易来隐藏财产发家致富 ，逃避税务。

text: Thus language acquisition might be like other biological functions. The linguistic clumsiness of tourists and students might be the price we pay for the linguistic genius we displayed as babies, just as the decrepitude of age is the price we pay for the vigour of youth.
translations: Thus language acquisition might be like other biological functions .因此 ，语言习得可能像其他生物学功能一样。

The linguistic clumsiness of tourists and students might be the price we pay for the linguistic genius we displayed as babies , just as the decrepitude of age is the price we pay for the vigour of youth.
游客和学生的语言笨拙可能是我们作为婴儿所展⽰的语言天赋付出的代价 ，就像年龄的下降是我们为年轻人的活力付出的代价一样。

text: Closure activities allow participants to consolidate learning, say goodbye to group mates, and attend to any unﬁnished business prior to the ending of the group experience. Generally, these activities involve some reﬂection upon what has been learned or accomplished during the preceding time together and a sharing of those thoughts or insights with other participants.
translations: Closure activities allow participants to consolidate learning , say goodbye to group mates , and attend to any unfinished business prior to the ending of the group experience .
封闭活动使参与者巩固学习 ，与队友说再见 ，并在小组体验结束之前参加未完成的任务。
Generally, these activities involve some reflection upon what has been learned or accomplished during the preceding time together and a sharing of those thoughts or insights with other participants .
通常 ，这些活动涉及对前一段时间一起学习或完成的事情的一些反思 ，并与其他参与者共享这些想法或见解。

text: This is an extremely useful resource, which ranks books and academic papers on the subject not only in terms of their reliability but also their readability. As a result, it is likely to save students time and eﬀort that would otherwise have been spent working through a lot of dense texts before ﬁnding the one they really need.
translations: This is an extremely useful resource , which ranks books and academic papers on the subject not only in terms of their reliability but also their readability.
这是一个非常有用的资源 ， 它不仅根据其可靠性而且还对可读性将有关该主题的书籍和学术论文进行排名。
As a result , it is likely to save students time and effort that would otherwise have been spent working through a lot of dense texts before finding the one they really need.
结果是 ， 它可以节省学生的时间和精力 ，而学生本来是要花很多时间才找到他们真正需要的文本。

text: This course provides an introduction to the history and development of the British legal system. Its aim is to describe the evolution of the Common Law of England, the legal system of England and to introduce you to the study of constitutions as law, and to the legal aspects of constitutional systems of government.
translations: This course provides an introduction to the history and development of the British legal system .本课程介绍英国法律体系的历史和发展。

Its aim is to describe the evolution of the Common Law of England , the legal system of England and to introduce you to the study of constitutions as law, and to the legal aspects of constitutional systems of government.
它的目的是描述英格兰普通法 ，英格兰法律制度的演变 ，并向你介绍宪法中的法律研究以及政府宪法体系的法律方面。

text: Credit unions are nonproﬁt organisations that were imported to the United States from Germany in the early 1900s. They were regulated in 1934 by the Federal Credit Union Act, which limits membership to groups sharing a common bond of occupation or association. Groups from particular geographical areas also were eligible to join credit unions.
translations: Credit unions are nonprofit organisations that were imported to the United States from Germany in the early 1900s .
信用合作社是1900年代初从德国进口到美国的非营利组织。
They were regulated in 1934 by the Federal Credit Union Act , which limits membership to groups sharing a common bond of occupation or association .
1934年 ，他们受到《联邦信用社法》 的管制 ，该法案将会员资格限制为共同占领或结社的团体。
Groups from particular geographical areas also were eligible to join credit unions .来自特定地理区域的团体也有资格加入信用合作社。

text: Some people are at higher risk of developing obesity because they possess genetic variants that aﬀect how the brain processes sensory information and regulates feeding and behaviour. The ﬁndings support a growing body of evidence that obesity is a disease whose roots are in the brain.
translations: Some people are at higher risk of developing obesity because they possess genetic variants that affect how the brain processes sensory information and regulates feeding and behaviour.
有些人患肥胖症的风险较高 ， 因为他们有一种遗传变您 ，这种变您有影响大脑处理感官信息以及调节进食和行为方怯的作用 。
The findings support a growing body of evidence that obesity is a disease whose roots are in the brain .越来越多的证据表明 ，肥胖症是一种源于大脑的疾病。

text: People who attended religious services at least once a week were signiﬁcantly less likely to die from 'deaths of despair ', including deaths related to suicide, drug overdose, and alcohol poisoning, according to new research.
translations: People who attended religious services at least once a week were significantly less likely to die from 'deaths of despair ' , including deaths related to suicide , drug overdose , and alcohol poisoning , according to new
research.
根据一项新的研究 ，每周至少参加一次宗教仪怯的人死于“绝望之死 ”的可能性大大降低 ，包括与自杀 ，药物过量和酒精中毒有关的死亡案例。

text: Global water consumption has increased almost fourfold in the past 100 years, and many regions can only meet their water demand thanks to essential contributions from mountain regions. In 30 years, almost a quarter of the world 's lowland population will strongly depend on runoﬀ from the mountains. Only sustainable development can ensure the important function of mountain areas as Earth 's 'water towers'.
translations: Global water consumption has increased almost fourfold in the past 100 years , and many regions can only meet their water demand thanks to essential contributions from mountain regions .
在过去的100年中 ，全球耗水量几乎增长了四倍 ，而且多亏山区的重要贡献 ，许多地区刚好能满足其用水需求。
In 30 years , almost a quarter of the world 's lowland population will strongly depend on runoff from the mountains .
在30年中 ，全球近四分之一的低地人口将强烈依赖高山的径流。
Only sustainable development can ensure the important function of mountain areas as Earth 's 'water towers ' .只有可持续发展才能确保山区作为地球的“水塔 ”发挥重要作用 。

text: Just how stressed are teachers? A recent Gallup poll found teachers are tied with nurses for the most stressful occupation in America today. Unfortunately, that stress can have a trickle- down eﬀect on their students, leading to disruptive behaviour that results in student suspensions.
translations: Just how stressed are teachers?老师的压力有多大？
A recent Gallup poll found teachers are tied with nurses for the most stressful occupation in America today.盖洛普最近进行的一项民意测验发现 ，教师与护士是当今美国压力最大的职业。
Unfortunately, that stress can have a trickle-down effect on their students , leading to disruptive behaviour that results in student suspensions .
不幸的是 ，这种压力会对他们的学生产生涓滴效应 ，导致破坏性行为使学生停学。

text: A new study comprehensively reveals how civil wars impact wildlife in countries aﬀected by conﬂict. Researchers found that the main impacts of civil wars on native mammals are often indirect, ultimately arising from institutional and socio-economic changes, rather than from direct military tactics.
translations: A new study comprehensively reveals how civil wars impact wildlife in countries affected by conflict.一项新的研究全面揭⽰了内战如何在受冲突影响的国家中影响野生动植物。

Researchers found that the main impacts of civil wars on native mammals are often indirect , ultimately arising from institutional and socio-economic changes , rather than from direct military tactics .
研究人员发现 ， 内战对本地哺乳动物的主要影响通常是间接的 ，最终是由于制度和社会经济的变化而不是直接的军事手段而产生的。

text: Orientalists, like many other nineteenth-century thinkers, conceive of humanity either in large collective terms or in abstract generalities. Orientalists are neither interested in nor capable of discussing individuals; instead, artiﬁcial entities predominate. Herds beneath very wide labels every possible variety of human plurality, reducing it in the process to one or two terminal collective abstractions.
translations: Orientalists , like many other nineteenth-century thinkers , conceive of humanity either in large collective terms or in abstract generalities .
像其他许多19世纪的思想家一样 ， 东方主义者也以大集体的名义或抽象的概括性来构想人类。
Orientalists are neither interested in nor capable of discussing individuals;东方主义者既不感兴趣也不讨论个人；
instead , artificial entities predominate .相反 ，人工实体占主导地位。
Herds beneath very wide labels every possible variety of human plurality, reducing it in the process to one or two terminal collective abstractions .
在很宽的范围内标记各种可能的人类多元化 ，从而最终将其减少为一两个集体抽象概念。

text: But on May third, a couple of weeks later, Lincoln issued an executive order calling for 43,000 three-year volunteers for the army, and also increasing the size of the regular army and navy by 40000 men. Both of these actions were in apparent violation of the constitution.
translations: But on May third , a couple of weeks later, Lincoln issued an executive order calling for 43 ,000 three-year volunteers for the army, and also increasing the size of the regular army and navy by 40000 men .
但是在几周后的5月3日 ，林肯发布了一项行政命令 ，要求民洲为军队提供43000名为期三年的志愿者 ， 同时还将正规军和海军的规模增加40000名。
Both of these actions were in apparent violation of the constitution .这两项行动显然违反了宪法。

text: If countries can specialise in certain goods they can beneﬁt from economies of scale and lower average costs. This is especially true in the industry with high ﬁxed costs or that requires a high level of investment. The beneﬁts of the economy of scale will ultimately lead to lower prices for consumers and greater eﬃciency for exporting ﬁrms.
translations: If countries can specialise in certain goods they can benefit from economies of scale and lower average costs .如果国家可以专门从事某些商品 ， 它们可以从规模经济和较低的平均成本中受益。
This is especially true in the industry with high fixed costs or that requires a high level of investment.在固定成本高或需要大量投资的行业中尤其如此。
The benefits of the economy of scale will ultimately lead to lower prices for consumers and greater efficiency for exporting firms .
规模经济的好处最终将导致消费者降低价格 ，并提高出口公司的效率。

text: In spite of the spectacularly high quality of life for the vast majority of the people who live in the European Union, its inhabitants seem obsessed with the region 's relative decline in the world. Slow economic growth rates and high unemployment have reinforced the impression that Europe is unhappy with today and unsure of tomorrow.
translations: In spite of the spectacularly high quality of life for the vast majority of the people who live in the European Union , its inhabitants seem obsessed with the region 's relative decline in the world.
尽管绝大多数居住在欧盟的人们的生活质量高得惊人 ，但该地区的居民似乎仍对该地区在世界范围内的相对衰落更着迷。
Slow economic growth rates and high unemployment have reinforced the impression that Europe is unhappy with today and unsure of tomorrow.
缓慢的经济增长率和高失业率加剧了人们对欧洲不满今天和不确定明天的印象。

text: The latest scientiﬁc evidence on the nature and strength of the links between diet and chronic diseases is examined and discussed in detail in the following sections of this report. This section gives an overall view of the current situation and trends in chronic diseases at the global level.
translations: The latest scientific evidence on the nature and strength of the links between diet and chronic diseases is examined and discussed in detail in the following sections of this report.
关于饮食与慢性病之间联系的性质和强度的最新科学证据已在本报告的以下各节中进行了详细检查和讨论。
This section gives an overall view of the current situation and trends in chronic diseases at the global level.本节概述了全球范围内慢性病的现状和趋势。

text: The current measure has remained virtually unchanged over the past 30 years. Yet during that time, there have been marked changes in the nation 's economy and society and in public policies that have aﬀected families 'economic well-being, which is not reﬂected in the measure.
translations: The current measure has remained virtually unchanged over the past 30 years .在过去的30年中 ， 当前的措施几乎保持不变。

Yet during that time , there have been marked changes in the nation 's economy and society and in public policies that have affected families 'economic well-being , which is not reflected in the measure .
然而 ，在那个时期 ， 国家的经济和社会以及公共政策发生了明显的变化 ，这些变化影响了家庭的经济福祉 ，但这一措施并未体现这一点。

text: It was found that while many companies express interest in Jacobson 's use case approach, actual scenario usage often falls outside what is described in textbooks and standard methodologies. Users therefore face signiﬁcant scenario management problems not yet addressed adequately in theory or practise, and are demanding solutions to these problems.
translations: It was found that while many companies express interest in Jacobson 's use case approach , actual scenario usage often falls outside what is described in textbooks and standard methodologies .
结果发现 ，尽管许多公司对雅各布森的用例方法颇感兴趣 ，但实际方案的使用通常不在教科书和标准方法所描述的范围之内。
Users therefore face significant scenario management problems not yet addressed adequately in theory or practise , and are demanding solutions to these problems .
因此 ，用户面临着尚未充分解决的理论或实践上重大方案管理问题 ，并且要求解决这些问题。

text: Australia has one of the world 's most important mining industries. It is a major exporter of coal, iron ore, gold and copper and is self-suﬃcient in all minerals bar petroleum. Since the ﬁrst discovery, the coal in 1798, mineral production has risen every year in the decade to 1992 it doubled.
translations: Australia has one of the world 's most important mining industries .澳大利亚拥有世界上最重要的采矿产业。
It is a major exporter of coal , iron ore , gold and copper and is self-sufficient in all minerals bar petroleum .它是煤炭 ，铁矿石 ，黄金和铜的主要出口国 ，并且自给自足 ，所有矿物都不含石油。
Since the first discovery, the coal in 1798 , mineral production has risen every year in the decade to 1992 it doubled.
自从1798年首次发现煤炭以来 ，到1992年的十年中 ，矿产产量每年都在增长 ，到1992年翻了一番。

text: Most succulent plants are found in regions where there is little rainfall, dry air, plenty of sunshine, porous soils and high temperatures during part of the year. These conditions have caused changes in plant structures, which have resulted in greatly increased thickness of stems, leaves and sometimes roots, enabling them to store moisture from the infrequent rains.
translations: Most succulent plants are found in regions where there is little rainfall , dry air, plenty of sunshine , porous soils and high temperatures during part of the year.
在一年中的部分时间里 ，大多数多肉植物分布在降雨少 ， 空气干燥 ， 阳光充足 ，土壤疏松和高温的地区。

These conditions have caused changes in plant structures , which have resulted in greatly increased thickness of stems , leaves and sometimes roots , enabling them to store moisture from the infrequent rains .
这些条件导致植物结构发生变化 ，从而导致茎 ， 叶甚至根部的厚度大大增加 ，从而使它们能够存储少雨中的水分。

text: While far fewer people these days write letters and therefore have less use for stamps, there are still a few categories of stamps which attract collectors. Stamps in common use for an indeﬁnite period-until the price goes up-are called "deﬁnitive "issues, while a more collectible type of stamp is the "commemorative "issue, honouring people, events and anniversaries.
translations: While far fewer people these days write letters and therefore have less use for stamps , there are still a few categories of stamps which attract collectors .
如今写信的人越来越少 ， 因此邮票也很少能用到了 ，但仍有几类邮票吸引着收藏家。

Stamps in common use for an indefinite period-until the price goes up-are called "definitive " issues , while a more collectible type of stamp is the "commemorative " issue , honouring people , events and anniversaries .
无限期通用邮票——直到价格上涨——被称为“确定性 ”邮票 ，而更具纪念意义的邮票是“纪念性 ”邮票 ， 以纪念人物，事件和纪念日 。

text: Before the time of Alexander the Great, the only eastern people who could be compared with the Greeks in the ﬁelds of science and philosophy were from the Indian sub-continent. However, because so little is known about Indian chronology, it is diﬃcult to tell how much of their science was original and how much was the result of Greek inﬂuence.
translations: Before the time of Alexander the Great , the only eastern people who could be compared with the Greeks in the fields of science and philosophy were from the Indian sub-continent.
在亚历山大大帝时代之前 ， 唯一可以在科学和哲学领域与希腊人相提并论的东方人来自印度次大陆。
However, because so little is known about Indian chronology, it is difficult to tell how much of their science was original and how much was the result of Greek influence .
然而 ， 由于对印度年代学知之甚少 ，很难说出他们的科学有多少成分是原始的 ， 以及对希腊产生了多少影响。

text: There are many kinds of ponds, but nearly all are small bodies of shallow, stagnant water in which plants with roots can grow. Water movement is slight and temperatures ﬂuctuate widely. The wealth of plants ensures that during daylight hours oxygen is plentiful. However, at night, when photosynthesis no longer takes place, oxygen supplies can fall very low.
translations: There are many kinds of ponds , but nearly all are small bodies of shallow, stagnant water in which plants with roots can grow.
池塘的种类很多 ，但几乎都是又小浅的死水池 ，这种池子有利于有根植物生长。
Water movement is slight and temperatures fluctuate widely.水的流动很小 ，温度波动很大。
The wealth of plants ensures that during daylight hours oxygen is plentiful.丰富的植物可确保白天的氧气充足。
However, at night , when photosynthesis no longer takes place , oxygen supplies can fall very low.但是 ，到了晚上 ， 当植物不再进行光合作用时 ，氧气供应可能会降到很低。

text: All the works of art shown in this exhibition were purchased on a shoestring budget. The criteria that the curators had to follow were that works must be acquired cheaply, appeal to a broad range of tastes, and ﬁt with unusual environments. Thus, many of our better known modern artists are not represented.
translations: All the works of art shown in this exhibition were purchased on a shoestring budget.这次展览中参展的所有艺术品都是以低价购买的。
The criteria that the curators had to follow were that works must be acquired cheaply, appeal to a broad range of tastes , and fit with unusual environments .
策展人必须遵循的标准是 ，必须廉价地购买作品 ， 吸引大众并适应不寻常的环境。
Thus , many of our better known modern artists are not represented.因此 ，我们许多知名的现代艺术家都没有参加。

text: The Atlantic coast of the peninsula can be thought of as the cold side, and the sea on this coast tends to be clear and cold, with a variety of seaweeds growing along the rocky shoreline. On a hot day, however, this cold water can be very refreshing and is said to be less hospitable to sharks, which prefer warmer waters.
translations: The Atlantic coast of the peninsula can be thought of as the cold side , and the sea on this coast tends to be clear and cold , with a variety of seaweeds growing along the rocky shoreline .
半岛的大西洋海岸是寒冷的一面 ，该海岸上的海域往往晴朗又寒冷 ， 多石海岸线生长着各种海藻。
On a hot day, however, this cold water can be very refreshing and is said to be less hospitable to sharks , which prefer warmer waters .
但是 ，在炎热的天气中 ，这种冷水可能会令人感到清爽 ，但据说对偏爱温暖水域的鲨鱼来说就不那么好客了。

text: For the ﬁrst two or three years after the Second World War, a new title would often sell out within a few months of publication. However, unless public demand for the book was unusually high, they were rarely able to reprint it. With paper stocks strictly rationed, they could not aﬀord to use up precious paper or tie up their limited capital with a reprint.
translations: For the first two or three years after the Second World War, a new title would often sell out within a few months of publication .
在第二次世界大战后的前两三年中 ，新标题通常会在发布后的几个月内销售一空。
However, unless public demand for the book was unusually high , they were rarely able to reprint it.但是 ， 除非公众对此书的需求您常高 ，否则他们很少能够重印该书。
With paper stocks strictly rationed , they could not afford to use up precious paper or tie up their limited capital with a reprint.
由于严格限制纸张库存量 ，他们无力消耗宝贵的纸张或将有限的资本重新印刷。

text: It is important to note that saving is not the same as investment. Saving is about cash, while investment is about the real product. The diﬀerence is important because money, being liquid, can leak out of the economic system-which it does when someone who is putting aside unspent income keeps it under the mattress.
translations: It is important to note that saving is not the same as investment.重要的是要注意 ，储蓄与投资并不相同。
Saving is about cash , while investment is about the real product.储蓄是现金 ，投资是真实的产品。
The difference is important because money, being liquid , can leak out of the economic system-which it does when someone who is putting aside unspent income keeps it under the mattress .
这种差您之所以重要 ，是因为金钱具有流动性 ，可以从经济体系中泄漏出来 ，而当有人将未动用的收入放在一边时，这种情况就会发生。

text: The starting point of Bergson 's theory is the experience of time and motion. Time is the reality we experience most directly, but this doesn 't mean that we can capture this experience mentally. The past is gone and the future is yet to come. The only reality is the present, which is real through our experience.
translations: The starting point of Bergson 's theory is the experience of time and motion .伯格森理论的起点是时间和运动的经验。
Time is the reality we experience most directly, but this doesn 't mean that we can capture this experience mentally.
时间是我们最能直接体验到的现实 ，但这并不意味着我们可以从心理上把握这种体验。
The past is gone and the future is yet to come .过去已经过去 ，未来尚未到来。
The only reality is the present , which is real through our experience .唯一的现实就是当下 ， 以我们的经验来看是真实的。

text: Foam-ﬁlled furniture is very dangerous if it catches ﬁre, and foam quickly produces a high temperature, thick smoke and poisonous gases-including carbon monoxide, Therefore, set levels of ﬁre resistance have been established for new and second-hand upholstered furniture and other similar products.
translations: Foam-filled furniture is very dangerous if it catches fire , and foam quickly produces a high temperature , thick smoke and poisonous gases-including carbon monoxide , Therefore , set levels of fire resistance have been
established for new and second-hand upholstered furniture and other similar products .
泡沫家具如果起火会非常危险 ，泡沫会迅速产生高温 ，浓烟和包括一氧化碳在内的有毒气体 ， 因此 ，我们已为新的和二手软垫家具及其他类似产品设置了一定的耐火水平。

text: Another method governments use to try and inﬂuence the private sector is economic planning. For a long time now, socialist and communist states have used planning as an alternative to the price mechanism, organising production and distributing their resources according to social and strategic needs, rather than based on purely economic considerations.
translations: Another method governments use to try and influence the private sector is economic planning.政府试图影响私营部门的另一种方法是计划经济。
For a long time now, socialist and communist states have used planning as an alternative to the price
mechanism , organising production and distributing their resources according to social and strategic needs , rather than based on purely economic considerations .
长期以来 ，社会主义国家和共产主义国家一直根据社会和战略需要使用计划作为价格机制的替代方法 ，而不是纯粹出于经济考虑来组织生产和分配资源。

text: Most peasants remained self-suﬃcient and sceptical about money-and with good reason: the triumph of capitalism probably made them worse oﬀ . They now had to deal with a centralised imperial state that was collecting tax more eﬃciently, giving more power to landlords, and slowly reducing customary peasant rights to land and produce.
translations: Most peasants remained self-sufficient and sceptical about money-and with good reason: the triumph of capitalism probably made them worse off.
大多数农民仍然经济上自给自足 ，对货币持怀疑态度 ，理由很充分： 资本主义的胜利可能使他们的处境更糟。
They now had to deal with a centralised imperial state that was collecting tax more efficiently, giving more power to landlords , and slowly reducing customary peasant rights to land and produce .
他们现在必须处理一个中央集权的帝国 ，这个国家要更有效地征税 ，赋予地主更多的权力 ，并逐渐减少农民的土地所有权和生产权。

text: The ritual of the state opening of parliament still illustrates the basis of the British constitution. The sovereignty of the Royal Family has passed to the sovereignty of parliament, leaving the monarchy with the trappings of power, while prime ministers are still denied the kind of status that is given to American and French presidents.
translations: The ritual of the state opening of parliament still illustrates the basis of the British constitution .议会国家开幕怯仍说明了英国宪法的基础。

The sovereignty of the Royal Family has passed to the sovereignty of parliament , leaving the monarchy with the trappings of power, while prime ministers are still denied the kind of status that is given to American and French presidents .
王室的主权已经转移到议会的主权 ，使君主制具有权力的束缚 ，而总理仍然被剥夺了美国和法国总统一样的地位。

text: Fractional reserve banking is a banking system in which banks only hold a fraction of the money their customers ' deposit as reserves. This allows them to use the rest of it to make loans and thereby essentially create new money. This gives commercial banks the power to directly aﬀect the money supply.
translations: Fractional reserve banking is a banking system in which banks only hold a fraction of the money their customers ' deposit as reserves .
分数储备银行业务是一种银行系统 ，在这种系统中 ，银行仅将客户存款的一部分作为储备金。
This allows them to use the rest of it to make loans and thereby essentially create new money.这使他们可以使用其余的贷款来借贷 ，从而从本质上创造新的资金。
This gives commercial banks the power to directly affect the money supply.这使商业银行有权直接影响货币供应。

text: New research shows that during the global ﬁnancial crisis, workers who stayed in jobs did not reduce their working hours, despite the claims that cuts in hours have led to job losses. A study found that the life of people who stayed with the same employer remained relatively unchanged.
translations: New research shows that during the global financial crisis , workers who stayed in jobs did not reduce their working hours , despite the claims that cuts in hours have led to job losses .
一项新的研究表明 ，在全球金融危机期间 ，尽管声称减少工作时间会导致失业 ，但留职的工人并没有减少工作时间。
A study found that the life of people who stayed with the same employer remained relatively unchanged.一项研究发现 ，与同一雇主住在一起的人的生活相对没有改变。

text: A constellation is an area in the celestial sphere in which a group of stars forms an imaginary outline or pattern, typically representing an animal, mythological person or creature, or an inanimate object. The origins of the earliest constellations likely go back to prehistory.
translations: A constellation is an area in the celestial sphere in which a group of stars forms an imaginary outline or pattern , typically representing an animal , mythological person or creature , or an inanimate object.
星座是天球中由一群恒星形成虚构轮廓或图案的区域 ，通常代表动物 ，神话人物或生物或无生命的物体。
The origins of the earliest constellations likely go back to prehistory.最早的星座起源可能要追溯到史前时期。

text: Investigators also compared those microbes with those living in 52 other soil samples taken from all around the planet. The park had organisms that also exist in deserts, frozen tundra, forests, rainforests, and prairies. Antarctica was the only area that had microbes that did not overlap with those found in Central Park. Only a small percentage of the park 's microbes were found to be already listed in databases.
translations: Investigators also compared those microbes with those living in 52 other soil samples taken from all around the planet.
研究人员还将这些微生物与生活在地球上其他52个土壤样品中的微生物进行了比较。
The park had organisms that also exist in deserts , frozen tundra , forests , rainforests , and prairies .公园中的生物也存在于沙漠 ，冻原 ，森林 ，雨林和大草原中。
Antarctica was the only area that had microbes that did not overlap with those found in Central Park.南极洲是唯一与中央公园微生物群不重叠的地区。
Only a small percentage of the park 's microbes were found to be already listed in databases .公园中只有一小部分已知微生物已被列入数据库中。

text: Every morning, no matter how late he had been up, my father rose at ﬁve-thirty, went to his study, wrote for a couple of hours, made us all breakfast, read the paper with my mother, and then went back to work for the rest of the morning. Many years passed before I realised that he did this by choice, for a living, and that he was not unemployed or mentally ill.
translations: Every morning , no matter how late he had been up , my father rose at five-thirty, went to his study, wrote for a couple of hours , made us all breakfast , read the paper with my mother, and then went back to work for the rest of the morning.
每天早晨 ，无论父亲起床多晚 ，他都会在五点半起床 ，到书房写几个小时 ，然后给我们做早餐 ，与母亲一起看报纸，然后回去工作度过上午的剩余时间。
Many years passed before I realised that he did this by choice , for a living , and that he was not unemployed or mentally ill.
很多年以后我才意识到 ，他是自愿这么做的 ，是为了谋生 ，他并不是失业了 ，也没有精神问题。

text: A level of competence in chemistry is essential to the professional practise of material conservation. An understanding of scientiﬁc concepts and a basic scientiﬁc vocabulary enables the conservator to understand conservation problems, treatments, materials, and techniques in a systematic and quantiﬁable way, which can be communicated not only to colleagues in the profession but also to those from other disciplines.
translations: A level of competence in chemistry is essential to the professional practise of material conservation .化学能力水平对材料保护的专业实践至关重要。
An understanding of scientific concepts and a basic scientific vocabulary enables the conservator to

understand conservation problems , treatments , materials , and techniques in a systematic and quantifiable way, which can be communicated not only to colleagues in the profession but also to those from other
disciplines .
对科学概念和基本科学词汇的理解使保护者能够以系统和可量化的方怯了解保护问题、治疗方法、材料和技术 ，不仅可以与业内同事沟通 ，也可以与其他学科的同事沟通。

text: The emergence of information technology has created new products, processes and distribution systems. New products include the computer, the Internet and digital TV; new processes include Internet banking, automated inventory control and automated teller machines; and new distribution systems include cable and satellite TV.
translations: The emergence of information technology has created new products , processes and distribution systems .信息技术的出现创造了新产品 ，新工艺和新分销系统。
New products include the computer, the Internet and digital TV;新产品包括计算机 ，互联网和数字电视。
new processes include Internet banking , automated inventory control and automated teller machines;新流程包括互联网银行 ， 自动库存控制和自动柜员机；
and new distribution systems include cable and satellite TV.新的发行系统包括有线电视和卫星电视。

text: To work eﬀectively with the heterogeneous student populations found in our schools, educators have the responsibility of acknowledging the cultural backgrounds of their students and the cultural setting in which the school is located in order to develop eﬀective instructional strategies.
translations: To work effectively with the heterogeneous student populations found in our schools , educators have the
responsibility of acknowledging the cultural backgrounds of their students and the cultural setting in which the school is located in order to develop effective instructional strategies .
为了有效地与我们校中的您类学生群体合作 ，教育者有责任了解其学生的文化背景和学校所处的文化背景 ， 以便制定有效的教学策略。

text: The purpose of the informative speech is to provide interesting, useful, and unique information to your audience. By dedicating yourself to the goals of providing information and appealing to your audience, you can take a positive step toward succeeding in your eﬀorts as an informative speaker.
translations: The purpose of the informative speech is to provide interesting , useful , and unique information to your audience .
演讲内容丰富的目的是为听众提供有趣 ，有用和独特的信息。
By dedicating yourself to the goals of providing information and appealing to your audience , you can take a positive step toward succeeding in your efforts as an informative speaker.
通过致力于提供信息和吸引听众的目标 ，你可以迈出积极的一步 ，为做一个有说服力的演讲者而努力。

text: Thus, a country might possess a sizeable rural population, but have an economic system in which the interests of the voters were predominantly related to their incomes, not to their occupations or location; and in such a country the political system would be unlikely to include an important agrarian party.
translations: Thus , a country might possess a sizeable rural population , but have an economic system in which the interests of the voters were predominantly related to their incomes , not to their occupations or location;
因此 ，一个国家可能拥有大量农村人口 ，但经济体制中 ，选民的利益主要与他们的收入有关 ，而不是与其职业或位置有关；
and in such a country the political system would be unlikely to include an important agrarian party.在这样的国家 ，政治制度不太可能包括重要的农业党。

text: Children as young as 14 months old will spontaneously help others for no reward. But a study of 3-to-5-year-olds found that, although they would spontaneously draw pictures, if they were given a reward for drawing pictures, then later they wouldn 't make any drawings unless a reward was oﬀered.
translations: Children as young as 14 months old will spontaneously help others for no reward.年仅14个月大的孩子就会自发地帮助他人 ，而没有回报。
But a study of 3-to-5-year-olds found that , although they would spontaneously draw pictures , if they were
given a reward for drawing pictures , then later they wouldn 't make any drawings unless a reward was offered.但一项针对3至5岁儿童的研究发现 ，虽然他们会自发画画 ，但如果他们画画得到奖励 ，那么以后除非有奖励 ，否则他们就不会画画。

text: You used to think that being green was a luxury for your company, but climate change has made you realise that you can no longer ignore it. The buzz is about becoming carbon- neutral, but where do you start? Consider your drivers. Do you want to become carbon- neutral for marketing reasons, for ﬁnancial reasons or to help save the planet?
translations: You used to think that being green was a luxury for your company, but climate change has made you realise that you can no longer ignore it.
你曾经认为绿色对公司来说是一种奢侈 ，但是气候变化使你意识到自己不能再忽略它了。
The buzz is about becoming carbon-neutral , but where do you start?人们关于碳中和而喋喋不休 ，那你是什么初衷呢？
Consider your drivers .想想你的司机。
Do you want to become carbon-neutral for marketing reasons , for financial reasons or to help save the planet?你是出于营销原因 ， 出于财务原因还是为了拯救地球而想要实现碳中和？

text: The maximum yield of plants, determined by their genetic potential, is seldom achieved because factors such as insuﬃcient water or nutrients, adverse climate condition, plant diseases, and insect damage will limit growth at some stage. Plants subjected to these biotic and abiotic constraints are said to be stressed.
translations: The maximum yield of plants , determined by their genetic potential , is seldom achieved because factors such as insufficient water or nutrients , adverse climate condition , plant diseases , and insect damage will limit
growth at some stage .
由于诸如水或养分不足 ，不利的气候条件 ，植物和昆虫损害等因素会在某个阶段限制植物生长 ， 因此它们很少能达到由其遗传潜能决定的最大产量。
Plants subjected to these biotic and abiotic constraints are said to be stressed.据说受到这些生物和非生物限制的植物压力很大。

text: Certainly one of the important values of literature is that it nourishes our emotional lives. An eﬀective literary work may seem to speak directly to us especially if we are ripe for it. The inner life that good writers reveal in their characters often gives us glimpses of some portion of ourselves. We can be moved to laugh, cry, tremble, dream, ponder, shriek, or rage with a character by simply turning the page instead of turning our lives upside down.
translations: Certainly one of the important values of literature is that it nourishes our emotional lives .当然 ，文学的重要价值之一是它滋养了我们的情感生活。
An effective literary work may seem to speak directly to us especially if we are ripe for it.一部成功的文学作品似乎可以直接与我们对话 ，尤其是在我们对它烂熟于心时。
The inner life that good writers reveal in their characters often gives us glimpses of some portion of ourselves .优秀作家在其角色中所展现的内心生活常常使我们对自己的某些特点有所了解。
We can be moved to laugh , cry, tremble , dream , ponder, shriek , or rage with a character by simply turning the page instead of turning our lives upside down .
通过简单地翻页而非让我们的人生大起大落 ，我们就可以被一个角色打动 ，或是大笑 ，哭泣 ，颤抖 ，梦想 ，思考 ，尖叫或是愤怒。

text: Australian speak English of course. But for many tourists and even some locals, Australian English has only tenuous links with the mother tongue. Our speech is peppered with words and phrases whose arcane means understood only by the initiate. It is these colourful colloquialisms that Australian slang sets to truly explain.
translations: Australian speak English of course .澳大利亚人当然会说英语。
But for many tourists and even some locals , Australian English has only tenuous links with the mother tongue .但对于许多游客甚至一些当地人来说 ，澳大利亚英语与母语之间的联系很微弱。
Our speech is peppered with words and phrases whose arcane means understood only by the initiate .我们的演讲中充斥着只有母语人士才能理解的晦涩难懂的单词和短语。
It is these colourful colloquialisms that Australian slang sets to truly explain .澳大利亚俚语真正解释的正是这些丰富多彩的俗语。

text: There is no single method of learning that guarantees success. How we learn that depends on many diﬀerent factors. And what works best for you will not necessarily be the same as the approach used for the other students even they study the same course. We are all unique as learners, although some patterns emerge any groups of students.
translations: There is no single method of learning that guarantees success .没有哪一种学习方法可以保证成功。
How we learn that depends on many different factors .我们如何学习取决于许多不同的因素。
And what works best for you will not necessarily be the same as the approach used for the other students even they study the same course .
而且 ， 即使你学习同一门课程 ，最适合你的方法也不一定与其他学生所用的方法相同。
We are all unique as learners , although some patterns emerge any groups of students .尽管某些模怯在任何学生群体中都会有 ，但作为学习者 ，我们都是独一无二的。

text: Have you ever pictured a world without light? Just think how much we rely on man-made light sources in our lives, without engineers, we wouldn 't be able to live the way we do. No street lights, no TV, no computer displays, no house light, engineers design and build all of these things.
translations: Have you ever pictured a world without light?你曾经想象过一个没有光的世界吗？
Just think how much we rely on man-made light sources in our lives , without engineers , we wouldn 't be able to live the way we do .
试想一下 ，在我们的生活中 ，如果没有工程师 ，我们将多大程度上依赖人造光源 ，我们也将无法按照自己的方怯生活。
No street lights , no TV, no computer displays , no house light , engineers design and build all of these things .没有路灯 ，没有电视 ，没有电脑显⽰器 ，没有室内照明灯 ，工程师设计并制造了所有的这些东西。

text: A unique characteristic of online shopping environments is that they allow vendors to create retail interfaces with highly interactive features. One desirable form of interactivity from a consumer perspective is the implementation of sophisticated tools to assist shoppers in their purchase decisions by customising the electronic shopping environment to their individual preferences.
translations: A unique characteristic of online shopping environments is that they allow vendors to create retail interfaces with highly interactive features .
在线购物环境的一个独特的特征是 ， 它们允许供应商创建具有高度交互功能的零售界面。

One desirable form of interactivity from a consumer perspective is the implementation of sophisticated tools to assist shoppers in their purchase decisions by customising the electronic shopping environment to their
individual preferences .
从消费者的角度来看 ，一种理想的交互形怯是实现复杂的工具 ， 以通过根据个人喜好定制电子购物环境的方怯来帮买家做决定。

text: Hybrid engine enables the driver to decide which source of power is appropriate for the travel requirements of a given journey. Major U. S. auto manufacturers are now developing feasible hybrid electric vehicles, and some are exploring fuel-cell technology for their electric cars.
translations: Hybrid engine enables the driver to decide which source of power is appropriate for the travel requirements of a given journey.
混合动力发动机使驾驶员能够决定哪种动力源适合特定旅程的行驶要求。
Major U. S. auto manufacturers are now developing feasible hybrid electric vehicles , and some are exploring fuel-cell technology for their electric cars .
美国主要汽车制造商现在正在开发可行的混合动力电动汽车 ，一些汽车制造商正在为他们的电动汽车探索燃料电池技术。

text: Imagine living all your life as the only family on your street. Then, one morning, you open the front door and discover houses all around you. You see neighbours tending their gardens and children walking to school. Where did all the people come from? What if the answer turned out to be that they had always been there, you just hadn 't seen them?
translations: Imagine living all your life as the only family on your street.想象一下一生中住在一个只有你一户人家的地方。
Then , one morning , you open the front door and discover houses all around you .然后 ，有一天早上 ，你打开前门 ，发现四周维满了房屋。
You see neighbours tending their gardens and children walking to school.你会看到邻居在打理花园 ，孩子们走着去上学。
Where did all the people come from?这些人都是从哪来的？
What if the answer turned out to be that they had always been there , you just hadn 't seen them?如果答案是 ，他们一直住在那 ，你只是没有看到 ，那怎么办？

text: As we progress into the 21st century, communications are becoming faster and faster. Think of millions of diﬀerent media images you are bombarded with every day. It is as important now to be able to read and make sense of these images, as it has been to be able to read ordinary text.
translations: As we progress into the 21st century, communications are becoming faster and faster.随着我们步入了21世纪 ，通信也变得越来越快。
Think of millions of different media images you are bombarded with every day.想想每天轰炸你的数百万不同的媒体图像。
It is as important now to be able to read and make sense of these images , as it has been to be able to read ordinary text.
现在 ，能够读取和理解这些图像与读取普通文本一样重要。

text: Electronic discourse is one form of interactive electronic communication. In this study, we reserve the term for the two-directional texts in which one person using a keyboard writes language that appears on the sender 's monitor and is transmitted to the monitor of a recipient, who responds by keyboard.
translations: Electronic discourse is one form of interactive electronic communication .电子语篇是交互怯电子通信的一种形怯。
In this study, we reserve the term for the two-directional texts in which one person using a keyboard writes
language that appears on the sender 's monitor and is transmitted to the monitor of a recipient , who responds by keyboard.
在本研究中 ，我们保留了双向文本的术语 ，其中一个人使用键盘敲下的话出现在接受者的显⽰器上 ，并被传输到了收件人的显⽰器 ，后者通过键盘予以回应。

text: Beauty contests, whether it 's Miss Universe or Miss Teen International, are demeaning to women and out of sync with the times. Opponents say that they are nothing more than symbols of decline. Since Australians Jennifer Hawkins and Lauryn Eagle were crowned Miss Universe and Miss Teen International respectively, there has been a dramatic increase in interest in beauty pageants in this country.
translations: Beauty contests , whether it 's Miss Universe or Miss Teen International , are demeaning to women and out of sync with the times .
选美比赛 ，无论是环球小姐还是国际青少年小姐 ，都不合时宜地贬低了女性。
Opponents say that they are nothing more than symbols of decline .反对者说 ，他们不过是衰退的象征。

Since Australians Jennifer Hawkins and Lauryn Eagle were crowned Miss Universe and Miss Teen International respectively, there has been a dramatic increase in interest in beauty pageants in this country.
自从澳大利亚人詹妮弗·霍金斯和劳琳·伊格尔分别被加冕为环球小姐和国际青年小姐后 ，该国对选美比赛的兴趣急剧增加。

text: The best comparison is likely a magnetar, a young neutron star with a powerful magnetic ﬁeld, the researchers said. Magnetars also produce bright X-ray ﬂares. While magnetars are thought to be young stars, the two ﬂaring objects in this study reside near elliptical galaxies, which contain older stars. So the objects are likely too old to be magnetars, the researchers said.
translations: The best comparison is likely a magnetar, a young neutron star with a powerful magnetic field , the researchers said.
研究人员说 ，最好的比较可能是磁星 ，一个具有强大磁场的年轻中子星。
Magnetars also produce bright X-ray flares .磁场也会产生明亮的X射线耀斑。
While magnetars are thought to be young stars , the two flaring objects in this study reside near elliptical galaxies , which contain older stars .
虽然磁星被认为是年轻的恒星 ，但这项研究中的两个向外扩张的物体位于椭圆星系附近 ，而椭圆星系包含较旧的恒星。
So the objects are likely too old to be magnetars , the researchers said.研究人员说 ， 因此这些物体可能太老了而无法成为磁星。

text: The preparation of abstract is an intellectual eﬀort requiring general familiarity with the subject. To bring out the salient points of an author 's argument calls for skill and experience. Consequently, a considerable amount of qualiﬁed manpower that could be used to advantage in other ways must be diverted to the task of facilitating access to information.
translations: The preparation of abstract is an intellectual effort requiring general familiarity with the subject.摘要的准备是一项脑力活 ， 需要对本主题有全面的了解。
To bring out the salient points of an author 's argument calls for skill and experience .提出作者论点的要点需要技巧和经验。
Consequently, a considerable amount of qualified manpower that could be used to advantage in other ways must be diverted to the task of facilitating access to information .
因此 ，必须将可用于其他方面的大量优质人才转移到信息获取的任务上。

text: Public demand for education has remained strong, reﬂecting the importance of education as a means of social progress. Aware of the social value of education to the world of the work, the government continues to innovate and update the education system in order to produce a qualiﬁed and competent workforce.
translations: Public demand for education has remained strong , reflecting the importance of education as a means of social progress .
公众对教育的需求仍然强烈 ，反映出作为社会进步手段的教育很重要。
Aware of the social value of education to the world of the work , the government continues to innovate and update the education system in order to produce a qualified and competent workforce .
意识到教育对工作世界的社会价值 ，政府将继续创新和改善教育体系 ， 以培养合格且称职的教育工作者。

text: Although Botswana 's economic outlook remains strong, the devastation that AIDS has caused threatens to destroy the country's future. In 2001, Botswana has the highest rates of HIV infection in the world. With the help of international donors it launched an ambitious national campaign that provided free antiviral drugs to anyone who need them, and by March 2004, Botswana 's infection rate has dropped signiﬁcantly.
translations: Although Botswana 's economic outlook remains strong , the devastation that AIDS has caused threatens to destroy the country 's future .
尽管博茨⽡纳的经济前景仍旧可观 ，但艾滋病造成的破坏却有可能毁掉该国的未来。
In 2001 , Botswana has the highest rates of HIV infection in the world. 2001年 ，博茨⽡纳的艾滋病毒感染率成为世界最高。

With the help of international donors it launched an ambitious national campaign that provided free antiviral drugs to anyone who need them , and by March 2004 , Botswana 's infection rate has dropped significantly.
在国际捐助者的帮助下 ， 国家发起了一项野心勃勃的全国性运动 ， 向需要的人免费提供抗病毒药物。 到2004年3月 ，博茨⽡纳的感染率已大大下降。

text: The training of an actor is an intensive process which requires curiosity, courage and commitment. You will learn how to prepare for rehearsal, how to rehearse and how to use independent and proactive processes that inform you to do the best work possible for both stage and screen.
translations: The training of an actor is an intensive process which requires curiosity, courage and commitment.对演员的培训是一个高压过程 ， 需要好奇心 ，勇气和奉献精神。
You will learn how to prepare for rehearsal , how to rehearse and how to use independent and proactive processes that inform you to do the best work possible for both stage and screen .
你会学到如何为排练做准备 ，如何进行排练以及如何使用独立先见的流程来告知自己如何在台前幕后完成得最好。

text: Globalisation has aﬀected what we eat in ways we are only beginning to understand. Modern food production is no longer related to our biological needs but is in direct conﬂict with them. The relationship between diet and our fertility, our cancer, heart disease and mental illness is becoming clear. Yet much of our food is nutritionally bankrupt.
translations: Globalisation has affected what we eat in ways we are only beginning to understand.全球化以我们才刚刚开始理解的方怯 ，对我们的饮食产生了影响。
Modern food production is no longer related to our biological needs but is in direct conflict with them .现代粮食生产不再与我们的生物需求有关 ，而是有了直接的冲突。
The relationship between diet and our fertility, our cancer, heart disease and mental illness is becoming clear.饮食与我们的生育能力 ，癌症 ，心脏病和精神疾病之间的关系正逐渐清晰。
Yet much of our food is nutritionally bankrupt.然而 ，如今许多食物已经营养欠佳了。

text: Traditional divisions of domestic work are understood to persist because of the strong association of the home with femininity and paid work with masculinity-to challenge who does what in the home is arguably equivalent to challenging what it is to be a woman or a man.
translations: Traditional divisions of domestic work are understood to persist because of the strong association of the home with femininity and paid work with masculinity-to challenge who does what in the home is arguably equivalent to challenging what it is to be a woman or a man .
传统的家务劳动之所以会持续存在 ，是因为家庭与女性特质联系紧密 ，而带薪工作与男性特质强烈结合—挑战谁做家务 ，可以说等同于挑战女人或男人。

text: Perhaps the most measurable beneﬁt of the programme has been the opportunity to me in small groups, something that is diﬃcult to arrange such a desperate organisation. Many oﬃcers would have to work together for thirty years but would not know other 's strengths and weaknesses.
translations: Perhaps the most measurable benefit of the programme has been the opportunity to me in small groups , something that is difficult to arrange such a desperate organisation .
在小团体中该计划最可衡量的好处也许是对我来说是一个机会 ，运营这样一个绝望的组织很难。
Many officers would have to work together for thirty years but would not know other 's strengths and weaknesses .
许多官员努力工作了三十年 ，但还是不了解他人的优缺点。

text: The department determines whether or not the candidate has passed the examination. In cases where an appearance for the ﬁnal public oral examination would constitute a substantial ﬁnancial hardship for the candidate, the director of graduate studies, may recommend to the dean of the Graduate School virtual, video-conferenced examination of the candidate.
translations: The department determines whether or not the candidate has passed the examination .由部门确定候选人是否通过考试。

In cases where an appearance for the final public oral examination would constitute a substantial financial hardship for the candidate , the director of graduate studies , may recommend to the dean of the Graduate School virtual , video-conferenced examination of the candidate .
如果最终公开面试会给候选人带来实质性的经济困难 ，则研究生院院长可向研究生院主任建议对候选人进行虚拟视频面试。

text: Companies will want to be known not just for the ﬁnancial results they generate, but equally for the imprint they leave on society as a whole. First, ensuring that their products contribute positively. Second, operating in a way that approaches a "net-neutral "impact to the natural environment. And third, cherishing their people.
translations: Companies will want to be known not just for the financial results they generate , but equally for the imprint they leave on society as a whole .
公司不仅希望财务业绩上赫赫有名 ，还希望在社会中闻名遐迩。
First , ensuring that their products contribute positively.首先 ，要确保其产品做出了积极的贡献。
Second , operating in a way that approaches a " net-neutral " impact to the natural environment.其次 ， 以对自然环境“ 净中立 ”的方怯进行企业运作。
And third , cherishing their people .
第三 ， 以人为本。

text: When we recycle, used materials are converted into new products, reducing the need to consume natural resources. If used materials are not recycled, new products are made by extracting fresh, raw material from the Earth, through mining and forestry. Recycling helps conserve important raw materials and protects natural habitats for the future.
translations: When we recycle , used materials are converted into new products , reducing the need to consume natural resources .
当我们回收利用时 ，用过的材料会转化为新产品 ，从而减少了对自然资源的消耗。
If used materials are not recycled , new products are made by extracting fresh , raw material from the Earth , through mining and forestry.
如果用过的材料不回收 ，人们就得通过开采和林业从地球上提取新鲜的原材料制造新产品。
Recycling helps conserve important raw materials and protects natural habitats for the future .回收利用有助于保存重要的原材料并保护未来的自然栖息地。

text: Orientalists, like many other nineteenth-century thinkers, conceive of humanity either in large collective terms or in abstract generalities. Orientalists are neither interested in nor capable of discussing individuals; instead, artiﬁcial entities predominate. Similarly, the age-old distinction between "Europe "and "Asia "or "Occident "and "Orient "herds beneath very wide labels every possible variety of human plurality, reducing it in the process to one or two terminal collective realities.
translations: Orientalists , like many other nineteenth-century thinkers , conceive of humanity either in large collective terms or in abstract generalities .
和许多其他19世纪的思想家一样 ， 东方主义者也以大集体的名义或抽象的概括性来构想人性。
Orientalists are neither interested in nor capable of discussing individuals;东方主义者既无意于个体也不予以讨论；
instead , artificial entities predominate .相反 ，人造实体占主导地位。

Similarly, the age-old distinction between " Europe "and "Asia "or "Occident "and "Orient " herds beneath very wide labels every possible variety of human plurality, reducing it in the process to one or two terminal collective
realities .
类似地 ，“ 欧洲 ”与“ 亚洲 ”或“ 西方 ”与“ 东方 ”之间的古老差您 ，各种可能的多元化人性藏匿于泛泛标签下 ，最终将其加工成一两个集体事实。

text: The next wave of leaders in industrial manufacturing will build an ecosystem that capitalises on the promise of analytics and connectivity to maximise eﬃciency for themselves and their customers. They will map out their strategies and prioritise measures that will bring the most value to their business, starting now with pilot projects, and building greater strengths in data analytics with cross-functional teams of experts.
translations: The next wave of leaders in industrial manufacturing will build an ecosystem that capitalises on the promise of analytics and connectivity to maximise efficiency for themselves and their customers .
工业制造下一届领导班子将建立一个生态系统 ，该生态系统将利用分析和连接性的承诺使自身和客户的效率最大化。
They will map out their strategies and prioritise measures that will bring the most value to their business ,
starting now with pilot projects , and building greater strengths in data analytics with cross-functional teams of experts .
他们将从现在的试点项目开始 ，制定计划并确定可为企业带来最大价值的措施之间的优先级 ，在跨职能的专家团队中建立更大的数据分析实力。

text: Researchers have found that divorce has diﬀerent kinds of negative impacts on the planet, including higher demand for resources and a lower rate of eﬃciency in the use of household resources. People have been talking about how to protect the environment and combat climate change, but divorce is an overlooked factor that needs to be considered.
translations: Researchers have found that divorce has different kinds of negative impacts on the planet , including higher demand for resources and a lower rate of efficiency in the use of household resources .
研究人员发现 ， 离婚对地球有多种不同的负面影响 ，包括对资源的需求变高和对家庭资源的利用效率变低。
People have been talking about how to protect the environment and combat climate change , but divorce is an overlooked factor that needs to be considered.
人们一直在谈论如何保护环境和应对气候变化 ，但是离婚这一被忽略掉的因素也值得考虑。

text: The elephant is the largest living land mammal. During evolution, its skeleton has greatly altered from the usual mammal, designed for two main reasons. One is to cope with the great weight of huge grinding cheek teeth and elongated tusk teeth, making the skull particularly massive. The other is to support the enormous bulk of such a huge body.
translations: The elephant is the largest living land mammal.大象是现存体型最大的哺乳动物。
During evolution , its skeleton has greatly altered from the usual mammal , designed for two main reasons .在进化过程中 ，大象的骨架与常规哺乳动物相比有了很大的变化 ，主要原因有两个。
One is to cope with the great weight of huge grinding cheek teeth and elongated tusk teeth , making the skull particularly massive .
一个原因是巨大的咀嚼颊齿和细长的象牙 ，使它的头骨特别重。
The other is to support the enormous bulk of such a huge body.另一个原因是为了支撑庞大身躯中的巨大骨架。

text: Business school admissions oﬃcers said the new drive to attract younger students was in part the result of a realisation that they had inadvertently limited their applicant pool by requiring several years ' work experience. Talented students who might otherwise have gone to business school instead opted for a law or policy degree because they were intimidated by the expectation of work experience.
translations: Business school admissions officers said the new drive to attract younger students was in part the result of a realisation that they had inadvertently limited their applicant pool by requiring several years ' work experience .商学院招生工作人员说 ， 吸引年轻学生的新动力一部分原因是由于意识到数年的工作经验这一要求在无意中限制了申请者的数量。
Talented students who might otherwise have gone to business school instead opted for a law or policy degree because they were intimidated by the expectation of work experience .
那些本来可以去商学院学习的优等生却选择了法律或政策学位 ， 因为他们对要求工作经验这一点望而却步。

text: A hazard assessment should be performed for work involving distillations of organic liquids and should thoroughly address issues relating to residual water and possible decomposition of the solvent in question, as well as the physical placement of the distillation apparatus and heating equipment to be employed.
translations: A hazard assessment should be performed for work involving distillations of organic liquids and should

thoroughly address issues relating to residual water and possible decomposition of the solvent in question , as well as the physical placement of the distillation apparatus and heating equipment to be employed.
对于涉及有机液体蒸馏的工作 ，应进行危害评估 ，并应彻底解决残留水和可能分解相关溶剂的问题 ， 以及蒸馏和加热设备的物理位置相关的问题。

text: Shrimp farmers used to hold animals in nursery ponds for 30 to 60 days; now they try to move them into grow-out ponds in less than 30 days. This reduces stress on the animals and dramatically increases survivals in the grow-out ponds. Many farms that abandoned nursery ponds have gone back to them, and the results have been surprisingly positive. They're using the old, uncovered, earthen, nursery ponds.
translations: Shrimp farmers used to hold animals in nursery ponds for 30 to 60 days;虾农过去在池中育苗30至60天；
now they try to move them into grow-out ponds in less than 30 days .现在 ，他们尝试在不到30天的时间内将它们移入成年虾塘。
This reduces stress on the animals and dramatically increases survivals in the grow-out ponds .这减少了虾群的压力 ，并大大增加了成年池塘的存活率。
Many farms that abandoned nursery ponds have gone back to them , and the results have been surprisingly positive .
虾农弄到了许多农场废弃的育苗池 ，结果令人惊讶地令人振奋。
They 're using the old , uncovered , earthen , nursery ponds .他们使用的是旧的 ，未经开采的 ，土制的育虾池。

text: Fence, humanly erected barrier between two divisions of land, used to mark a legal or other boundary, to keep animals or people in or out, and sometimes as an ornament. In newly settled lands, fences are usually made of materials at hand, e. g ., stone, earth, or wood.
translations: Fence , humanly erected barrier between two divisions of land , used to mark a legal or other boundary, to keep animals or people in or out , and sometimes as an ornament.
栅栏 ，一种人为竖在两块土地之间的屏障 ，用于标记法律边界或其他界限 ， 以防止动物或人的进出 ，有时还用作装饰。
In newly settled lands , fences are usually made of materials at hand , e . g . , stone , earth , or wood.在新开垦出来的土地上 ， 围栏通常由野生材料制成。 如石头 ，泥土或木头。

text: Northcote Parkinson, a British writer, formulated Parkinson 's rule: "Work expands to ﬁll the time allotted to it; or, conversely, the amount of work completed is in inverse proportion to the number of people employed. "Simply said: If you have an hour to do a 5-minute job, it will take an hour to do it. A large number of people accomplish less work than a smaller number of people.
translations: Northcote Parkinson , a British writer, formulated Parkinson 's rule: "Work expands to fill the time allotted to it;英国作家诺斯科特·帕金森制定了帕金森法则： “ 工作总是随着花在上面的时间而增加。
or, conversely, the amount of work completed is in inverse proportion to the number of people employed. "或者 ，相反地 ，完成的工作量与受雇人数成反比。
Simply said: If you have an hour to do a 5-minute job , it will take an hour to do it.简而言之： 如果给你一个小时处理一份耗时5分钟的工作 ，那你就会花一个小时完成。
A large number of people accomplish less work than a smaller number of people .人多完成的工作比人少完成的工作少。

text: The quest for a user-friendly copyright regime began a decade ago when the Hong Kong government launched a public consultation on "Copyright Protection in the Digital Environment "in December 2006. Although this consultation initially sought to address Internet-related challenges, such as those caused by peer-to-peer-ﬁle-sharing technology, the reform eﬀort quickly evolved into a more comprehensive digital upgrade of the Hong Kong copyright regime.
translations: The quest for a user-friendly copyright regime began a decade ago when the Hong Kong government launched a public consultation on "Copyright Protection in the Digital Environment " in December 2006.
寻求用户友好的版权制度始于十年前 ， 当时香港政府于2006年12月发起了有关“数字环境中的版权保护 ”的公众咨询。

Although this consultation initially sought to address Internet-related challenges , such as those caused by peer-to-peer-file-sharing technology, the reform effort quickly evolved into a more comprehensive digital
upgrade of the Hong Kong copyright regime .
尽管这次磋商最初试图解决与互联网相关的挑战 ，例如对等文件共享技术所带来的挑战 ，但改革工作很快演变为对香港版权制度的更全面的数字升级。

text: Your body 's composed of trillions of cells; lots of diﬀerent types of cells that make up diﬀerent organs and other parts of your body. Your body is also where 10 times that number of bacteria call 'home sweet home. 'But don 't be afraid-these bacteria do more good than harm to you. And besides, just in case you wanted to strike up a conversation with your tenants, you and your bacteria do have a few things in common.
translations: Your body 's composed of trillions of cells;您的身体由数万亿个细胞组成；
lots of different types of cells that make up different organs and other parts of your body.许多组成不同器官和身体部位的不同类型的细胞。
Your body is also where 10 times that number of bacteria call ' home sweet home . '你身体存在的细菌数量就是“甜蜜之家 ”（ 一款游戏） 的10倍。
But don 't be afraid-these bacteria do more good than harm to you . ”但别害怕——这些细菌对你有益而无害。
And besides , just in case you wanted to strike up a conversation with your tenants , you and your bacteria do have a few things in common .
此外 ，万一假如你想与这些租户对话 ，你们之间确实有一些共同点。

text: "What we found is that the plant is actually damaged by herbivores like most plants are in nature. And in response to that it secretes sugar from the wound edges where the herbivores have damaged the plant. "Tobias Lortzing is a graduate student at Freie University Berlin and one of the study authors.
translations: "What we found is that the plant is actually damaged by herbivores like most plants are in nature .我们发现 ，就像自然界大多数植物一样 ，该植物实际上也被食草动物破坏。
And in response to that it secretes sugar from the wound edges where the herbivores have damaged the plant. "
作为响应 ， 它在被食草动物损害的伤口边缘分泌出糖分。
Tobias Lortzing is a graduate student at Freie University Berlin and one of the study authors . “ Tobias Lortzing是柏林弗雷大学的研究生 ，也是该研究的作者之一。

text: Kinderman says he thinks the compound could be a win-win for the planet-and the animals. "You know the methane is kind of a waste product. And this energy, instead of losing it for the animal, it can be reused for the animal in terms of performance, and at the same time we are doing something for greenhouse gas emission and climate change ". The product 's not on the market yet-toxicology tests are ongoing.
translations: Kinderman says he thinks the compound could be a win-win for the planet-and the animals .金德曼说 ，他认为该化合物对地球和动物来说可能是双赢的。
"You know the methane is kind of a waste product. “你知道甲烷是一种废气。

And this energy, instead of losing it for the animal , it can be reused for the animal in terms of performance , and at the same time we are doing something for greenhouse gas emission and climate change " .
这种能量不仅不会为动物造成损失 ，反而在性能方面可以被动物重新利用 ，与此同时 ，我们正在为温室气体排放和气候变化做些事情。 ”
The product 's not on the market yet-toxicology tests are ongoing.该目前产品尚未投放市场 ，正在进行毒理学测试。

text: They controlled for the birds 'age, sex, body size and species. And they found that the hunted specimen 's brains were actually ﬁve percent smaller, on average, than the brains of birds that died by other means. "The surprising thing is that, if you make a similar kind of analysis of liver or heart size, there is absolutely no diﬀerence there. So this is speciﬁc to the brain. "
translations: They controlled for the birds 'age , sex , body size and species .他们控制了鸟类的年龄 ，性别 ，体型和种类。
And they found that the hunted specimen 's brains were actually five percent smaller, on average , than the brains of birds that died by other means .
他们发现 ，所猎标本的大脑实际上平均比通过其他方法死亡的鸟类小百分之五。
"The surprising thing is that , if you make a similar kind of analysis of liver or heart size , there is absolutely no difference there .
“令人惊讶的是 ，如果您对肝脏或心脏大小进行类似的分析 ，会发现根本没有区别。
So this is specific to the brain . "因此 ，这是大脑独有的特质。 ”

text: By this time, however, paleontological momentum had moved to England. In 1812, at Lyme Regis on the Dorset coast, an extraordinary child named Mary Anning, aged eleven, twelve or thirteen, depending on whose account you read, found a strange fossilised sea monster; 17 feet long and now known as the ichthyosaurus, embedded in the steep and dangerous cliﬀs along the English Channel.
translations: By this time , however, paleontological momentum had moved to England.然而 ，到这个时候 ，古生物学的势头已经转移到了英格兰。

In 1812 , at Lyme Regis on the Dorset coast , an extraordinary child named Mary Anning , aged eleven , twelve or thirteen , depending on whose account you read , found a strange fossilised sea monster;
1812年 ，在多塞特郡海岸的莱姆里杰斯市 ，一个名叫玛丽·安宁的不凡之子 ，年龄十一二三岁左右 ，根据所读的书，发现了一个奇怪的化石海怪。
17 feet long and now known as the ichthyosaurus , embedded in the steep and dangerous cliffs along the English Channel.
它长17英尺 ，现在被称为鱼龙 ，嵌在英吉利海峡沿线又陡又险的悬崖上。

text: Clementson wanted to see if claims of question dodging actually held up, historically, not necessarily in the unique case of Trump. So Clementson analysed the transcripts of 14 presidential debates, from 1996 to 2012. Overall, he found 51 accusations of question dodging, 26 by Dems, 25 by Republicans.
translations: Clementson wanted to see if claims of question dodging actually held up , historically, not necessarily in the unique case of Trump.
克莱门特森想了解 ， 回避问题的主张在历史上是否真的得到了遏制 ，但在特朗普这一的特例中并不一定如此。
So Clementson analysed the transcripts of 14 presidential debates , from 1996 to 2012.因此 ，克莱门森分析了1996年至2012年14场总统辩论的笔录。
Overall , he found 51 accusations of question dodging , 26 by Dems , 25 by Republicans .总体而言 ，他发现有51项回避问题的指控 ，其中民主党提出了26项 ，共和党提出了25项。

text: Some people object that in order for the eye to modify and still remain a useful instrument to its owner, many changes would have had to take place simultaneously. However, it is not necessary to suppose this if the modiﬁcations were extremely slight and gradual.
translations: Some people object that in order for the eye to modify and still remain a useful instrument to its owner, many changes would have had to take place simultaneously.
有人反对说为了使眼睛能够自行调节且仍然对它的所有者有用 ，许多改动必须同时进行。
However, it is not necessary to suppose this if the modifications were extremely slight and gradual.但是如果改动非常轻微和迟缓 ，就没必要这样假设。

text: The curriculum enhances the general management programme with health-related courses, Dr. Schulman says. Required courses include healthcare in the 21st century and the economics and strategy of health-sector management. Students may also take electives such as medical device commercialization, healthcare marketing, and the economics and management of the pharmaceutical industry.
translations: The curriculum enhances the general management programme with health-related courses , Dr. Schulman says .舒尔曼博士说 ，该课程设立了与健康相关的课程推进了普通管理项目 。
Required courses include healthcare in the 21st century and the economics and strategy of health-sector management.
必修课程包括21世纪的医疗保健以及卫生部门管理的经济学和战略。
Students may also take electives such as medical device commercialization , healthcare marketing , and the economics and management of the pharmaceutical industry.
学生还可以选修诸如医疗器械商业化 ， 医疗保健营销以及制药行业的经济学和管理等选修课。

text: The English Revolution has been interpreted in several ways by historians: as a ﬁght between the aristocratic Cavaliers, who were open to life, and the serious Puritans; as a battle for power between parliament and the monarchy over the rights of Englishmen that had been going on for centuries; and as a class war similar to the French Revolution, of which it was a forerunner.
translations: The English Revolution has been interpreted in several ways by historians: as a fight between the aristocratic Cavaliers , who were open to life , and the serious Puritans;
历史学家对英国大革命的解释多种多样： 这是开放的贵族骑士与严肃的清教徒之间的斗争；
as a battle for power between parliament and the monarchy over the rights of Englishmen that had been going on for centuries;
作为在议会与君主制之间为争夺英国人民权利而进行的斗争 ，这种斗争已经持续了数百年；
and as a class war similar to the French Revolution , of which it was a forerunner.
它作为先驱 ，有点类似于法国大革命的阶级战争 ，。

text: The term supernova was coined in the 1930s by a memorably odd astrophysicist named Frits Zwicky. Born in Bulgaria and raised in Switzerland, Zwicky came to the California Institute of Technology in the 1920s and there at once distinguished himself by his abrasive personality and erratic talents. He didn 't seem to be outstandingly bright, and many of his colleagues considered him little more than "an irritating buﬀoon ".
translations: The term supernova was coined in the 1930s by a memorably odd astrophysicist named Frits Zwicky.超新星一词是1930年代由一位令人难忘的叫Frits Zwicky的天体物理学家起的。

Born in Bulgaria and raised in Switzerland , Zwicky came to the California Institute of Technology in the 1920s and there at once distinguished himself by his abrasive personality and erratic talents .
Zwicky出生于保加利亚 ，在瑞士长大 ，于1920年来到加州理工学院 ，并因其坚韧品格和卓越才能而一举成名。
He didn 't seem to be outstandingly bright , and many of his colleagues considered him little more than "an irritating buffoon " .
他似乎并不十分聪明 ，许多同事也认为他不过是“遭人嫌的小丑 ”而已。

title_zh: 非物质文化 版本二
text: In comparing material with none-material culture-the ﬁrst being the objects and technologies we create, and the second our customs, beliefs and attitudes-the speaker gives greater emphasis to the material culture. He gives the example of the development of genetic science and the beneﬁts it has brought to mankind, despite a fair amount of opposition.
translations: In comparing material with none-material culture-the first being the objects and technologies we create , and the second our customs , beliefs and attitudes-the speaker gives greater emphasis to the material culture .
在将物质文化与非物质文化进行比较时 （ 首先是我们创造的对象和技术 ，其次是我们的习俗 ，信念和态度） ，演讲者更加强调了物质文化。
He gives the example of the development of genetic science and the benefits it has brought to mankind , despite a fair amount of opposition .
他举例说明了遗传科学的发展尽管遭到了很多反对 ，但却给人类带来了益处。

text: Psychologist Saho Takagi, a graduate student at Kyoto University in Japan, strolls into one of Japan 's many cat cafes. These establishments allow customers to pay an hourly fee for the chance to cuddle some cats. They are popular in Japan because so many apartment buildings forbid pet ownership. But Takagi isn 't a typical customer. She is not there for feline aﬀection, but to probe their minds.
translations: Psychologist Saho Takagi , a graduate student at Kyoto University in Japan , strolls into one of Japan 's many cat cafes .
京都大学的心理学研究生Saho Takagi走进了日本的一家猫咖。
These establishments allow customers to pay an hourly fee for the chance to cuddle some cats .这些场所按小时收费 ，客人可以在这吸猫。
They are popular in Japan because so many apartment buildings forbid pet ownership.这些店在日本很受欢迎 ， 因为许多公寓楼禁养宠物。
But Takagi isn 't a typical customer.但是Takagi可不是一般的客人。
She is not there for feline affection , but to probe their minds .她不是去那做猫奴的 ，而是研究猫咪的思想去了。

text: DeLone and McLean 's model has been criticised by some authors. Indeed, this model is speciﬁc to contexts of voluntary use of information technology. The usage variable remains a success variable of information systems if the user himself decides to adopt or reject the technology. However, for mandatory uses, such as for ERP systems, the use of the technology is obvious. The success of information systems cannot, therefore, be measured by usage.
translations: DeLone and McLean 's model has been criticised by some authors . DeLone和McLean的模型受到一些作者的批评。
Indeed , this model is specific to contexts of voluntary use of information technology.实际上 ，此模型仅限于自愿使用信息技术的情况。
The usage variable remains a success variable of information systems if the user himself decides to adopt or reject the technology.
如果用户本人决定采用或拒绝该技术 ，则使用变量仍是信息系统的成功变量。
However, for mandatory uses , such as for ERP systems , the use of the technology is obvious .但是 ，对于强制性用途 （ 例如用于ERP系统） ，该技术的使用就显而易见了。
The success of information systems cannot , therefore , be measured by usage .因此 ，信息系统的成功无法通过是否使用来衡量。

text: Australians do speak English, however, for some tourists and travellers, it can be diﬃcult to understand the slang. Also, the links between Australian and American English were seen to be very tenuous. At least some colloquialisms in Australian English do not exist in other types of English.
translations: Australians do speak English , however, for some tourists and travellers , it can be difficult to understand the slang.
澳大利亚人确实会说英语 ，但是 ，对于一些游客来说 ，可能很难理解俚语。
Also , the links between Australian and American English were seen to be very tenuous .同样 ，澳怯英语和美怯英语之间的联系也很少。
At least some colloquialisms in Australian English do not exist in other types of English.至少在澳怯英语中 ，有些口语在其他类的英语中并不存在。

text: The provision of accurate and authoritative statistical information strengthens our society. It provides a basis for decisions to be made on public policy, such as determining electoral boundaries and where to locate schools and hospitals. It also allows businesses to know their market, grow their business, and improve their marketing strategies by targeting their activities appropriately.
translations: The provision of accurate and authoritative statistical information strengthens our society.提供准确和权威的统计信息能有助于社会发展。
It provides a basis for decisions to be made on public policy, such as determining electoral boundaries and where to locate schools and hospitals .
它为公共政策的制定提供了基础 ，例如确定选举范围以及在何处建立学校和医院。
It also allows businesses to know their market , grow their business , and improve their marketing strategies by targeting their activities appropriately.
它也使企业能够通过适当地定位自己的活动来了解市场 ，发展业务并改善营销策略。

text: The brain is divided into its 'hemispheres'by a prominent groove. At the base of this lies nerve ﬁbres which enable these two halves of the brain to communicate with each other. But the left hemisphere usually controls movement and sensation in the right side of the body, while the right hemisphere similarly controls the left side of the body.
translations: The brain is divided into its ' hemispheres ' by a prominent groove .大脑通过一个突出的凹槽被分为“ 半球 ”。
At the base of this lies nerve fibres which enable these two halves of the brain to communicate with each other.
这是神经纤维的基础 ，神经纤维使大脑的这两半能相互交流。
But the left hemisphere usually controls movement and sensation in the right side of the body, while the right hemisphere similarly controls the left side of the body.
但是左半球通常控制身体右侧的运动和感觉 ，而同样地 ，右半球控制身体的左侧。

text: Competence in mathematics was another trouble spot. More than half said that their real task school 's graduates are deﬁcient in mathematics, more than 10 percent of respondents said college 's graduates are deﬁcient in the subject, while 70 percent said they are adequate.
translations: Competence in mathematics was another trouble spot.数学能力是另一个难题。

More than half said that their real task school 's graduates are deficient in mathematics , more than 10 percent of respondents said college 's graduates are deficient in the subject , while 70 percent said they are adequate .超过一半的人表⽰他们的实际任务 ， 即学校的毕业生 ，数学能力不足 ，超过10％ 的受访者说大学毕业生缺乏该学科方面的知识 ，而70％ 的人说他们的能力刚刚好。

text: Few things in the world produce such amazement as one 's ﬁrst of glimpse of the Grand Canyon; it took around more than 2 billion years to create this vast wonder, in some places. 17 miles wide, largely through the relentless force of Colorado River, which runs 277 miles along its length, a mile beneath its towering rims.
translations: Few things in the world produce such amazement as one 's first of glimpse of the Grand Canyon;世界上几乎没什么能比第一次看到大峡谷那样令人惊讶了。
it took around more than 2 billion years to create this vast wonder, in some places .在某些地方 ，得花大约20亿年的时间才能创造出这个奇迹。
17 miles wide , largely through the relentless force of Colorado River, which runs 277 miles along its length , a mile beneath its towering rims .
它宽17英里 ，主要通过全长277英里的科罗拉多河迅猛的冲力 ，位于其高耸的轮辋下方一英里处。

text: Along with customary classes on subjects such as ﬁnance, accounting and marketing, today 's MBA students are enrolling on courses for environmental policy and stewardship. Indeed, more than half of business schools require a course in environmental sustainability or corporate social responsibility, according to a survey of 91 US business schools, published in October 2005.
translations: Along with customary classes on subjects such as finance , accounting and marketing , today 's MBA students are enrolling on courses for environmental policy and stewardship.
除了有关金融 ，会计和市场营销等常规课程外 ，如今的工管研究生也正申报环境政策和管理课程。

Indeed , more than half of business schools require a course in environmental sustainability or corporate social responsibility, according to a survey of 91 US business schools , published in October 2005.
实际上 ，根据2005年10月发布的对91所美国商学院的调查显⽰ ，超过一半的商学院需要环境可持续性或企业社会责任课程。

text: Tesla 's theoretical work formed the basis of modern alternating current electric power systems. Thomas Edison promised him almost one million dollars in today's money to undertake motor and generator improvement. However, when Tesla, an ethical Serbs, asked about the money, Edison reported reply"Tesla, you don 't understand our American humour. "The pair becomes arch-rivals.
translations: Tesla 's theoretical work formed the basis of modern alternating current electric power systems .特斯拉的理论工作奠定了现代交流电力系统的基础。
