Thomas Edison promised him almost one million dollars in today 's money to undertake motor and generator improvement.
托马斯·爱迪生向他承诺在今天相当于近一百万美元的资金 ，用于改善电动机和发电机。
However, when Tesla , an ethical Serbs , asked about the money, Edison reported reply "Tesla , you don 't understand our American humour. "
但是 ， 当具备道德的塞族人特斯拉问他要这笔钱时 ，爱迪生回答说： “特斯拉 ，你不懂我们的美怯幽默。
The pair becomes arch-rivals .两人自此成为了劲敌。

text: First-year university students have designed and built a groundbreaking electric car that recharges itself. Fifty students from the University of Sydney 's Faculty of Engineering spent ﬁve months cobbling together bits of plywood, foam and ﬁbreglass to build the ManGo concept car. They developed the speciﬁcations and hand built the car. It 's a pretty radical design: a four-wheel drive with a motor in each wheel.
translations: First-year university students have designed and built a groundbreaking electric car that recharges itself.大一新生已经设计并制造出了具突破性质的自充电怯电动汽车。
Fifty students from the University of Sydney 's Faculty of Engineering spent five months cobbling together bits of plywood , foam and fibreglass to build the ManGo concept car.
来自悉尼大学工程学院的五十名学生花了五个月的时间将几块胶合板 ，泡沫和玻璃纤维拼凑在一起 ，制造出了ManGo概念车。
They developed the specifications and hand built the car.他们制定了规格并动手制作了汽车。
It 's a pretty radical design: a four-wheel drive with a motor in each wheel.这是一种非常重大的设计： 四轮驱动 ，每个车轮都配备一个电机。

text: The physical location of a restaurant in the competitive landscape of the city has long been known as a major factor in its likely success or failure. Once restaurants are established in such environments they can do little about their location. All they can do is work to improve customer access to their premises. Restaurateurs often do this by engaging in battles with local authorities about car parking.
translations: The physical location of a restaurant in the competitive landscape of the city has long been known as a major factor in its likely success or failure .
长期以来 ，餐厅在城市竞争环境中的地理位置一直是其成败的主要因素。
Once restaurants are established in such environments they can do little about their location .在这种环境中成立餐馆 ，他们就无力回天。
All they can do is work to improve customer access to their premises .他们所能做的就是改善客户驶入其经营场所的路况。
Restaurateurs often do this by engaging in battles with local authorities about car parking.饭店老板经常与地方当局就停车问题斗智斗勇。

text: A national study into fraud by bookkeepers employed at small and medium-sized businesses has uncovered 65 instances of theft in more than ﬁve years, with more than 31 million stolen. Of the cases identiﬁed by the research, 56 involved women and nine instances involved men. However, male bookkeepers who defrauded their employer stole three times, on average, the amount that women stole.
translations: A national study into fraud by bookkeepers employed at small and medium-sized businesses has uncovered 65 instances of theft in more than five years , with more than 31 million stolen .
一项全国性的针对中小企业雇用簿记员等欺诈行为的研究发现 ，在五年多的时间内发生了65起盗窃案 ，涉案金额达3100万。
Of the cases identified by the research , 56 involved women and nine instances involved men .在研究的特定案例中 ，有56例涉及女性 ，9例涉及男性。
However, male bookkeepers who defrauded their employer stole three times , on average , the amount that women stole .
但是 ，欺骗雇主的男性簿记员的平均偷窃量是女性的三倍。

text: Hundreds of millions of people eat fast food every day without giving it too much thought. They just unwrap their hamburgers and dig in. An hour or so later, when the burger 's all gone and the wrapper 's been tossed into the garbage, the whole meal has already been forgotten.
translations: Hundreds of millions of people eat fast food every day without giving it too much thought.数亿人每天吃快餐 ，却没有多想。
They just unwrap their hamburgers and dig in .他们只是打开汉堡包开始吃。
An hour or so later, when the burger 's all gone and the wrapper 's been tossed into the garbage , the whole meal has already been forgotten .
大约一个小时后 ， 当汉堡全部消失 ，包装纸也被扔进垃圾桶时 ，整顿饭已经被遗忘了。

text: A marketing plan is a comprehensive document or blueprint that outlines a business advertising and marketing eﬀorts for the coming year. It describes business activities involved in accomplishing speciﬁc marketing objectives within a set time frame. A marketing plan also includes a description of the current marketing position of a business.
translations: A marketing plan is a comprehensive document or blueprint that outlines a business advertising and marketing efforts for the coming year.
营销计划是综合的文档或蓝图 ， 它概述了来年的商业广告和营销等工作。
It describes business activities involved in accomplishing specific marketing objectives within a set time frame .它规定了在设定的时间范围内完成特定营销目标所涉及的业务活动。
A marketing plan also includes a description of the current marketing position of a business .营销计划还包括对企业当前营销状况的描述。

text: Tourism is a challenging sector that divides statistics since businesses serve tourists, also serve local people. Therefore, it is not straightforward to estimate how much business sectors 'revenues and how many jobs are due to tourist expenditures.
translations: Tourism is a challenging sector that divides statistics since businesses serve tourists , also serve local people .旅游业是一个具有挑战性的行业 ， 由于企业为游客服务 ，也为当地人服务 ， 因此统计数据也存在分歧。
Therefore , it is not straightforward to estimate how much business sectors 'revenues and how many jobs are due to tourist expenditures .
因此 ，要估计有多少商业部门的收入和多少工作岗位是由于旅游支出而产生的并不容易。

text: The free market is extremely competitive and companies are constantly trying to gain an edge over their rivals. Merchandising and brand image play a major role in attracting customers, but they often lead to over-packaging. This is a serious problem since most packaging these days are made of plastics which are not biodegradable. Some people blame the manufacturers for their blatant disregard, while others point the ﬁnger at consumers.
translations: The free market is extremely competitive and companies are constantly trying to gain an edge over their rivals .自由市场竞争您常激烈 ，各公司一直在努力超越竞争对手。
Merchandising and brand image play a major role in attracting customers , but they often lead to over- packaging.
商品和品牌形象在吸引客户方面起着主要作用 ，但它们通常会导致过度包装的问题。
This is a serious problem since most packaging these days are made of plastics which are not biodegradable .这是一个严重的问题 ， 因为如今大多数包装都由不可生物降解的塑料制成。
Some people blame the manufacturers for their blatant disregard , while others point the finger at consumers .有些人指责制造商熟视无睹 ，而另一些人则将矛头指向了消费者。

text: This study tracked about one thousand adults in the United States, and they ranged in age from 34 to 93, and they started the study by asking, 'How much stress have you experienced in the last year? They also asked, How much time have you spent helping out friends, neighbours, people in your community? And then they used public records for the next ﬁve years to ﬁnd out who died.
translations: This study tracked about one thousand adults in the United States , and they ranged in age from 34 to 93 , and they started the study by asking , ' How much stress have you experienced in the last year?
这项研究追踪了美国约1000名成年人 ，他们的年龄从34岁到93岁不等 ，他们会被问道： “您去年承受了多少压力？
They also asked , How much time have you spent helping out friends , neighbours , people in your community?他们会被问： 您花了多少时间来帮助您的朋友 ，邻居 ，社区中的人们？
And then they used public records for the next five years to find out who died.然后他们使用未来五年的公共记录来找出谁去世了。

text: It seems that when it comes to love, men and women are designed to misconstrue, misread and misunderstand one another and themselves. You discover that in fact, they make good sense. Being a deluded romantic is often the best way to make a good-biologically successful-choice about a potential partner on the basis.
translations: It seems that when it comes to love , men and women are designed to misconstrue , misread and misunderstand one another and themselves .
似乎谈及爱情时 ，男人和女人天生就会误解彼此 ，也误会自 己。
You discover that in fact , they make good sense .你会发现事实上 ， 它们很有意义。
Being a deluded romantic is often the best way to make a good-biologically successful-choice about a potential partner on the basis .
成为一个受欺骗的浪漫主义者通常是在此基础上对潜在伴侣做出良好的生物学成功选择的最佳方怯。

text: Scientists know little about how exactly it works, especially when it comes to complex functions like memory formation. Research is more advanced in animals, but experiments on humans are hard. Yet, even today, some parts of the brain, like the motor cortex, are better understood. Nor is complete knowledge always needed. Machine learning can recognise patterns of neural activity; the brain itself gets the hang of controlling BCIS with extraordinary ease. And neurotechnology will reveal more of the brain 's secrets.
translations: Scientists know little about how exactly it works , especially when it comes to complex functions like memory formation .
科学家对它到底是如何工作的几乎一无所知 ，尤其是在涉及诸如记忆形成之类的复杂功能时。
Research is more advanced in animals , but experiments on humans are hard.虽然对动物的研究较为先进 ，但是对人类的实验却很困难。
Yet , even today, some parts of the brain , like the motor cortex , are better understood.但是 ， 即使在今天 ，人们也可以更好地理解大脑的某些部分 ，例如运动皮层。
Nor is complete knowledge always needed.也不总是需要完整的知识。
Machine learning can recognise patterns of neural activity;机器学习可以识别神经活动的模怯；
the brain itself gets the hang of controlling BCIS with extraordinary ease .大脑本身可以轻松控制脑机接口 。
And neurotechnology will reveal more of the brain 's secrets .而神经技术将揭⽰更多关于大脑的秘密。

text: This year the National Environmental Science Competition received excellent undergraduate and postgraduate entries from all across the country, with a wide range of projects. We are delighted that our awards are encouraging exciting and valuable projects that go beyond research and analysis to develop solutions for a number of key problems. Information about the shortlisted projects will be posted on our website in the ﬁrst week in June.
translations: This year the National Environmental Science Competition received excellent undergraduate and postgraduate entries from all across the country, with a wide range of projects .
今年的国家环境科学竞赛收到了来自全国各地的优秀本科生和研究生入学申请 ，项目涉及的范围很广泛。
We are delighted that our awards are encouraging exciting and valuable projects that go beyond research and analysis to develop solutions for a number of key problems .
我们很高兴 ，奖项的设立推进了激动人心且有价值的项目 ，这些项目超出了研究和分析范围 ，可以为许多关键问题提供解决方案。
Information about the shortlisted projects will be posted on our website in the first week in June .有关入围项目的信息将在六月的第一周发布在我们的网站上。

text: Scientiﬁc studies show that by age three there is a gap in brain development between kids who are read aloud to and those who are not, and children from low-income families are disproportionately impacted by this gap. Making sure all parents know the importance of reading aloud to their children is critical to closing the achievement gap.
translations: Scientific studies show that by age three there is a gap in brain development between kids who are read aloud to and those who are not , and children from low-income families are disproportionately impacted by this gap.科学研究表明 ，到三岁时 ，大声朗读的孩子和不大声朗读的孩子之间的大脑发育存在差距 ，而来自低收入家庭的孩子受到这种差距的影响更大。
Making sure all parents know the importance of reading aloud to their children is critical to closing the achievement gap.
确保所有父母都知道向孩子大声朗读的重要性 ，对于缩小成绩差距至关重要。

text: The grid-based infrastructure enables large-scale scientiﬁc applications to be run on distributed resources. However, in practise, grid resources are not very easy to use for the end-users who have to learn how to generate security credentials. There is an imminent need to provide transparent access to these resources so that the end-users are shielded from the complicated details.
translations: The grid-based infrastructure enables large-scale scientific applications to be run on distributed resources .基于网格的基础架构使大型科学应用程序可以在分布怯资源上运行。
However, in practise , grid resources are not very easy to use for the end-users who have to learn how to generate security credentials .
但实际上 ， 网格资源对于必须学习如何生成安全凭证的最终用户来说使用起来并不容易。
There is an imminent need to provide transparent access to these resources so that the end-users are shielded from the complicated details .
因此急需提供些能对这些资源的透明访问通道 ， 以使最终用户免受复杂细节的影响。

text: Social media are playing an increasingly important role as information sources for travellers. The goal of this study is to investigate the extent to which social media appear in search engine results in the context of travel-related searches. It also provides evidence for challenges faced by traditional providers of travel-related information.
translations: Social media are playing an increasingly important role as information sources for travellers .作为旅客信息来源的社交媒体正在发挥其日益重要的作用 。
The goal of this study is to investigate the extent to which social media appear in search engine results in the context of travel-related searches .
这项研究的目的是调查在旅行相关搜索的背景下 ，社交媒体出现在搜索引擎结果中的情况。
It also provides evidence for challenges faced by traditional providers of travel-related information .它还给旅游指南的传统商家面临的挑战提供了线索。

text: A mental illness is a health problem that signiﬁcantly aﬀects how a person feels, thinks, behaves, and interacts with other people. People who experience mental illnesses and their family and friends suﬀer a great deal due to these illnesses. According to the World Health Organization, depression will be one of the biggest health problems worldwide by the year 2020.
translations: A mental illness is a health problem that significantly affects how a person feels , thinks , behaves , and interacts with other people .
精神疾病是一种健康问题 ，会严重影响一个人的感受 ，思考 ，行为以及与他人的互动。
People who experience mental illnesses and their family and friends suffer a great deal due to these illnesses .患有精神疾病的患者及其家人和朋友会因此遭受很多痛苦。
According to the World Health Organization , depression will be one of the biggest health problems worldwide by the year 2020.
世界卫生组织的数据表明 ，到2020年 ，抑郁症将成为全球最大的健康问题之一。

text: Before the discovery of Australia, people in the old world were convinced that all swans were white, an unassailable belief as it seemed completely conﬁrmed by empirical evidence. The sighting of the ﬁrst black swan might have been an interesting surprise for a few scientists, but that is not where the signiﬁcance of the story lies.
translations: Before the discovery of Australia , people in the old world were convinced that all swans were white , an unassailable belief as it seemed completely confirmed by empirical evidence .
在发现澳大利亚之前 ， 旧世界的人们已确信所有天鹅都是白色的 ，这是不容置疑的 ， 因为已有证据完全证实了这一点。
The sighting of the first black swan might have been an interesting surprise for a few scientists , but that is not where the significance of the story lies .
对于一些科学家来说 ，发现第一只黑天鹅可能是一个有趣的惊喜 ，但这并不是故事的意义所在。

text: Legal writing is usually less discursive than writing in other humanities subjects, and precision is more important than variety. Sentence structure should not be too complex; it is usually unnecessary to make extensive use of adjectives or adverbs, and consistency of terms is often required.
translations: Legal writing is usually less discursive than writing in other humanities subjects , and precision is more important than variety.
与其他人文学科的写作相比 ，法律写作通常没有那么多话语权 ，且写作的准确性比多样性更重要些。
Sentence structure should not be too complex;句子结构不应太复杂；
it is usually unnecessary to make extensive use of adjectives or adverbs , and consistency of terms is often required.
通常不需要大量使用形容词或副词 ，通常需要保持术语的一致性。

text: For any marketing course that requires the development of a marketing plan, such as Marketing Management, Marketing Strategy and Principles of Marketing, this is the only planning handbook that guides students through step by step creation of a customised marketing plan while oﬀering commercial software to aid in the process.
translations: For any marketing course that requires the development of a marketing plan , such as Marketing Management , Marketing Strategy and Principles of Marketing , this is the only planning handbook that guides students
through step by step creation of a customised marketing plan while offering commercial software to aid in the process .
对于需要制定营销计划的任何营销课程 ，例如“ 营销管理 ” ，“ 营销策略 ”和“ 营销原理 ” ，这是唯一的规划手册 ，可以指导学生逐步创建定制的营销计划 ， 同时提供商业软件的帮助。

text: The semiconductor industry has been able to improve the performance of electric systems for more than four decades by making ever-smaller devices. However, this approach will soon encounter both scientiﬁc and technical limits, which is why the industry is exploring a number of alternative device technologies.
translations: The semiconductor industry has been able to improve the performance of electric systems for more than four decades by making ever-smaller devices .
随着生产出来的设备越来越小 ，半导体行业已经能将电子系统的性能改善至四十年以上了。
However, this approach will soon encounter both scientific and technical limits , which is why the industry is exploring a number of alternative device technologies .
但是 ，这种方法很快就会受到科学和技术上的限制 ，这就是为什么业界正在探索许多替代技术的原因。

text: Two sisters were at a dinner party when the conversation turned to upbringing. The elder sister started to say that her parents had been very strict and that she had been rather frightened of them. Her sister, younger by two years, interrupted in amazement. "What are you talking about? "she said. "Our parents were very lenient. "
translations: Two sisters were at a dinner party when the conversation turned to upbringing.两个姐妹正在一个宴会上谈论教养。
The elder sister started to say that her parents had been very strict and that she had been rather frightened of them .
姐姐就开始说父母很严厉 ，很害怕他们。
Her sister, younger by two years , interrupted in amazement.她妹妹小她两岁 ， 听了很惊讶 ，就打断了她。
"What are you talking about? “你说什么呢？
"she said. “她说。
"Our parents were very lenient. " “我们的父母很慈爱啊。 ”

text: In his landmark account, ﬁrst published over twenty years ago, the author argues that the ignorance and lethargy of the poor are direct results of the whole situation of economic, social and political domination. By being kept in a situation in which critical awareness and response are practically impossible the disadvantaged are kept 'submerged '.
translations: In his landmark account , first published over twenty years ago , the author argues that the ignorance and lethargy of the poor are direct results of the whole situation of economic , social and political domination .
在20年前首次发表的具有里程碑意义的叙述中 ，作者认为 ， 穷人的无知和嗜睡是经济 ，社会和政治统治整个局势所导致的直接结果。
By being kept in a situation in which critical awareness and response are practically impossible the disadvantaged are kept 'submerged ' .
在处于几乎不可能进行批判意识和反应的情况下 ，弱势群体处于被“淹没 ”的状态。

text: In multi-lingual countries, code-mixing, the use of more than one variety in the same utterance or sentence and code-switching, the use of diﬀerent languages or varieties between sentences is common and natural. Despite its frequency, or perhaps because of it, some scholars and self-appointed guardians of linguistic morality, view both code-mixing and code-switching as a sign of linguistic deﬁciency.
translations: In multi-lingual countries , code-mixing , the use of more than one variety in the same utterance or sentence and code-switching , the use of different languages or varieties between sentences is common and natural.
在多语言国家和地区 ，语码混合 ，在同一表达中使用多个语言变体和语码转换 ，在句子之间使用不同语言或语言变体 ，是很自然的一件事。
Despite its frequency, or perhaps because of it , some scholars and self-appointed guardians of linguistic morality, view both code-mixing and code-switching as a sign of linguistic deficiency.
这类情况频繁出现 ，或者也许是因为如此高频 ，一些学者和自命为语言道德的守护者就将语码混合和语码转换视为语言缺陷的标志。

text: The Japanese tea ceremony is a tour inﬂuenced by Buddhism in which green tea is prepared and served to a small group of guests in a peaceful setting. The ceremony can take as long as four hours and there are many traditional gestures that both the server and the guest must perform.
translations: The Japanese tea ceremony is a tour influenced by Buddhism in which green tea is prepared and served to a small group of guests in a peaceful setting.
日本茶道是受佛教影响的仪怯 ，人们备好茶 ，并在宁静的环境中为一群客人奉茶。
The ceremony can take as long as four hours and there are many traditional gestures that both the server and the guest must perform .
仪怯长达四个小时 ，并且服务器者和访客都必须要做许多传统的手势。

text: In Japan, tea ceremony is a ritual-like formalism in which green tea you prepare and serve to multiple guests in a tea full setting. The ceremony can take as long as four hours and there are many tradition gestures that the server and the guests must perform.
translations: In Japan , tea ceremony is a ritual-like formalism in which green tea you prepare and serve to multiple guests in a tea full setting.
在日本 ，茶道是一种宗教怯的形怯主义 ，您可以在这用全套茶具为客人备茶 ，提供服务。
The ceremony can take as long as four hours and there are many tradition gestures that the server and the guests must perform .
仪怯可能长达四个小时 ，且服务者和来宾必须执行许多传统手势。

text: This book is no ordinary book, and should not be read through from beginning to end. It contains many diﬀerent adventures, and the path you take will depend on the choices you make along the way. The success or failure of your mission will hinge on the decisions you make, so think carefully before choosing.
translations: This book is no ordinary book , and should not be read through from beginning to end.这本书不是普通的书 ，不应从头到尾通读一遍。
It contains many different adventures , and the path you take will depend on the choices you make along the way.
它包含许多不同的冒险旅程 ，而您所走的路将取决于您的选择。
The success or failure of your mission will hinge on the decisions you make , so think carefully before choosing.任务的成败取决于您所作的决定 ， 因此在选择前请三思。

text: Long isolated from Western Europe, Russia grew up without participating in the development like the Reformation that many Russians taking pride in their unique culture, ﬁnd dubious value. Russia is, as a result, the most unusual member of European family, if indeed it is European at all. The question is still open to debate, particularly among Russians themselves.
translations: Long isolated from Western Europe , Russia grew up without participating in the development like the Reformation that many Russians taking pride in their unique culture , find dubious value .
俄罗斯与西欧长期处于隔绝状态 ，在没有参与改革的发展过程中成长 ，许多对自己独特文化引以为傲的俄罗斯人发现了猫腻。
Russia is , as a result , the most unusual member of European family, if indeed it is European at all.俄罗斯其实是欧洲大家庭中最不寻常的成员 ， 即使它们确实是欧洲“大家庭 ”。
The question is still open to debate , particularly among Russians themselves .这个问题仍待商讨 ，尤其是在俄罗斯人中。

text: For diplomacy the starting point must be that globalisation requires bridges and removes barriers. A policy of containment is a diﬃcult strategy in the age of the ﬁber-optic cable, the jumbo jet and the satellite dish. There will always be the exception, such as the murderous regime in Iraq where the only safe strategy is to keep it in the isolation ward until it accepts the norms of international behaviour. Or the military dictatorship in Burma which has persistently failed to respond to dialogue. It takes two to critically engage.
translations: For diplomacy the starting point must be that globalisation requires bridges and removes barriers .对于外交而言 ，必须以全球化需要桥梁和消除壁垒作为起点。
A policy of containment is a difficult strategy in the age of the fiber-optic cable , the jumbo jet and the satellite dish.
在光缆 ， 巨型喷气机和卫星天线时代 ， 闭关锁国政策是一条难走的道路。
There will always be the exception , such as the murderous regime in Iraq where the only safe strategy is to keep it in the isolation ward until it accepts the norms of international behaviour.
总是会有例外 ，例如伊拉克的谋杀政权 ， 唯一保险策略是孤立遏制它 ，直到它接受国际行为准则为止。
Or the military dictatorship in Burma which has persistently failed to respond to dialogue .缅甸的军事独裁政权一直未能回应。
It takes two to critically engage .这需要两方平等对话。

text: The uniquely scented ﬂavour of vanilla is second only to chocolate in popularity on the world 's palate. It 's also the second most expensive spice after saﬀron. But highly labor- intensive cultivation methods and the plant 's temperamental life cycle and propagation mean production on a global scale is struggling to keep up with the increasing demand for the product.
translations: The uniquely scented flavour of vanilla is second only to chocolate in popularity on the world 's palate .香草独特的风味世上仅逊色于巧克力。
It 's also the second most expensive spice after saffron .它也是仅次于番红花的第二昂贵的香料。

But highly labor-intensive cultivation methods and the plant 's temperamental life cycle and propagation mean production on a global scale is struggling to keep up with the increasing demand for the product.
但是 ，高密度的耕作方法以及植物的生命周期和繁殖方怯 ，意味着全球量产较难满足产品日益增长的需求。

text: Exhilarating, exhausting and intense, there are just some of the words used to describe doing an MBA, everyone 's experience of doing MBA is, of course, diﬀerent though denying that it 's hard and demanding work whichever course you do. MBA is one of the fastest growing areas of studying in the UK so that must be a sustainable beneﬁt against form in one pain.
translations: Exhilarating , exhausting and intense , there are just some of the words used to describe doing an MBA ,
everyone 's experience of doing MBA is , of course , different though denying that it 's hard and demanding work whichever course you do .
令人振奋 ，疲惫和紧张 ，这里仅用一些词来形容MBA学位 ，每个人的MBA经历当然都是不同的 ，不管他们在否认与否 ， 哪个专业都一样费心费神。
MBA is one of the fastest growing areas of studying in the UK so that must be a sustainable benefit against form in one pain .
MBA是英国学习发展最快的领域之一 ， 因此也一定能背水一战后坐拥其成。

text: Where there are eﬀects, there are often side eﬀects. The car is a boon to mobility, but can lead to obesity, deaths and pollution. Burning fossil fuel may keep economies going, but wrecks the climate in the long run. In a similar way, there are side eﬀects to information technology in education settings-from childcare to the classroom to the lecture hall and beyond.
translations: Where there are effects , there are often side effects .在起作用的时候 ，经常会伴随有副作用 。
The car is a boon to mobility, but can lead to obesity, deaths and pollution .汽车是出行的福音 ，但会导致肥胖 ，死亡和污染问题。

text: Weakness in electronics, auto and gas station sales dragged down overall retail sales last month, but excluding those three categories, retailers enjoyed healthy increases across the board, according to government ﬁgures released Wednesday. Moreover, December sales numbers were also revised higher.
translations: Weakness in electronics , auto and gas station sales dragged down overall retail sales last month , but excluding those three categories , retailers enjoyed healthy increases across the board , according to government figures released Wednesday.
根据政府周三公布的数据 ，上个月电子 ，汽车和加油站销售的疲软拖累了整体零售额 ，但除了这三类 ，零售商整体上呈现健康增长趋势。
Moreover, December sales numbers were also revised higher.此外 ， 12月的销售额也将上升。

text: The founding fathers established constitutional protections for the press because they understood that leaving the watchdog function to partisan politicians wouldn 't necessarily serve the public interest, both sides have too many incentives to preserve the status quo and ignore problems that elude quick ﬁxes.
translations: The founding fathers established constitutional protections for the press because they understood that leaving the watchdog function to partisan politicians wouldn 't necessarily serve the public interest , both sides have
too many incentives to preserve the status quo and ignore problems that elude quick fixes .
开国元勋为新闻界提供了宪法保护 ， 因为他们了解将看门狗职能留给党派政客这一行为并不一定符合公共利益 ，双方都有太多动机来维持现状并忽略速战速决的问题。

text: It isn 't rare for private equity houses to hire grads fresh out of business school, but 9 times out of 10, the students who nab these jobs are the ones who had private equity experience under their belt before even starting their MBA programme.
translations: It isn 't rare for private equity houses to hire grads fresh out of business school , but 9 times out of 10 , the students who nab these jobs are the ones who had private equity experience under their belt before even starting their MBA programme .
私募股权公司聘请商学院刚毕业的学生并不罕见 ，但十分之九抓住此工作的机遇的人 ，甚至在开始读研之前就有私募股权经验了。

text: Surprisingly, despite what appear to be inﬁnite variations, all diﬃcult conversations share a common structure. When you 're caught up in the details and anxiety of a particularly diﬃcult conversation, this structure is hard to see. But understanding that structure is essential to improving how you handle your most challenging conversations.
translations: Surprisingly, despite what appear to be infinite variations , all difficult conversations share a common structure .令人惊讶的是 ，尽管看似是无限的变化 ，但所有困难的对话都具有相同的结构。
When you 're caught up in the details and anxiety of a particularly difficult conversation , this structure is hard to see .
当您陷入特别困难的谈话的细节和焦虑之中时 ，这种结构就很难看清。
But understanding that structure is essential to improving how you handle your most challenging conversations .
但是了解这种结构对于改善如何处理最具挑战性的对话至关重要。

text: Once most animals reach adulthood, they stop growing. In contrast, even plants that are thousands of years old continue to grow new needles, add new wood, and produce cones and new ﬂowers, almost as if parts of their bodies remained "forever young ". The secrets of plant growth are regions of tissue that can produce cells that later develop into specialised tissues.
translations: Once most animals reach adulthood , they stop growing.大多数动物一旦成年 ，就会停止生长。

In contrast , even plants that are thousands of years old continue to grow new needles , add new wood , and produce cones and new flowers , almost as if parts of their bodies remained "forever young " .
相比之下 ，甚至几千年前的植物仍在继续长新叶子和枝干 ，并开花结果 ，好像其身体的一部分几乎“永葆青春 ”。
The secrets of plant growth are regions of tissue that can produce cells that later develop into specialised tissues .
植物生长的秘密是组织区域 ，该区域可以产生细胞 ，然后发育成专门的组织。

text: Solar energy is an excellent source of supplying power to homes and companies, and by utilising solar power you 're not merely protecting the environment from becoming polluted but also you are saving the rest of the earth 's natural resources. Capturing solar energy does not contribute to any pollution and does not harm the atmosphere. One of the factors why many individuals are still hesitant to make use of solar power is because it is expensive. The need of big location of space is another reason why people aren 't taking into consideration solar power.
translations: Solar energy is an excellent source of supplying power to homes and companies , and by utilising solar power you 're not merely protecting the environment from becoming polluted but also you are saving the rest of the earth 's natural resources .
太阳能是向家庭和公司供电的绝佳来源 ，通过利用太阳能 ，您不仅可以保护环境免受污染 ，还可以节省地球上其他的自然资源。
Capturing solar energy does not contribute to any pollution and does not harm the atmosphere .获取太阳能不会造成任何污染 ，也不会损害大气。
One of the factors why many individuals are still hesitant to make use of solar power is because it is expensive .
许多人仍然不愿意使用太阳能 ，其中一个原因是它比较贵。
The need of big location of space is another reason why people aren 't taking into consideration solar power.对空间位置要求高是人们不考虑太阳能的另一个原因。

text: Living room is the most used part that withholds most of the traﬃc coming in and out of the house. It is highly recommended that the ﬂooring should be strong enough that it can endure all such amendments done with your furniture or to the increasing and decreasing ratio of visitors. For this purpose, you can opt for hardwood ﬂooring. Being classy and sophisticated in look, it is the perfect choice for your living room whenever you are remodelling your home.
translations: Living room is the most used part that withholds most of the traffic coming in and out of the house .客厅是最常用的部分 ，可免除大部分来回进出房屋的⿇烦。
It is highly recommended that the flooring should be strong enough that it can endure all such amendments done with your furniture or to the increasing and decreasing ratio of visitors .
强烈建议你把地板铺牢 ，使它可以承受家具的所有刮擦 ，或应对来往的客人。
For this purpose , you can opt for hardwood flooring.为此 ，您可以选择硬木地板。
Being classy and sophisticated in look , it is the perfect choice for your living room whenever you are remodelling your home .
它的外观优雅精致 ，每当您要装修时 ， 它都是您客厅的理想选择。

text: If bonus or "incentive pay "schemes work so well for senior executives and bankers, why does everyone not get them? After all, many jobs involve making important decisions or taking risks. Is there anything about corporate decisions and ﬁnancial risks that makes these categories of work special in terms of how they need to be incentivized and rewarded?
translations: If bonus or " incentive pay "schemes work so well for senior executives and bankers , why does everyone not get them?
如果奖金或“激励性薪酬 ”方案对高管和银行家如此有效 ，为什么都没有人能拿到？
After all , many jobs involve making important decisions or taking risks .毕竟 ，许多工作涉及重要决策或去冒险。
Is there anything about corporate decisions and financial risks that makes these categories of work special in terms of how they need to be incentivized and rewarded?
关于公司决策和财务风险 ，有什么使这些类别的工作在如何受到激励和奖励这方面变得特别的？

text: How quickly is the world 's population growing? In the United States and other developed countries, the current growth rate is very low. In most developing countries, the human population is growing at a rate of 3 people per second. Because of this bustling growth rate, the human population is well on its way to reaching 9 billion within lifetime.
translations: How quickly is the world 's population growing?世界人口增长有多快？
In the United States and other developed countries , the current growth rate is very low.在美国和其他发达国家 ， 当前的增长率非常低。
In most developing countries , the human population is growing at a rate of 3 people per second.在大多数发展中国家 ，人口以每秒3人的速度增长。
Because of this bustling growth rate , the human population is well on its way to reaching 9 billion within lifetime .
由于这一令人不安的增长率 ，人口正逐步达到90亿。

text: This is what needs to happen on climate change: the world needs to put a price on carbon emissions and let the market respond. If politicians pretend this can be done without pain, it will probably result in another ﬁve to ten years of pretending to take action.
translations: This is what needs to happen on climate change: the world needs to put a price on carbon emissions and let the market respond.
这就是应对气候变化应做的事： 世界需要为碳排放定价 ，让市场做出回应。
If politicians pretend this can be done without pain , it will probably result in another five to ten years of pretending to take action .
如果政客们假装能轻松地做到这一点 ，那很可能会导致他们又会继续装模作样五到十年。

text: In classes, your teachers will talk about topics that you are studying. The information that they provide will be important to know when you take tests. You must be able to take good written notes from what your teacher says.
translations: In classes , your teachers will talk about topics that you are studying.在课堂上 ，老师会讨论你正在研究的课题。
The information that they provide will be important to know when you take tests .当你考试时 ，他们提供的信息将非常重要。
You must be able to take good written notes from what your teacher says .你一定要从老师的话中整理好笔记。

text: The diversity of human language may be compared to the diversity of the natural world. Just as the demise of plant species reduces genetic diversity, and deprives humanity or potential medical and biological resources. So extinction of language takes with it a wealth of culture, art and knowledge.
translations: The diversity of human language may be compared to the diversity of the natural world.人类语言的多样性堪比自然界的生物多样性。
Just as the demise of plant species reduces genetic diversity, and deprives humanity or potential medical and biological resources .
就像植物物种的灭绝会减少遗传多样性并剥夺人类潜在的医学和生物资源一样。
So extinction of language takes with it a wealth of culture , art and knowledge .因此 ，语言的灭绝催生了丰富的文化 ，艺术和知识。

text: Major breeding areas, and breeding islands, are shown as dark green areas or darts. Open darts are shown no-breeding records on islands, and are also used for oﬀshore sightings, that is from ships or boats. Other areas where species are not meant to be seen are plain pale green, with pale green hatching where records are usually sparse.
translations: Major breeding areas , and breeding islands , are shown as dark green areas or darts .主要繁殖区域会标⽰为深绿色区或飞镖。
Open darts are shown no-breeding records on islands , and are also used for offshore sightings , that is from ships or boats .
公开的飞镖表⽰在岛上没有繁殖记录 ，也用于从船上离岸观察。
Other areas where species are not meant to be seen are plain pale green , with pale green hatching where records are usually sparse .
其他无望发现物种的区域是浅绿色 ，带有阴影的区域通常物种稀疏。

text: As to the Industrial Revolution, one cannot dispute today the fact that it has succeeded in inaugurating in a number of countries a level of mass prosperity which was undreamt of in the days preceding the Industrial Revolution. But, on the immediate impact of the Industrial Revolution, there were substantial divergences among writers.
translations: As to the Industrial Revolution , one cannot dispute today the fact that it has succeeded in inaugurating in a number of countries a level of mass prosperity which was undreamt of in the days preceding the Industrial Revolution .
今天人们不能质疑工业革命在许多国家成功地开创了大规模繁荣的这一事实 ，这是人们在工业革命前的日子里并没预料到的。
But , on the immediate impact of the Industrial Revolution , there were substantial divergences among writers .但是 ，在工业革命的直接影响下 ，作家之间仍存在很大分歧。

text: The Ford Company provides plenty of opportunities for its employees. It guarantees not only comfortable and appropriate working conditions, but also many other advantages. Therefore, becoming a part of the Ford Motor company is always proﬁtable and beneﬁcial. Moreover, it is important to mention that Ford Motors provides its employees with eﬀective and useful services and takes care of their well-being.
translations: The Ford Company provides plenty of opportunities for its employees .福特公司为员工提供了很多机会。
It guarantees not only comfortable and appropriate working conditions , but also many other advantages .它不仅保证舒适的工作条件 ，而且还保证了许多其他福利。
Therefore , becoming a part of the Ford Motor company is always profitable and beneficial.因此 ，成为福特汽车公司的一员总是有利可图。
Moreover, it is important to mention that Ford Motors provides its employees with effective and useful services and takes care of their well-being.
此外 ，重要的是福特汽车公司为员工提供有效的服务 ，并关爱员工的健康。

text: Such cross-protection is usually seen between two animals. But Gore studies the same sort of mutualism in microbes. He and his team demonstrated the ﬁrst experimental example of that cross-protective relationship in drug-resistant microbes, using two strains of antibiotic- resistant E. coli bacteria: one resistant to ampicillin, the other to chloramphenicol.
translations: Such cross-protection is usually seen between two animals .我们通常在两只动物之间能看到这种交叉保护。
But Gore studies the same sort of mutualism in microbes .但是戈尔研究了微生物中的同一种共生关系。

He and his team demonstrated the first experimental example of that cross-protective relationship in drug- resistant microbes , using two strains of antibiotic-resistant E. coli bacteria: one resistant to ampicillin , the other to chloramphenicol.
他和团队成员使用两种对抗生素具有抗药性的大肠杆菌菌株 ，在第一个实验例子的抗药性微生物中证明了这种交叉保护关系： 一种对氨苄青霉素具有抗性 ，另一种对氯霉素具有抗性。

text: Written examinations are a fact of life for most high school and university students. However, recent studies have shown that this traditional form of assessment may not be an accurate indicator of academic performance. Tests have shown that many students experience anxiety during exam weeks, which leads to poorer results. As a result, some learning institutions are replacing exams with alternative assessments such as group work and oral presentations.
translations: Written examinations are a fact of life for most high school and university students .笔试对于大多数高中生和大学生来说都是常事。
However, recent studies have shown that this traditional form of assessment may not be an accurate indicator of academic performance .
但是 ，最近的研究表明 ，这种传统的评估形怯可能不是衡量学习成绩的准确指标。
Tests have shown that many students experience anxiety during exam weeks , which leads to poorer results .测试表明 ，许多学生在考试周内会感到焦虑 ，就会导致成绩较差。
As a result , some learning institutions are replacing exams with alternative assessments such as group work and oral presentations .
结果 ，一些学习机构正在用替代评估代替考试 ，例如小组作业和口头报告。

text: Researchers gathered 160 uncaﬀeinated adults, people who consumed less than 500 milligrammes of caﬀeine a week. These decaf subjects looked at pictures of various objects, then took either a placebo or a pill containing 200 milligrammes of caﬀeine. That 's roughly the amount you 'd get from two cups of coﬀee.
translations: Researchers gathered 160 uncaffeinated adults , people who consumed less than 500 milligrammes of caffeine a week.
研究人员征集了160名咖啡因摄入量较低的成年人 ，这些人每周咖啡因的摄入量少于500毫克。
These decaf subjects looked at pictures of various objects , then took either a placebo or a pill containing 200 milligrammes of caffeine .
这些无咖啡因的受试者查看了各种物体的照片 ，然后服用安慰剂或含有200毫克咖啡因的药丸。
That 's roughly the amount you 'd get from two cups of coffee .这大约是你从两杯咖啡中获得的咖啡因数量。

text: Such an agreement would include recognition that the world must aim as soon as possible to hold global warming to 1.5-degree Celsius; a long-term low-carbon future; 5-year updated action plans that recognise the developing climate reality; and aid to those countries that did little to cause climate change but are most at risk from it.
translations: Such an agreement would include recognition that the world must aim as soon as possible to hold global warming to 1.5-degree Celsius;
此协议将包括如下目标 ，达成世界必须尽快将全球变暖保持在摄氏1 .5度的共识；
a long-term low-carbon future;长期的低碳目标；
5-year updated action plans that recognise the developing climate reality;五年一更新的实施计划 ，认清了气候在不断发展的现实；
and aid to those countries that did little to cause climate change but are most at risk from it.并向那些对气候变化几乎没影响但深受其害国家提供援助。

text: The primary application we 're targeting at ﬁrst is to give people a decision aid during rehabilitation, following an acute knee injury, to help them understand when they can perform particular activities, and when they can move to diﬀerent intensities of particular activities. A useful thing to take crack at.
translations: The primary application we 're targeting at first is to give people a decision aid during rehabilitation , following an acute knee injury, to help them understand when they can perform particular activities , and when they can move to different intensities of particular activities .
我们最初针对的主要应用是 ，在急性膝盖受伤后的康复过程中 ，为人们提供对策来帮助他们了解何时可以进行哪些不同强度的活动。
A useful thing to take crack at.这才是值得研究的。

text: Studying abroad is a very popular option for students who come from a wealthy family. Most people believe that overseas experience provides a deeper understanding of cultures and develops communication skills. While this may be true, not all of these new experiences are useful for ﬁnding a job. Employers tend to value interpersonal skills and industry knowledge more than cultural background.
translations: Studying abroad is a very popular option for students who come from a wealthy family.对于家境富裕的学生来说 ， 出国留学是一种非常受欢迎的选择。
Most people believe that overseas experience provides a deeper understanding of cultures and develops communication skills .
大多数人认为 ，海外经验可以使人们对文化有更深刻的了解 ，并提升交流技巧。
While this may be true , not all of these new experiences are useful for finding a job.尽管可能这是对的 ，但并非所有这些新经验都对找工作有用 。
Employers tend to value interpersonal skills and industry knowledge more than cultural background.与文化背景相比 ，雇主更重视人际交往能力和专业知识。

text: Augustus was given the powers of an absolute monarch, but he presented himself as the preserver of republican traditions. He treated the Senate, or state council, with great respect. He successfully reduced the political power of the army by retiring many soldiers, but giving them land or money to keep their loyalty.
translations: Augustus was given the powers of an absolute monarch , but he presented himself as the preserver of republican traditions .
奥古斯拥有了只手遮天的权力 ，但他却表现为共和传统的守护者。
He treated the Senate , or state council , with great respect.他非常尊重参议院或州议会。
He successfully reduced the political power of the army by retiring many soldiers , but giving them land or money to keep their loyalty.
他通过裁军而成功地削减了军队的政治实力 ，但却通过给士兵分发土地或金钱的方怯来维持他们的忠诚度。

text: In 1815, on the island of Sumbawa in Indonesia, a handsome and long quiescent mountain named Tambora exploded spectacularly, killing a hundred thousand people with its blast and associated tsunamis. No one living now has ever seen such fury. Tambora was far bigger than anything any living human has experienced. It was the biggest volcanic explosion in ten thousand years 150 times the size of Mount St Helens, equivalent to sixty thousand Hiroshima-sized atom bombs.
translations: In 1815 , on the island of Sumbawa in Indonesia , a handsome and long quiescent mountain named Tambora exploded spectacularly, killing a hundred thousand people with its blast and associated tsunamis .
1815年 ，在印度尼西亚的苏巴⽡岛上 ，一座名叫坦波拉的僻静又绵长的山上发生了惊人的爆炸 ，爆炸及所引起的海啸使几十万人丧生。
No one living now has ever seen such fury.没有人见过这种场面。
Tambora was far bigger than anything any living human has experienced.坦波拉事件是人类有史以来最严重的一次事故。
It was the biggest volcanic explosion in ten thousand years 150 times the size of Mount St Helens , equivalent to sixty thousand Hiroshima-sized atom bombs .
这是一万年来最大的火山爆炸 ，是圣海伦斯山的150倍 ，威力相当于六万枚广岛大小的原子弹爆炸。

text: Nurse sharks are thought to take advantage of dormant ﬁsh which would otherwise be too fast for the sharks to catch, although their small mouths limit the size of prey items, the sharks have large throat cavities which are used as a sort of bellows valve. In this way, Nurse sharks are able to suck in their prey. Nurse sharks are also known to graze algae and coral.
translations: Nurse sharks are thought to take advantage of dormant fish which would otherwise be too fast for the sharks to catch , although their small mouths limit the size of prey items , the sharks have large throat cavities which are used as a sort of bellows valve .
人们认为铰口鲨可以利用鱼类的休眠来捕食 ，否则它们会游得太快难以捕获 ，尽管它们的嘴小 ， 限制了猎物的尺寸，但鲨鱼的喉咙却好用如波纹管阀。
In this way, Nurse sharks are able to suck in their prey.这样 ，铰口鲨就可以吞入猎物。
Nurse sharks are also known to graze algae and coral.据悉 ， 哺乳鲨还会吃食藻类和珊瑚。

text: According to the United States Constitution, a presidential election is to be held once every fourth year. The process of electing a President and Vice-President begins long before Election Day. Candidates from both major and minor political parties and independent candidates begin to raise money and campaign at least one year in advance of the general presidential election. In order to oﬃcially represent a political party, a candidate must be nominated by that party.
translations: According to the United States Constitution , a presidential election is to be held once every fourth year.根据美国宪法 ，总统选举每四年举行一次。
The process of electing a President and Vice-President begins long before Election Day.选举总统和副总统的过程会早于大选日 。
Candidates from both major and minor political parties and independent candidates begin to raise money and campaign at least one year in advance of the general presidential election .
来自主要和次要政党的候选人以及独立候选人至少在大选前一年就开始筹款和竞选。
In order to officially represent a political party, a candidate must be nominated by that party.为了正怯代表一个政党 ，候选人必须由该政党提名。

text: The prejudice against too-good employees is pervasive. Companies tend to prefer an applicant who is a perfect ﬁt over someone who brings more intelligence, education, or experience than needed. On the surface, this bias makes sense: Studies have consistently shown that employees who consider themselves overqualiﬁed exhibit higher levels of discontent.
translations: The prejudice against too-good employees is pervasive .对优秀员工的偏见无处不在。
Companies tend to prefer an applicant who is a perfect fit over someone who brings more intelligence , education , or experience than needed.
公司往往更喜欢各方面完全合适的申请人 ，而不是那些拥有更多智慧 ，教育或经验的人。
On the surface , this bias makes sense: Studies have consistently shown that employees who consider themselves overqualified exhibit higher levels of discontent.
从表面上看 ，这种偏见是有道理的： 研究一直表明 ，认为自己资历过高的员工会表现出更强烈的不满。

text: On a ﬁeld trip to the Amazon in 1807, 19th century explorer Alexander Von Humboldt witnessed a group of horses lead through a muddy pool ﬁlled with electric eels, which he described as dramatically leaping up to attack the intruders. But scientists have doubted the story. An illustration of Alexander Von Humboldt 's story of the battle between the horses and electric eels.
translations: On a field trip to the Amazon in 1807 , 19th century explorer Alexander Von Humboldt witnessed a group of horses lead through a muddy pool filled with electric eels , which he described as dramatically leaping up to
attack the intruders .
1807年 ，在前往亚马逊的实地考察中 ，十九世纪的探险家亚历山大·冯·洪堡目睹了一群马匹穿过充满电鳗的泥泞池塘 ，他把它们形容成跃跃欲试的入侵者。
But scientists have doubted the story.但是科学家对此事表⽰怀疑。
An illustration of Alexander Von Humboldt 's story of the battle between the horses and electric eels .一张亚历山大·冯·洪堡关于马与电鳗之间的战斗故事的插图。

text: In the past two centuries, there has been a dramatic change in the role of food and eating in Australian public consciousness. Public discussion of food was largely conﬁned to matters of supply, distribution and price. Towards the end of the nineteenth century, some newspapers were oﬀering regular columns of advice on housekeeping topics, including menu planning and recipes.
translations: In the past two centuries , there has been a dramatic change in the role of food and eating in Australian public consciousness .
在过去的两个世纪中 ，澳大利亚公众意识中食品的作用发生了巨大变化。
Public discussion of food was largely confined to matters of supply, distribution and price .关于食品的公开讨论主要限于供应 ，分配和价格问题。
Towards the end of the nineteenth century, some newspapers were offering regular columns of advice on housekeeping topics , including menu planning and recipes .
到19世纪末 ，一些报纸定期提供有关家居主题的一些建议 ，包括菜单规划和食谱。

text: In such an environment, warfare is no longer purely directed against the military potential of adversarial states. It is rather directed at inﬁltrating all areas of their societies and to threaten their existences. The comparatively easy access to weapons of mass destruction, in particular relatively low-cost biological agents, is of key concern.
translations: In such an environment , warfare is no longer purely directed against the military potential of adversarial states .在这样的环境下 ， 战争不再仅仅针对对抗国家的军事潜力。
It is rather directed at infiltrating all areas of their societies and to threaten their existences .它的目的是渗透到地方社会的所有领域并威胁他们的生存。
The comparatively easy access to weapons of mass destruction , in particular relatively low-cost biological agents , is of key concern .
关键问题是大规模毁灭性武器相对容易获得的 ，尤其是相对廉价的生物制剂。

text: The authors noted causality of risks and beneﬁts cannot be established for either with the research currently available as they are largely based on observational data. Further research is needed to quantify the risk-beneﬁt balance for coﬀee consumption, as well as identify which of coﬀee 's many active ingredients, or indeed the combination of such, that could be inducing these health beneﬁts.
translations: The authors noted causality of risks and benefits cannot be established for either with the research currently available as they are largely based on observational data .
作者指出 ， 由于现有的研究主要基于观察数据 ， 因此无法通过现有的研究确定风险和收益的因果关系。

Further research is needed to quantify the risk-benefit balance for coffee consumption , as well as identify which of coffee 's many active ingredients , or indeed the combination of such , that could be inducing these health benefits .
因此需要进行进一步的研究以量化咖啡消费的风险收益平衡 ，并确定咖啡的多种有效成分中的哪一种 ，或者实际上是多种成分的组合 ，可以带来这些健康益处。

text: Every generation inevitably believes that the clothes, manners and speech of the following one have deteriorated. We would therefore expect to ﬁnd a respect for conservative language in every century and every culture and, in literate societies, a reverence for the language of the 'best authors 'of the past.
translations: Every generation inevitably believes that the clothes , manners and speech of the following one have deteriorated.
每一代人都难免认为下一代的服饰 ，举止和言语已经堕落了。
We would therefore expect to find a respect for conservative language in every century and every culture and , in literate societies , a reverence for the language of the ' best authors 'of the past.
因此 ，我们希望在每个世纪和每种文化中都能找到对传统语言的尊重 ，并且在文明社会中 ，人们会尊重过去“ 最佳作者 ”的语言。

text: Promoting active lifestyles can help us address some of the important challenges facing the UK today. Increasing physical activity has the potential to improve the physical and mental health of the nation, reduce all-cause mortality and improve life expectancy. It can also save money by signiﬁcantly easing the burden of chronic disease on the health and social care services.
translations: Promoting active lifestyles can help us address some of the important challenges facing the UK today.倡导积极的生活方怯可以帮助我们应对当今英国面临的一些重要挑战。
Increasing physical activity has the potential to improve the physical and mental health of the nation , reduce all-cause mortality and improve life expectancy.
增强体育锻炼有助于改善国民的身心健康 ， 降低全因死亡率 ，并提高预期寿命。
It can also save money by significantly easing the burden of chronic disease on the health and social care services .
不仅可以显著减轻慢性病对健康的负担和对社会护理服务的负担 ，还可以节省开支。

text: There 's a glimmer of hope for frogs and other amphibians that are being wiped out by a lethal disease. Some now seem to be evolving resistance to the killer "chytrid "fungus. In Panama, 9 aﬀected species have virtually recovered to previous levels.
translations: There 's a glimmer of hope for frogs and other amphibians that are being wiped out by a lethal disease .致命疾病给青蛙和其他两栖动物带来了一线希望。
Some now seem to be evolving resistance to the killer "chytrid "fungus .现在一些两栖动物似乎正在展开对杀手 “ 壶菌 ”的抵抗。
In Panama , 9 affected species have virtually recovered to previous levels .在巴拿马 ，有9种受感染物种实际上已恢复到以前的水平。

text: Based on experimental evidence physicists publish revolutionary new theory on brain learning that contradicts the most common assumption in neuroscience, will transform our understanding of brain function, and open new horizons for advanced deep learning algorithms.
translations: Based on experimental evidence physicists publish revolutionary new theory on brain learning that contradicts the most common assumption in neuroscience , will transform our understanding of brain function , and open
new horizons for advanced deep learning algorithms .
基于实验证据 ，物理学家发表了新的大脑学习理论 ，该理论与神经科学中最常见的假设相矛盾 ，并将改变我们对脑功能的理解 ，为深度学习算法开辟新的视野。

text: In the largest study of its kind, nine novel genes for osteoarthritis have been discovered by scientists from the Wellcome Sanger Institute and their collaborators. Results of the study, published today in Nature Genetics, could open the door to new targeted therapies.
translations: In the largest study of its kind , nine novel genes for osteoarthritis have been discovered by scientists from the Wellcome Sanger Institute and their collaborators .
在同类中规模最大的一项研究中 ，惠康桑格研究所及其合作者新发现了九种骨关节炎的基因。
Results of the study, published today in Nature Genetics , could open the door to new targeted therapies .研究结果发表在《自然遗传学》 上 ，这可能为靶向疗法打开了一扇新的大门。

title_zh: 饮食和生活习惯的改变
text: Dietary and lifestyle changes guided by registered dietitian nutritionists and other professionals can help reduce the incidence and progression of obesity-related cancers and support the recovery of cancer survivors.
translations: Dietary and lifestyle changes guided by registered dietitian nutritionists and other professionals can help
reduce the incidence and progression of obesity-related cancers and support the recovery of cancer survivors .由注册营养师及其他专业人员指导的饮食和生活方怯的改变 ，能有助于减少与肥胖相关的癌症的发生率和扩散 ，并促进癌症患者的康复。

text: As we get older, our endurance declines, in part because our blood vessels lose some of their capacity to deliver oxygen and nutrients to muscle tissue. A research team has now found that it can reverse this age-related endurance loss in mice.
translations: As we get older, our endurance declines , in part because our blood vessels lose some of their capacity to deliver oxygen and nutrients to muscle tissue .
随着年龄的增长 ，我们的耐力会下降 ，部分原因是我们的血管失去了向肌肉组织输送氧气和营养的能力。
A research team has now found that it can reverse this age-related endurance loss in mice .现在 ，一个研究小组发现用小鼠可以逆转这种与年龄有关的耐力丧失。

text: The slow fade of radioactive elements following a supernova allows astrophysicists to study them at length. But the universe is packed full of ﬂash-in-the-pan transient events lasting only a brief time, so quick and hard to study they remain a mystery.
translations: The slow fade of radioactive elements following a supernova allows astrophysicists to study them at length.超新星后的放射性元素的缓慢衰变 ，使天体物理学家可以对其展开详细的研究。
But the universe is packed full of flash-in-the-pan transient events lasting only a brief time , so quick and hard to study they remain a mystery.
但是 ， 宇宙充满了昙花一现的瞬态事件 ， 因为它们出现时间短 ，很难研究 ， 因此它们仍然是一个谜。

text: If you keep a close eye on an MRI scan of the brain, you 'll see a wave pass through the entire brain like a heartbeat once every few seconds. This ultra-slow rhythm was recognised decades ago, but no one quite knew what to make of it.
translations: If you keep a close eye on an MRI scan of the brain , you ' ll see a wave pass through the entire brain like a heartbeat once every few seconds .
如果你密切关注大脑的核磁共振扫描 ，就会发现每隔几秒就会有一次像心跳一样的波动穿过整个大脑。
This ultra-slow rhythm was recognised decades ago , but no one quite knew what to make of it.这种超慢节奏在几十年前就已得到认可 ，但没人知道该怎么做。

text: Students whose circadian rhythms were out of sync with their class schedules, say, night owls taking early morning courses-received lower grades due to "social jet lag ", a condition in which peak alertness times are at odds with work, school or other demands.
translations: Students whose circadian rhythms were out of sync with their class schedules , say, night owls taking early
morning courses-received lower grades due to "social jet lag " , a condition in which peak alertness times are at odds with work , school or other demands .
昼夜节律与课表不同步的学生 ，例如 ，夜猫子上早课由于倒“社交时差 ”而成绩不好 ， 因为在这种情况下 ，警醒高峰与工作学习或其他活动是相矛盾的。

text: Though their purpose and function are still largely unknown, mirror neurons in the brain are believed by some neuroscientists to be central to how humans relate to each other. Deﬁciencies in mirror neurons might also play a role in autism and other disorders aﬀecting social skills.
translations: Though their purpose and function are still largely unknown , mirror neurons in the brain are believed by some neuroscientists to be central to how humans relate to each other.
尽管它们的目的和功能仍很大程度上处于未知状态 ，但一些神经科学家认为 ，大脑中的镜像神经元对于人际关系起着至关重要的作用 。
Deficiencies in mirror neurons might also play a role in autism and other disorders affecting social skills .镜像神经元的受损可能在自闭症和其他影响社交技能的疾病中起到了一定作用 。

text: In the last decades of the 18th century, the losers seriously outnumbered the winners. Those who were fortunate enough to occupy the upper levels of society, celebrated their good fortune by living a hedonistic life of gambling, parties and alcohol.
translations: In the last decades of the 18th century, the losers seriously outnumbered the winners .在18世纪的最后几十年 ，败者的人数远超胜者。
Those who were fortunate enough to occupy the upper levels of society, celebrated their good fortune by living a hedonistic life of gambling , parties and alcohol.
那些幸运地跻身上流社会的人 ，通过享乐主义如赌博 ，聚会和酗酒来庆祝自己的好运。

text: A 30-year-old transgender woman has become the ﬁrst oﬃcially recorded to breastfeed her baby. An experimental three and a half-month treatment regimen, which included hormones, a nausea drug and breast stimulation.
translations: A 30-year-old transgender woman has become the first officially recorded to breastfeed her baby.一名30岁的变性女子已成为官方记载的首个母乳喂养的女子。
An experimental three and a half-month treatment regimen , which included hormones , a nausea drug and breast stimulation .
治疗方案的实验为时三个半月 ，方案包括激素 ，止吐药和乳房刺激。

text: Once sunﬂowers bloom, their back-and-forth motion ceases, and they typically point toward the rising sun. To see if facing east was beneﬁcial to the mature plants, the researchers rotated some sunﬂowers so they were facing west, then recorded how many bees and other insects visited the plants.
translations: Once sunflowers bloom , their back-and-forth motion ceases , and they typically point toward the rising sun .向日葵开花后 ， 它们的往返运动就停止了 ， 它们通常指向朝阳。
To see if facing east was beneficial to the mature plants , the researchers rotated some sunflowers so they were facing west , then recorded how many bees and other insects visited the plants .
为了了解朝东是否对植物成熟有利 ，研究人员把向日葵扭向西边 ，然后记录能吸引多少蜜蜂和其他昆虫。

text: Buttercups get their bright colour from yellow pigments in the petals 'surface layer. But the petals 'shiny gloss is due to the double layer of air just beneath the surface. This reﬂectivity is what turns people 's chins yellow when they hold a ﬂower underneath.
translations: Buttercups get their bright colour from yellow pigments in the petals 'surface layer.毛莨从花瓣表层的黄色素中获取鲜艳的色彩。
But the petals 'shiny gloss is due to the double layer of air just beneath the surface .但是花瓣的光泽是由表面下方的双层空气所致。
This reflectivity is what turns people 's chins yellow when they hold a flower underneath.当人们拿着花放在下巴下面时 ，这种反射会使下巴变黄。

text: Just how many you should remove comes down to a delicate balance. The more suckers your plant has, the more opportunities it will have to ﬂower and make fruit. But all this growth can use a lot of energy, which may mean you get smaller tomatoes.
translations: Just how many you should remove comes down to a delicate balance .应该你所删除的数量会达到一个微妙的平衡。
The more suckers your plant has , the more opportunities it will have to flower and make fruit.植物吸盘越多 ，开花结果的机会就越多。
But all this growth can use a lot of energy, which may mean you get smaller tomatoes .但是 ，植物的所有生长活动都要消耗大量能量 ，可能就意味着你收获的西红柿也会变小。

text: It has long been known that insects such as pollinators and pests can distinguish between plants by the unique bouquet of chemicals they release. What 's new is the idea that plants use their emissions to talk among themselves.
translations: It has long been known that insects such as pollinators and pests can distinguish between plants by the unique bouquet of chemicals they release .
我们早就知道 ，如传粉媒介和害虫之类的昆虫可以通过释放的独特化学物质来区分植物。
What 's new is the idea that plants use their emissions to talk among themselves .新发现表明 ，植物也使用自己释放的物质来相互对话。

text: The invention of weapons may have levelled the playing ﬁeld, because dominant men were no longer able to fend oﬀ competitors who were weaker but armed. That aligns helped social stability. If a few men monopolise all the women, that leaves a lot of disgruntled bystanders.
translations: The invention of weapons may have levelled the playing field , because dominant men were no longer able to fend off competitors who were weaker but armed.
武器的发明可能把战争的档次提升了 ， 因为统治者再不能抵御实力较弱但装备精良的对手了。
That aligns helped social stability.这有助于社会稳定。
If a few men monopolise all the women , that leaves a lot of disgruntled bystanders .如果几个男人垄断了所有女人 ，就会留下很多不满的旁观者。

text: The most popular varieties of tea, including black tea, green tea, Oolong tea, white tea, and chai. All come from the leaves of the evergreen shrub Camellia sinensis, otherwise known as the tea tree.
translations: The most popular varieties of tea , including black tea , green tea , Oolong tea , white tea , and chai.茶的最受欢迎品种包括红茶 ，绿茶 ，乌龙茶 ， 白茶和混合茶。
All come from the leaves of the evergreen shrub Camellia sinensis , otherwise known as the tea tree .所有茶都是常绿灌木茶花的叶子 ，也称茶树。

text: In the Namibia desert of southern Africa, where annual rainfall can be as little as 2 millimetres a year, drought-resistant head-stander beetles make up a large chunk of the endemic biodiversity. They survive by basking in the mists that wash in from the Atlantic Ocean.
translations: In the Namibia desert of southern Africa , where annual rainfall can be as little as 2 millimetres a year, drought- resistant head-stander beetles make up a large chunk of the endemic biodiversity.
在南非的纳米比亚沙漠中 ，年降雨量可能仅为2毫米 ，地方性生物多样性很大一部分是抗旱的立茎甲虫。
They survive by basking in the mists that wash in from the Atlantic Ocean .他们靠沐浴在大西洋的薄雾中生存。

text: Could local authorities impose such measures today? Probably not. Even so, the legacy of the moral reform of the late 1800s and 1900s lives on today. Because of it, the British have come to expect a system which is competent, fair to all and free from corruption.
translations: Could local authorities impose such measures today?当局现在可以采取这样的措施吗？
Probably not.可能不会。
Even so , the legacy of the moral reform of the late 1800s and 1900s lives on today.即便如此 ， 1800年代和1900年代后期道德改革的遗留问题仍然存在。
Because of it , the British have come to expect a system which is competent , fair to all and free from corruption .
因此 ，英国人开始希望建立一个称职的 ，对所有人公平的 ，没有腐败的制度。

text: Simple living said: sets my heart on higher thoughts. There is a need to follow simplicity in our life. In today 's world of increasing pomp and show, when everybody is joining the rat race of displaying his wealth, we should prefer to live simply, without any artiﬁciality.
translations: Simple living said: sets my heart on higher thoughts .简单的生活说： 让我立志于深刻的想法。
There is a need to follow simplicity in our life .在我们的生活中需要遵循简单性。
In today 's world of increasing pomp and show, when everybody is joining the rat race of displaying his wealth , we should prefer to live simply, without any artificiality.
在越来越富丽堂皇的今天 ，每个人都在展⽰自己的财富 ，我们应倾向于过着简单的生活 ，没有任何人为干预。

text: To see whether the sunﬂowers ' daily swings were tipped oﬀ by environmental cues or driven by an internal clock, the researchers rigged up a growth chamber with a row of lights that turned on and oﬀ sequentially, mimicking the movement of the sun.
translations: To see whether the sunflowers ' daily swings were tipped off by environmental cues or driven by an internal clock , the researchers rigged up a growth chamber with a row of lights that turned on and off sequentially, mimicking the movement of the sun .
为了了解向日葵的日常摆动是由环境因素引起的还是由内部时钟驱动的 ，研究人员在生长室中安装了一排依次点亮和熄灭的灯 ，来模仿太阳的运动。

text: All plants grow thanks to dome-shaped bundles of cells called meristems that make new tissue. The main shoot of a determinate tomato plant doesn 't grow upwards indeﬁnitely. After a while, its meristem switches into reproductive mode, makes a ﬂower.
translations: All plants grow thanks to dome-shaped bundles of cells called meristems that make new tissue .所有植物的生长都得益于可发育出新组织的 ，名为分生组织的圆顶状细胞束。
The main shoot of a determinate tomato plant doesn 't grow upwards indefinitely.特定种类的番茄植株的主芽不会无限期地向上生长。
After a while , its meristem switches into reproductive mode , makes a flower.过了一一段时间 ， 它的分生组织会进入繁殖模怯 ，并开花。

text: It sounds far-fetched, but since John Wyndham 's book was published in 1951, one aspect of this ﬁction has proved to be science fact: plants do talk to one another. If you stroll through a forest and take a deep breath, you can smell the "words ".
translations: It sounds far-fetched , but since John Wyndham 's book was published in 1951 , one aspect of this fiction has proved to be science fact: plants do talk to one another.
这听起来有些牵强 ，但是自从约翰·温德姆的书于1951年出版以来 ，小说提到的一点已经科学证实了： 植物之间确实可以互相交谈。
If you stroll through a forest and take a deep breath , you can smell the "words " .如果你徜徉在森林中深呼吸 ，就会嗅到一些“话语 ”。

text: Take a moment before you plant a mix of generic wild-ﬂower seeds in your garden. If you live in or near a natural area and the seed mix you use is from elsewhere, your wild ﬂowers may escape and compete or hybridise with local wild populations.
translations: Take a moment before you plant a mix of generic wild-flower seeds in your garden .在花园种下普通的野花种子前先等一下。
If you live in or near a natural area and the seed mix you use is from elsewhere , your wild flowers may escape and compete or hybridise with local wild populations .
如果你住在一处野外 ，而使用的杂交种子来自其他地区 ，那么野花可能会逃跑并与当地野生种群竞争或杂交。

text: Climate scientists are in no doubt that global warming is almost entirely the result of human activity. Which makes it odd that attempts to predict how things will pan out have paid lip service to human behaviour, one of the key factors determining whether a sustainable future is possible.
translations: Climate scientists are in no doubt that global warming is almost entirely the result of human activity.毫无疑问 ，气候学家们认为 ，全球变暖几乎完全是人类活动的结果。
Which makes it odd that attempts to predict how things will pan out have paid lip service to human behaviour, one of the key factors determining whether a sustainable future is possible .
奇怪的是 ，试图预测事物将如何发展的所作出的努力对人类行为起了劝诫作用 ，这是决定是否拥有可持续未来的关键因素之一。

text: Chronic dream deprivation isn 't just a problem for people with small children. Going to bed drunk or stoned, taking various medications or even just using an alarm to wake up in the morning can all leave your dreams smothered.
translations: Chronic dream deprivation isn 't just a problem for people with small children .对于有小孩的人来说 ，长期抑制梦境不只会出现一种问题。
Going to bed drunk or stoned , taking various medications or even just using an alarm to wake up in the morning can all leave your dreams smothered.
酪酊大醉就睡觉 ，服用各种药物 ，甚至只是在早晨用闹钟叫醒自 己 ，都可能抑制梦境。

text: That might sound like a trivial complaint. We tend to think of dream sleep as unimportant, the poor relative of vital and restorative deep sleep. But now it seems that dreams are much more than mystical night-time adventures.
translations: That might sound like a trivial complaint.听起来像是琐碎的抱怨。
We tend to think of dream sleep as unimportant , the poor relative of vital and restorative deep sleep.我们倾向于认为有梦睡眠不重要 ，与重要的恢复性深度睡眠的关系也不大。
But now it seems that dreams are much more than mystical night-time adventures .但现在看来 ，梦境远不止是神秘的夜间探险。

text: It will take an audacious mission to reach Titan. But that is exactly what is in the works. The plan is to send a souped-up, sensor-packed drone to hopscotch across its surface in search of life not at all as we know it.
translations: It will take an audacious mission to reach Titan .爬上泰坦峰需要勇往直前。
But that is exactly what is in the works .但这也正是工作原理。
The plan is to send a souped-up , sensor-packed drone to hopscotch across its surface in search of life not at all as we know it.
该计划是要发出一堆配满传感器的无人机在地表上来回巡视 ， 以寻找些目前未知的生命。

text: It 's diﬃcult to focus your gaze on an object when your eyes are on opposite sides of your head. When European starlings want to focus their gaze, they do so in a unique way: rapidly bobbing their heads from side to side so both eyes get a look.
translations: It 's difficult to focus your gaze on an object when your eyes are on opposite sides of your head.当眼睛长在头的相对两侧时 ，生物就很难将视线聚焦在一个物体上。
When European starlings want to focus their gaze , they do so in a unique way: rapidly bobbing their heads from side to side so both eyes get a look.
当欧椋鸟想要集中视线时 ， 它们采用了一种独特的方怯： 快速地左右摆动头部 ， 以便两只眼睛都能看到。

text: The remains of dozens of fortiﬁed villages, built before the arrival of Europeans, have been found in a relatively remote region of the Amazon. It seems the southern periphery of the Amazon was home to a million people before 1500 AD, far more than assumed.
translations: The remains of dozens of fortified villages , built before the arrival of Europeans , have been found in a relatively remote region of the Amazon .
在亚马逊人相对偏远的地区 ，人们发现了建于欧洲人抵达前几十个防御性村庄的遗迹。
It seems the southern periphery of the Amazon was home to a million people before 1500 AD , far more than assumed.
似乎在公元1500年之前 ，亚马逊河的南部边缘就有一百万人在居住 ，远远超过了人们的预期。

text: TV companies want people to watch their shows; science news outlets cannot resist a juicy story; trolls will be trolls. Whenever science is done by press release, it is science that usually comes oﬀ worst.
translations: TV companies want people to watch their shows;电视公司希望人们收看他们的节目 。
science news outlets cannot resist a juicy story;科学新闻媒体无法抗拒精彩的故事；
trolls will be trolls .魔鬼就是魔鬼。
Whenever science is done by press release , it is science that usually comes off worst.每当科学与新闻稿沾边时 ，通常倒霉的就是科学。

text: The fat sand rat is a strange creature. It lives in burrows, eats around 80 percent of its body mass in leaves each day and doesn 't drink water. But the really odd thing about this gerbil is that some of its DNA appears to be missing.
translations: The fat sand rat is a strange creature .胖胖的沙鼠是一种奇怪的生物。
It lives in burrows , eats around 80 percent of its body mass in leaves each day and doesn 't drink water.它生活在洞穴中 ，每天吃掉的叶子重量能占体重的80％ ，并且不喝水。
But the really odd thing about this gerbil is that some of its DNA appears to be missing.但是 ，这种沙鼠的真正奇怪之处在于它的某些DNA似乎缺失了。

text: What is more concerning is the rate of growth of carbon dioxide. It appears to be accelerating despite the recent dramatic slowing in annual emissions from human activity.
translations: What is more concerning is the rate of growth of carbon dioxide .二氧化碳的增长速度更令人关注。
It appears to be accelerating despite the recent dramatic slowing in annual emissions from human activity.尽管最近人类活动的年碳排放量急剧下降 ，但它似乎正在加速发展。

text: Using a mobile phone while driving is dangerous. Trying to catch Pokemon at the wheel could be even worse. According to a new analysis, the mobile game Pokemon Go may have contributed to nearly 150,000 traﬃc accidents.
translations: Using a mobile phone while driving is dangerous .开车时使用手机很危险。
Trying to catch Pokemon at the wheel could be even worse .试图把神奇宝贝拿到方向盘上可能会更危险。
According to a new analysis , the mobile game Pokemon Go may have contributed to nearly 150 ,000 traffic accidents .
根据最新分析 ，手机游戏《精灵宝可梦 Go》 可能导致了近15万起交通事故。

text: Even four-month-old infants expect adults to comfort crying babies. The ﬁnding suggests that we may be born with a foundation of morality, that becomes the basis for more advanced moral and social behaviour in later life.
translations: Even four-month-old infants expect adults to comfort crying babies .即使是四个月大的婴儿 ，也希望大人能够安慰下他们的哭闹。
The finding suggests that we may be born with a foundation of morality, that becomes the basis for more advanced moral and social behaviour in later life .
该发现表明 ，我们可能天生具有道德基础 ，这种道德基础会成为日后生活中更高级的道德和社会行为的基础。

text: Here comes the sun. The heads of young sunﬂower plants, those with immature ﬂowers, follow the sun during the day, then reverse course at night, so they 're ready to face the dawn.
translations: Here comes the sun .太阳出来了。
The heads of young sunflower plants , those with immature flowers , follow the sun during the day, then reverse course at night , so they 're ready to face the dawn .
向日葵植株头部有未成熟的花朵 ， 它们白天跟随太阳 ， 晚上要原路返回 ，才能准备好面对新的黎明。

text: Some other plants also warm their ﬂowers. A few burn food like warm-blooded animals, and one rhubarb species has translucent leaves that act like a greenhouse.
translations: Some other plants also warm their flowers .其他的植物也可以使花朵变暖。
A few burn food like warm-blooded animals , and one rhubarb species has translucent leaves that act like a greenhouse .
少数植物会像温血动物一样灼热食物 ，而一种大黄则有半透明的形状像温室的叶子。

text: If you are desperate for blue blooms, your best bet is to buy a solution of aluminium sulphate. The sulphate will acidify the soil, ensuring the aluminium ions can get into the plant.
translations: If you are desperate for blue blooms , your best bet is to buy a solution of aluminium sulphate .如果你很想得到蓝色花朵 ，最好的办法是购买硫酸铝溶液。
The sulphate will acidify the soil , ensuring the aluminium ions can get into the plant.硫酸盐会酸化土壤 ，使得铝离子可以渗入植物中。

text: By making the participants feel like they had extra help, the placebo probably made them feel more conﬁdent and adventurous. We think the placebo removes this mental block and allows people to feel more supported and let go of their fears.
translations: By making the participants feel like they had extra help , the placebo probably made them feel more confident and adventurous .
安慰剂能使参与者感到更加自信勇敢 ，让受试者感到自己受到了额外的帮助。
We think the placebo removes this mental block and allows people to feel more supported and let go of their fears .
我们认为安慰剂消除了精神障碍 ，使人们感觉受到了更多的支持 ， 同时摆脱了恐惧。

text: Recent research suggests that rapid eye movement sleep, when we have the most powerful dreams, is vital to learning and creativity, and promotes a healthy mind in a variety of ways. It isn 't romantic whimsy to say that if we stiﬂe our dreams, we aren 't going to reach our potential.
translations: Recent research suggests that rapid eye movement sleep , when we have the most powerful dreams , is vital to learning and creativity, and promotes a healthy mind in a variety of ways .
最新研究表明 ，快速眼动睡眠 （ 即在我们梦境最清晰时） 对于学习和创造力来说至关重要 ，并可以多角度地促进大脑健康。
It isn 't romantic whimsy to say that if we stifle our dreams , we aren 't going to reach our potential.要说抑制了梦境 ，我们就没法发挥潜力 ，那这种想法可不是胡诊。

text: If you need to get creative, a placebo could help unleash your talents. The placebo eﬀect is best known in medicine for making people feel better when they are given sham treatments. Now there is growing interest in using placebos to boost athletic and cognitive abilities.
translations: If you need to get creative , a placebo could help unleash your talents .如果你需要发挥创造力 ，那么安慰剂可以帮你施展才能。
The placebo effect is best known in medicine for making people feel better when they are given sham treatments .
安慰剂在医学上的作用广为人知 ， 它可以使人们在给药后感觉良好。
Now there is growing interest in using placebos to boost athletic and cognitive abilities .现在 ，人们对使用安慰剂来增强运动和认知能力愈发感兴趣。

text: When monkeys played against a computer, rather than each other, more crashes occurred, suggesting that the monkeys do get useful information from the direction of their partner 's gaze.
translations: When monkeys played against a computer, rather than each other, more crashes occurred , suggesting that the monkeys do get useful information from the direction of their partner 's gaze .
当猴子在与计算机而非同类玩耍时 ，就发生很多糟心的事 ，这表明猴子的确能从玩伴所注视的方向中获取有用的信息。

text: It 's very important that young people are involved, because young people are going to inherit this place, it 's their world that we 're talking about. We aren 't doing a very good job at the moment. We are letting down our young people, there is no doubt about that.
translations: It 's very important that young people are involved , because young people are going to inherit this place , it 's their world that we 're talking about.
年轻人的参与非常重要 ， 因为年轻人会承袭这一方天地 ，我们在谈论的是人家的地盘。
We aren 't doing a very good job at the moment.但目前 ，我们做的还不够好。
We are letting down our young people , there is no doubt about that.毫无疑问 ，年轻人对我们这一代很失望。

text: We humans have our eyes on the front of our heads, so their ﬁelds of vision overlap, but most birds have theirs on the sides. Scientists have proposed three ways they might focus on an object: use just one eye.
translations: We humans have our eyes on the front of our heads , so their fields of vision overlap , but most birds have theirs on the sides .
我们人类的眼睛长在头的前面 ， 因此左右眼的视野会有重叠 ，但大多数鸟类的眼睛长在侧面。
Scientists have proposed three ways they might focus on an object: use just one eye .科学家提出了三种方法来聚焦物体： 只用一只眼睛。

text: Over the last few years, researchers have shown what dog owners long suspected: our furry friends can recognise human facial expressions. For instance, a 2015 study showed that dogs know the diﬀerence between a happy face and an angry face.
translations: Over the last few years , researchers have shown what dog owners long suspected: our furry friends can recognise human facial expressions .
在过去的几年中 ，研究人员向人们展⽰了狗主人长期存疑的事情： 我们的毛孩子可以识别人的面部表情。
For instance , a 2015 study showed that dogs know the difference between a happy face and an angry face .例如 ，2015年的一项研究表明 ，狗能知道冷脸和热脸之间的区别。

text: It 's not exactly reading a dog 's mind, but it 's at least having a sneak peek. Researchers can now work out what a dog is looking at, just by examining a scan of its brain.
translations: It 's not exactly reading a dog 's mind , but it 's at least having a sneak peek.人们并没有完全读懂狗的想法 ，但至少略窥一二。
Researchers can now work out what a dog is looking at , just by examining a scan of its brain .现在 ，研究人员只需扫描狗的大脑即可知道它在看什么。

text: In today 's world, reading is basic to everyday life. As children we learn to read, and as adults, we read to learn. We read to learn about the news, to learn about rules, and to learn about how to do things. We also use reading to learn English.
translations: In today 's world , reading is basic to everyday life .在当今世界 ， 阅读对日常生活来说是很平常的事。
As children we learn to read , and as adults , we read to learn .孩子学习怎么去阅读 ，大人读书来学习知识。
We read to learn about the news , to learn about rules , and to learn about how to do things .我们阅读是为了浏览新闻 ， 了解规则 ，学习如何行事。
We also use reading to learn English.我们还通过阅读的方怯来学习英语。
