text: There are many intelligent people in the economic ﬁeld who would tell us that rising of prices is a phenomenon, which is characteristic of a developing economy. But inﬂation can be beneﬁcial, only if production and national income of the country also increase.
translations: There are many intelligent people in the economic field who would tell us that rising of prices is a phenomenon , which is characteristic of a developing economy.
经济领域很多精英会告诉我们 ，价格上涨是一种现象 ，也是经济发展中的一个特征。
But inflation can be beneficial , only if production and national income of the country also increase .但是 ，只有在该国的生产和国民收入也增加的情况下 ，通货膨胀才是有益的。

text: Life is full of various factors, the factors which can fascinate us for the moment but may lead us to failure, or the factors which can repel immediately but may be the stepping stones to success.
translations: Life is full of various factors , the factors which can fascinate us for the moment but may lead us to failure , or the factors which can repel immediately but may be the stepping stones to success .
生活中充满了各种事物 ，这些事物可能使我们暂时着迷 ，但可能导致我们失败； 或者这些事物可以让我们立马不开心 ，但也可能成为成功的垫脚石。

text: The proverb is always useful for a successful life. It conveys the idea that we should always think and then act accordingly. Impulsive actions may lead us to embarrassing and odd situations. As we should always think before we speak, in the same way we should think before we act.
translations: The proverb is always useful for a successful life .谚语对于成功的生活来说总是有用的。
It conveys the idea that we should always think and then act accordingly.它传达了这样的一种想法 ，我们应该始终保持思考然后将思考付诸行动。
Impulsive actions may lead us to embarrassing and odd situations .冲动的行为可能使我们陷入尴尬和奇怪的境地。
As we should always think before we speak , in the same way we should think before we act.正如我们始终应该先三思后说话一样 ， 同样也应该先三思而后行动。

text: Pluto lost its oﬃcial status as a planet yesterday, when the International Astronomical Union downsized the solar system from nine to eight planets. Although there had been a passionate debate at the IAU General Assembly Meeting in Prague about the deﬁnition of a planet-and whether Pluto met the speciﬁcations-the audience greeted the decision to exclude it with applause.
translations: Pluto lost its official status as a planet yesterday, when the International Astronomical Union downsized the solar system from nine to eight planets .
冥王星昨天从官方地位中被除名了 ， 国际天文学联合会将太阳系的行星从9颗缩减到了8颗。
Although there had been a passionate debate at the IAU General Assembly Meeting in Prague about the
definition of a planet-and whether Pluto met the specifications-the audience greeted the decision to exclude it with applause .
尽管在布拉格的国际天文联合会上 ，人们对行星的定义以及冥王星是否符合规定进行了激烈的辩论 ， 听众对这一决定表⽰认可 ，并报以热烈掌声。

text: The core of the problem was the immense disparity between the country's productive capacity and the ability of people to consume. Great innovations in productive techniques during and after the war raised the output of industry beyond the purchasing capacity of U.S. farmers and earners.
translations: The core of the problem was the immense disparity between the country 's productive capacity and the ability of people to consume .
问题的核心是该国的生产力和人们的消费能力之间存在巨大差距。
Great innovations in productive techniques during and after the war raised the output of industry beyond the purchasing capacity of U.S. farmers and earners.
战时和战后 ，生产技术的重大创新使工业产值超出了美国农民和工薪阶层的购买能力。

text: When countries assess their annual carbon dioxide emissions, they count up their cars and power stations, but bush ﬁres are not included presumably because they are deemed to be events beyond human control. In Australia, Victoria alone sees several hundred thousand hectares burn each year in both 2004 and the present summer, the ﬁgure has been over 1 million hectares.
translations: When countries assess their annual carbon dioxide emissions , they count up their cars and power stations , but bush fires are not included presumably because they are deemed to be events beyond human control.
当各国评估其年碳排放量时 ，会统计出汽车和发电站的数量 ，但可能不包括森林大火 ， 因为这些事故是无法人为控制的。
In Australia , Victoria alone sees several hundred thousand hectares burn each year in both 2004 and the present summer, the figure has been over 1 million hectares .
在澳大利亚 ，仅维州就分别在2004年和今年夏天每年有数十万公顷土地被烧毁 ，总数已超100万公顷。

text: While blue is one of the most popular colours, it is one of the least appetising. Food researchers say that when humans searched for food, they learned to avoid toxic or spoiled objects, which were often blue, black, or purple. When food dyed blue is served to study subjects, they lose appetite.
translations: While blue is one of the most popular colours , it is one of the least appetising.虽然蓝色是最受欢迎的颜色之一 ，但它却是最倒人胃口的颜色之一。
Food researchers say that when humans searched for food , they learned to avoid toxic or spoiled objects , which were often blue , black , or purple .
食品研究人员说 ，原始人类在寻找食物时 ，学会了要避开有毒或变质的东西 ，这些东西通常是蓝色 ，黑色或紫色的。
When food dyed blue is served to study subjects , they lose appetite .当将染成蓝色的食物提供给研究对象时 ，他们就会食欲不振。

text: If you have a chronic disease such as heart disease, diabetes, asthma, or back or joint pain, exercise can have important health beneﬁts. However, it is important to talk to your doctor before starting an exercise routine. He or she might have advice on what exercises are safe and any precautions you might need to take while exercising.
translations: If you have a chronic disease such as heart disease , diabetes , asthma , or back or joint pain , exercise can have important health benefits .
如果你患有慢性疾病 ，例如心脏病 ，糖尿病 ， 哮喘或背部关节痛 ，那么锻炼对健康大有裨益。
However, it is important to talk to your doctor before starting an exercise routine .但是 ，在开始锻炼之前 ，务必要先向医生咨询一下。
He or she might have advice on what exercises are safe and any precautions you might need to take while exercising.
他们可能对哪些运动是安全的以及运动时可能需要采取的预防措施给出建议。

text: In an attempt to lure new students, leading business schools, including Harvard, Stanford, the University of Chicago and Wharton, have moved away from the unoﬃcial missions and prerequisites of four years ' work experience and instead have set their sights on recent college graduates and so-called early career professionals with only a couple years of work under their belt.
translations: In an attempt to lure new students , leading business schools , including Harvard , Stanford , the University of Chicago and Wharton , have moved away from the unofficial missions and prerequisites of four years ' work experience and instead have set their sights on recent college graduates and so-called early career
professionals with only a couple years of work under their belt.
为了吸引新生 ，一流的商学院包括哈佛 ，斯坦福大学 ，芝加哥大学和沃顿商学院在内等 ， 已经对四年工作经验这类非硬性要求不予采用了 ，而将目光投向了刚毕业的大学生和只具备两年的工作经验 ，所谓的早期专业能手。

text: Marriage is a big step in anyone 's life and there is an argument to be made against getting married too early. As any newlywed couple knows, there is a huge amount of ﬁnancial pressure associated with marriage. Firstly, the wedding reception and honeymoon will cost you an arm and a leg. Then there 's the matter of home loans, rent and energy bills. If you 're looking to start a family, your child 's education is another thing you need to save up for. Teenagers should probably ﬁnd a proper job before deciding to tie the knot.
translations: Marriage is a big step in anyone 's life and there is an argument to be made against getting married too early.婚姻是每个人生活中的重要一步 ，有人提出反对过早结婚。
As any newlywed couple knows , there is a huge amount of financial pressure associated with marriage .每对新婚夫妇都知道 ，与婚姻相关的经济压力是很大的。
Firstly, the wedding reception and honeymoon will cost you an arm and a leg.首先 ，婚礼招待会和蜜月会耗资不菲。
Then there 's the matter of home loans , rent and energy bills .然后是房贷 ，租金和水电费的问题。
If you 're looking to start a family, your child 's education is another thing you need to save up for.如果你想组建家庭 ，那么另一比花销就是孩子的教育。
Teenagers should probably find a proper job before deciding to tie the knot.青少年在决定结婚之前应先找到合适的工作。

text: At the end of this year, we will launch the cup class boats. So these will be about twice the power. The sailors are down in the cockpits, unlike today. A lot of power is being generated by these four grinders that are providing hydraulic power, and that energy is being used to control the ﬂying surface, the hydrofoil and is also being used to control the wing and the ﬂaps, eﬀectively the engine, of what we have.
translations: At the end of this year, we will launch the cup class boats .在今年年底 ，我们将推出杯级帆船。
So these will be about twice the power.因此 ，他们的功率将扩大两倍。
The sailors are down in the cockpits , unlike today.与现在不同的是 ，水手们坐在座舱里面。

A lot of power is being generated by these four grinders that are providing hydraulic power, and that energy is being used to control the flying surface , the hydrofoil and is also being used to control the wing and the flaps , effectively the engine , of what we have .
这四个提供液压动力的磨床能提供很大动力 ，并且该动力可用于控制飞行面 ，水翼 ，还可用于控制设备上的机翼和襟翼 ，有效地控制发动机。

text: Howard believed that all clouds belonged to three distinct groups: cumulus, stratus and cirrus. He added a fourth category, nimbus, to describe a cloud in the act of condensation into rain, hail or snow. It is by observing how clouds change colour and shape that weather can be predicted, and as long as it is the ﬁrst three of cloud to keep their normal shape there won 't be any rain.
translations: Howard believed that all clouds belonged to three distinct groups: cumulus , stratus and cirrus .霍华德认为 ，所有云都可划分为三组类别： 积云 ，层云和卷云。
He added a fourth category, nimbus , to describe a cloud in the act of condensation into rain , hail or snow.他添加了第四类 ，雨云 ，用来概括凝结成雨 ，冰雹或雪的云。
It is by observing how clouds change colour and shape that weather can be predicted , and as long as it is the first three of cloud to keep their normal shape there won 't be any rain .
通过观察云如何变色变形就可以预测天气 ，而且只要有前三种形态的云 ，就不会下雨。

text: It is diﬃcult to tell whether the speaker approves of Hemingway's lifestyle or not. He was famously macho and spent a lot of time hunting wild animals, going to wars and getting into ﬁghts. All these things got into his books, and the speaker thinks that this is not necessarily a good thing as it means that too many people prefer to read about his life than read his books.
translations: It is difficult to tell whether the speaker approves of Hemingway 's lifestyle or not.很难判断演讲者是否认可海明威的生活方怯。
He was famously macho and spent a lot of time hunting wild animals , going to wars and getting into fights .他是出了名的硬汉 ，经常打猎 ，还参与世界大战的战斗中。
All these things got into his books , and the speaker thinks that this is not necessarily a good thing as it means that too many people prefer to read about his life than read his books .
他把这些东西都写进了书里 ，演讲者认为这不一定是一件好事 ， 因为这意味着太多的人宁愿了解他的生活而不愿读他的书。

text: Botanic gardens are scientiﬁc and cultural institutions established to collect, study, exchange and display plants for research and for the education and enjoyment of the public. There are major botanic gardens in each capital city. Zoological parks and aquariums are primarily engaged in the breeding, preservation and display of native and exotic fauna in captivity.
translations: Botanic gardens are scientific and cultural institutions established to collect , study, exchange and display plants for research and for the education and enjoyment of the public .
植物园的建立是用于收集 ，研究 ，交换和展⽰植物以进行研究 ，为教育和民众服务的科学文化机构。
There are major botanic gardens in each capital city.每个首都都设有大型植物园。
Zoological parks and aquariums are primarily engaged in the breeding , preservation and display of native and exotic fauna in captivity.
动物园和水族馆主要负责本地和外来动物的繁殖 ，饲养和展⽰。

text: Environment problems caused by hard rock mining involve water pollution by metals themselves, chemicals used in processing, acid drainage, and sediment. Metals and metal- like elements in the ore are toxic and prone to cause trouble by ending up in nearby streams and water tables as a result of mining operations.
translations: Environment problems caused by hard rock mining involve water pollution by metals themselves , chemicals used in processing , acid drainage , and sediment.
开采硬岩引起的环境问题包括金属本身对水的污染 ，加工中使用的化学物质 ，排出的酸性废水和沉淀物等。
Metals and metal-like elements in the ore are toxic and prone to cause trouble by ending up in nearby streams and water tables as a result of mining operations .
矿石中的金属和类金属元素有毒 ，也容易出现问题 ， 因为采矿工作结束后它们会流向附近的溪流和地下水。

text: Charles Darwin published his paper "On the Origin of Species "in 1859. It is one of the most well-known pieces of scientiﬁc literature in human history. In the paper, Darwin proposes the theory of natural selection. He states that for any generation of any species, there will always be a struggle for survival. Individuals who are better suited to the environment are "ﬁtter ", and therefore have a much higher chance of surviving and reproducing. This means that later generations are likely to inherit these stronger genetic traits.
translations: Charles Darwin published his paper "On the Origin of Species " in 1859.查尔斯·达尔文在1859年发表了他的论文“物种起源 ”。
It is one of the most well-known pieces of scientific literature in human history.它是人类历史上最著名的科学文献之一。
In the paper, Darwin proposes the theory of natural selection .在论文中 ，达尔文提出了自然选择理论。
He states that for any generation of any species , there will always be a struggle for survival.他指出 ，对于任何物种的任何一代来说 ，都会为生存而竞争。
Individuals who are better suited to the environment are "fitter " , and therefore have a much higher chance of surviving and reproducing.
更能适应环境的个体是“适者 ” ， 因此生存和繁殖的机会要高得多。
This means that later generations are likely to inherit these stronger genetic traits .这意味着后代可能会继承这些更强的遗传特征。

text: You may have heard of the new fad known as ecotourism. This means tourism which is environmentally friendly, and conscious about conserving the environment. The key is to minimise the physical, social and behavioural impacts of overseas travel. Tour groups will often work with local and indigenous communities to design respectful and memorable programmes for visitors.
translations: You may have heard of the new fad known as ecotourism .你可能听说过名为生态旅游的一种新时尚。
This means tourism which is environmentally friendly, and conscious about conserving the environment.这就意味着旅游业必须要环保 ，要有保护环境的意识。
The key is to minimise the physical , social and behavioural impacts of overseas travel.关键在于要最大程度地减少出国旅行对自身 ，对社会和人们行为的影响。
Tour groups will often work with local and indigenous communities to design respectful and memorable programmes for visitors .
旅游团通常会与当地和人当地社区合作 ，为游客设计精彩难忘的节目 。

text: Life expectancy has increased dramatically in the last century. Most people these days will live for over 70 years. This is more than double the lifespan of the average human in the seventeenth century. We can attribute our longevity to advances in medicine and lifestyle. While everyone agrees that living longer is wonderful, overpopulation is becoming a serious environmental concern.
translations: Life expectancy has increased dramatically in the last century.在上个世纪 ，人们的预期寿命急剧增加。
Most people these days will live for over 70 years .近几年大多数人将能活到70多岁。
This is more than double the lifespan of the average human in the seventeenth century.较十七世纪普通人寿命延长了两倍以上。
We can attribute our longevity to advances in medicine and lifestyle .我们可以将长寿归因于医学的进步和生活方怯的改善。
While everyone agrees that living longer is wonderful , overpopulation is becoming a serious environmental concern .
尽管所有人都认为寿命长是好事 ，但人口过剩正成为日益严重的环境问题。

text: Many people believe that employers discriminate against older people because youths have more energy and creativity. This is not true. The main reason for hiring younger workers is payroll. In most countries, your salary is dependent on how many years of work experience you have. It is far more cost eﬃcient to hire postgraduates, fresh out of university, than senior staﬀ with over twenty years of industry knowledge.
translations: Many people believe that employers discriminate against older people because youths have more energy and creativity.
许多人认为 ，雇主歧视老年人 ， 因为青年人更有活力和创造力。
This is not true .这种想法不对。
The main reason for hiring younger workers is payroll.雇用年轻人的主要是因为工资。
In most countries , your salary is dependent on how many years of work experience you have .在大多数国家中 ，工资取决于你的工作经验。
It is far more cost efficient to hire postgraduates , fresh out of university, than senior staff with over twenty years of industry knowledge .
雇用刚毕业的研究生 ，要比雇佣具备二十多年行业知识的高级职员更具成本效益。

text: Roman writers and orators began to expand their imaginative and intellectual horizons and reﬁne the Latin language through the study of Greek literature. Early Roman literature had two kinds of recording and examination of public life and behaviour through life stories of famous men, and the particularly Roman art of satirical comedy and drama.
translations: Roman writers and orators began to expand their imaginative and intellectual horizons and refine the Latin language through the study of Greek literature .
罗马作家和演说者开始通过研究希腊文学来扩大想象力 ，拓宽视野 ，并完善拉丁语。
Early Roman literature had two kinds of recording and examination of public life and behaviour through life stories of famous men , and the particularly Roman art of satirical comedy and drama .
早期的罗马文学通过名人的生活故事 ，尤其是罗马讽刺喜剧和戏剧艺术 ，对公共生活和行为进行了两种记录和考察。

text: The researchers think that long-distance ﬂiers such as the American golden-plover and the white-rumped sandpiper picked up the spores while lining their nests. Then when the birds arrive in new places they moult, leaving behind the feathers and their precious cargo to start growing again at the other end of the world.
translations: The researchers think that long-distance fliers such as the American golden-plover and the white-rumped sandpiper picked up the spores while lining their nests .
研究人员认为 ，长距离飞行的鸟类 ，例如美国金珩和白鹬 ，靠捡拾孢子来筑巢。
Then when the birds arrive in new places they moult , leaving behind the feathers and their precious cargo to start growing again at the other end of the world.
然后 ， 当这些鸟飞到新的地方时会蜕皮 ， 留下羽毛和宝贵的存货 ，在世界的另一头重新开始生活。

text: The Grand Canyon is 277 miles long, up to 18 miles wide and attains a depth of over a mile. While the speciﬁc geologic processes and timing that formed the Grand Canyon are the subject of debate by geologists, recent evidence suggests the Colorado River established its course through the canyon at least 17 million years ago.
translations: The Grand Canyon is 277 miles long , up to 18 miles wide and attains a depth of over a mile .科罗拉多大峡谷长277英里 ，宽18英里 ，深度超过一英里。

While the specific geologic processes and timing that formed the Grand Canyon are the subject of debate by geologists , recent evidence suggests the Colorado River established its course through the canyon at least 17 million years ago .
形成大峡谷的特定地质过程和时间一直是地质学家们所争论的话题 ，但最新的证据表明 ，科罗拉多河至少在1700万年前就形成了横跨峡谷的路线。

text: How do we imagine the unimaginable? If we are asked to think of an object-say, a yellow tulip-a picture immediately forms in our mind 's eye? But what if we try to imagine a concept such as the square root of a negative number?
translations: How do we imagine the unimaginable?我们如何去想象难以想象的事物的？
If we are asked to think of an object-say, a yellow tulip-a picture immediately forms in our mind 's eye?如果要求我们考虑一个物体 ，如黄色的郁金香 ，我们的脑海中会立即形成一个画面吗？
But what if we try to imagine a concept such as the square root of a negative number?但是 ，如果我们尝试想象一个概念 ，例如负数的平方根 ，该怎么办呢？

text: The development of easy-to-use statistical software has changed the way statistics is being taught and learned. Students can make transformations of variables, create graphs of distributions of variables, and select among statistical analyses all at the click of a button. However, even with these advancements, students sometimes still ﬁnd statistics to be an arduous task.
translations: The development of easy-to-use statistical software has changed the way statistics is being taught and learned.
易于使用的统计软件的开发改变了统计学的教学方怯。
Students can make transformations of variables , create graphs of distributions of variables , and select among statistical analyses all at the click of a button .
学生只需点击按钮即可对变量进行转换、创建变量分布图 ，并在统计分析中进行选择。
However, even with these advancements , students sometimes still find statistics to be an arduous task.然而 ， 即使取得了这些进步 ，学生有时仍然发现统计数据是一项艰巨的任务。

text: Tesla actually worked for Edison in his early career. Edison oﬀered to pay him the modern equivalent of a million dollars to ﬁx the problems he was having with his DC generators and motors. Tesla ﬁxed Edison 's machines and when he asked him for the money which he was promised, Edison laughed him oﬀ and had this to say: "Tesla, you don 't understand our American humour ".
translations: Tesla actually worked for Edison in his early career.实际上特斯拉在他职业生涯的早期给爱迪生打工。
Edison offered to pay him the modern equivalent of a million dollars to fix the problems he was having with his DC generators and motors .
爱迪生提出向他支付相当于一百万美元的赔偿费用 ， 以解决他的直流发电机和电动机所遇到的问题。
Tesla fixed Edison 's machines and when he asked him for the money which he was promised , Edison laughed him off and had this to say: "Tesla , you don 't understand our American humour " .
特斯拉修好了爱迪生的机器 ， 当他问爱迪生要所承诺的报酬时 ，爱迪生一阵狂笑 ，并说道： “特斯拉 ，你不懂我们的美怯幽默 ”。

text: Although it comes from a remote region of the western Himalayas, this plant now looks entirely at home on the banks of English rivers. Brought to the UK in 1839, it quickly escaped, colonising riverbanks and damp woodlands. Now it is spreading across Europe, New Zealand and Canada. In the Himalayas, the plant is held in check by various pests, and it grows and reproduces unhindered.
translations: Although it comes from a remote region of the western Himalayas , this plant now looks entirely at home on the banks of English rivers .
虽然它来自西喜马拉雅山的偏远地区 ，但现在这种植物在英国河流的岸边看起来完全像在家里一样。
Brought to the UK in 1839 , it quickly escaped , colonising riverbanks and damp woodlands .它于 1839 年被带到英国 ，但很快就逃脱了 ，在河岸和潮湿的林地中定居。
Now it is spreading across Europe , New Zealand and Canada .现在它正在欧洲、新西兰和加拿大蔓延。
In the Himalayas , the plant is held in check by various pests , and it grows and reproduces unhindered.在喜马拉雅山 ，这种植物受到各种害虫的抑制 ，但它的生长和繁殖不受阻碍。

text: The beginning of the twenty-ﬁrst century will be remembered, not for military conﬂicts or political events, but for a whole new age of globalisation, a 'ﬂattening 'of the world. The explosion of advanced technologies now means that suddenly knowledge pools and resources have connected all over the planet, levelling the playing ﬁeld as never before.
translations: The beginning of the twenty-first century will be remembered , not for military conflicts or political events , but for a whole new age of globalisation , a 'flattening 'of the world.
我们会记住二十一世纪初的 ，不是因为军事冲突或政治事件 ，而是因为全球化的整个新时代 ， 即世界的“扁平化 ”。
The explosion of advanced technologies now means that suddenly knowledge pools and resources have connected all over the planet , levelling the playing field as never before .
现在 ，先进技术的爆炸怯增长意味着知识储备和资源突然之间在整个地球上连接起来 ， 实现了前所未有的公平竞争。

text: At the beginning of each ﬁscal year funds are allocated to each State account in accordance with the University 's ﬁnancial plan. Funds are allocated to each account by object of expenditure. Account managers are responsible for ensuring that adequate funds are available in the appropriate object before initiating transactions to use the funds.
translations: At the beginning of each fiscal year funds are allocated to each State account in accordance with the University 's financial plan .
在每个财年开始时 ，资金将根据大学的财务计划分配至各州帐户。
Funds are allocated to each account by object of expenditure .资金按支出用途分配给每个帐户。
Account managers are responsible for ensuring that adequate funds are available in the appropriate object before initiating transactions to use the funds .
客户经理负责在启动使用资金的交易之前 ，确保在适当的对象中有足够的资金可用 。

text: Since its inception, the UN system has been working to ensure adequate food for all through sustainable agriculture. The majority of the worlds poorest people live in rural areas of developing countries. They depend on agriculture and related activities for their livelihoods. This makes them particularly vulnerable to man-made and natural inﬂuences that reduce agricultural production.
translations: Since its inception , the UN system has been working to ensure adequate food for all through sustainable agriculture .
自成立以来 ，联合国系统一直在努力通过可持续农业确保所有人粮食充足。
The majority of the worlds poorest people live in rural areas of developing countries .世界上最贫穷的人口大多数生活在发展中国家的农村地区。
They depend on agriculture and related activities for their livelihoods .他们以农业和农业相关活动为生。
This makes them particularly vulnerable to man-made and natural influences that reduce agricultural production .
这使得它们特别容易受到人为和自然因素的影响 ，从而影响农业生产。

text: The one-year programme of the master in global management is designed only for those who have the graduate degree in the thesis, increasing temporary skill of new managers in an international capacity, something that recruiters are looking for more and more.
translations: The one-year programme of the master in global management is designed only for those who have the graduate degree in the thesis , increasing temporary skill of new managers in an international capacity, something that recruiters are looking for more and more .
全球管理硕士课程为期一年 ，仅适用于那些拥有研究生学位的人 ，在国际层面增加新管理人员的临时技能 ，而这种技能正是招聘人员日益需要的。

text: Food is one of the most important things you 'll ever buy. And yet most people never bother to think about their food and where it comes from. People spend a lot more time worrying about what kind of blue jeans to wear, what kind of video games to play, what kind of computers to buy.
translations: Food is one of the most important things you ' ll ever buy.食物是你要购买的最重要的东西之一。
And yet most people never bother to think about their food and where it comes from .然而 ，大多数人从来没有思考过过食物本身及其来源。
People spend a lot more time worrying about what kind of blue jeans to wear, what kind of video games to play, what kind of computers to buy.
人们花很多时间担心穿什么样的蓝色牛仔裤 ，玩哪种视频游戏以及买哪种电脑。

text: Lincoln 's apparently radical change of mind about his war powers to emancipate slaves was caused by the escalating scope of war, which convinced him that any measure to weaken the Confederacy and strengthen the Union war eﬀort was justiﬁable as a military necessity.
translations: Lincoln 's apparently radical change of mind about his war powers to emancipate slaves was caused by the escalating scope of war, which convinced him that any measure to weaken the Confederacy and strengthen the Union war effort was justifiable as a military necessity.
林肯对解放奴隶的战争权力的态度显然发生了根本性的转变 ，这是由于战争范围的扩大而引起的 ，这使他相信 ，为削弱军事同盟和加强联盟战争所努力的任何措施 ，在军事上都是必要的合理的。

text: Tesla came over from Graz and went to work for Thomas Edison. Nonetheless, Edison oﬀered him a job, promising Tesla ﬁfty thousand dollars if Tesla could redesign Edisons breakdown-prone DC generator designs. The new generator designs were a vast improvement over Edison 's originals. Upon completing the job Tesla went to Edison to collect the 50, 000 promised for the task. Tesla, Edison replied, you don 't understand our American humour. And Tesla was never paid.
translations: Tesla came over from Graz and went to work for Thomas Edison .特斯拉从格拉茨过来 ，为托马斯·爱迪生工作。
Nonetheless , Edison offered him a job , promising Tesla fifty thousand dollars if Tesla could redesign Edisons breakdown-prone DC generator designs .
尽管如此 ，爱迪生还是给他提供了一份工作 ，并承诺如果特斯拉能够重新设计易出故障的直流发电机 ，则向特斯拉提供5万美元。
The new generator designs were a vast improvement over Edison 's originals .新发电机的设计在爱迪生原来的基础上有了巨大改进。
Upon completing the job Tesla went to Edison to collect the 50 , 000 promised for the task.在完成工作后 ，特斯拉去找爱迪生 ，兑现所承诺的50 ，000刀。
Tesla , Edison replied , you don 't understand our American humour.而爱迪生却回答说 ，特斯拉 ，你不懂我们的美怯幽默。
And Tesla was never paid.特斯拉一直没收到钱。

text: Parents can communicate their personal feelings about undesirable programmes both by discouraging their children from watching them and by writing to their local television station or to the program 's sponsors. The public does have a voice. Clearly, not all programmes need please everybody. We do have a choice of programmes and we also have a choice, for ourselves and at least for our younger children, of watching or not watching. There is an oﬀ button on every set!
translations: Parents can communicate their personal feelings about undesirable programmes both by discouraging their children from watching them and by writing to their local television station or to the program 's sponsors .
父母可以通过劝阻孩子不要看电视节目 ，并写信给当地的电视台或节目的赞助商等方怯 ，来传达他们对不良节目的个人感受。
The public does have a voice .公众确实有发言权。
Clearly, not all programmes need please everybody.显然 ，各花入各眼。
We do have a choice of programmes and we also have a choice , for ourselves and at least for our younger children , of watching or not watching.
我们确实对节目有选择权 ，至少对我们的年幼孩子来说 ，我们也可以选择观看还是不观看。
There is an off button on every set!毕竟每个电视都有一个关闭按钮！

text: Parents need to take control of the television viewing of pre-schoolers and children of early school age. A workable technique is to make a simple but ﬁrm weekly plan as to what programmes will be permitted and how much time overall may be spent in viewing. Any child 's weekly schedule normally involves a certain amount of time for school, naps, outdoor play and indoor play. There should not, therefore, be great amounts of unﬁlled time when the child gravitates towards the TV set.
translations: Parents need to take control of the television viewing of pre-schoolers and children of early school age .父母需要控制学龄前儿童和低年级学生观看电视。
A workable technique is to make a simple but firm weekly plan as to what programmes will be permitted and how much time overall may be spent in viewing.
一种可行的方法是 ，根据哪些节目可以看以及总共可能花费多少时间 ，来制作简单但坚定执行的周计划。
Any child 's weekly schedule normally involves a certain amount of time for school , naps , outdoor play and indoor play.
任何孩子的每周日程通常包括一些上学 ，小睡 ，户外游戏和室内游戏的时间。
There should not , therefore , be great amounts of unfilled time when the child gravitates towards the TV set.因此 ，不应留有大量的空闲时间来让孩子沉浸在电视中。

text: By beginning so early, he knows that he has plenty of time to do thoroughly all the work he can be expected to do. All his work having been ﬁnished in good time, he has a long interval of rest in the evening before the timely hour when he goes to bed. After a sound night 's rest, he rises early next morning in good health and spirits for the labours of a new day.
translations: By beginning so early, he knows that he has plenty of time to do thoroughly all the work he can be expected to do .
他这么早就开始了 ，他知道他有足够的时间来彻底地完成预期的所有工作。
All his work having been finished in good time , he has a long interval of rest in the evening before the timely hour when he goes to bed.
他所有的工作都按时完成 ，在晚上上床睡觉之前 ，他要歇息很长一段时间。
After a sound night 's rest , he rises early next morning in good health and spirits for the labours of a new day.经过一夜的安歇后 ，他第二天一早恢复体力 ，精神振奋 ，开始了新的一天。

text: Each tube-shaped mic-robot is a sandwich of three materials. A graphene outer layer, which binds to heavy metals. A middle layer of nickel, which gives the bots magnetic polarity, so they can be pulled through wastewater with magnets. And platinum inside for propulsion. Just add a bit of peroxide to the wastewater, and it 'll react with the platinum to form water and oxygen bubbles, which can propel the tubes along.
translations: Each tube-shaped mic-robot is a sandwich of three materials .每个管状的微型机器人都是三种材料的三明治。
A graphene outer layer, which binds to heavy metals .石墨烯外层 ，与重金属结合在一起。
A middle layer of nickel , which gives the bots magnetic polarity, so they can be pulled through wastewater with magnets .
镍的中间层使机器人具有极性 ， 因此可以用磁铁将它们从废水中吸出来。
And platinum inside for propulsion .铂金内部具有推力。
Just add a bit of peroxide to the wastewater, and it ' ll react with the platinum to form water and oxygen bubbles , which can propel the tubes along.
只需向废水中添加一些过氧化物 ， 它就会与铂反应形成水和氧气气泡 ，从而推动管子前进。

text: Trump has threatened to declare China a currency manipulator, but experts say he has little legal or economic basis to take such a step. He has also threatened to impose a tariﬀ of up to 45 percent on Chinese imports if Beijing doesn 't "behave, "a move that could lead to a trade war and damage the economies of both nations.
translations: Trump has threatened to declare China a currency manipulator, but experts say he has little legal or economic basis to take such a step.
特朗普扬言要宣布中国为货币垄断国 ，但专家表⽰ ，他没有任何法律或经济依据。
He has also threatened to impose a tariff of up to 45 percent on Chinese imports if Beijing doesn 't " behave , "a move that could lead to a trade war and damage the economies of both nations .
他还威胁说 ，如果北京不“规矩 ” ，将对中国进口商品征收最高45％ 的关税 ，此举可能导致贸易战并损害两国经济。

text: To understand the past you have to be able, as far as possible, to think as the people in the period you are studying thought. The example of what it must have been like to be a peasant in the Middle Ages is used. However, sensibilities change over time and we can 't completely throw oﬀ the mentality of the present. Therefore, every age will have a slightly diﬀerent perspective on the same period of the past, no matter what the facts are.
translations: To understand the past you have to be able , as far as possible , to think as the people in the period you are studying thought.
要了解过去 ，您必须尽可能地像您研究思想的那个时代的人们那样思考。
The example of what it must have been like to be a peasant in the Middle Ages is used.举例个例子 ，在中世纪需要成为农民的样子。
However, sensibilities change over time and we can 't completely throw off the mentality of the present.但是 ，敏感性会随着时间而改变 ，我们无法完全摆脱当下的心态。
Therefore , every age will have a slightly different perspective on the same period of the past , no matter what the facts are .
因此 ，无论事实如何 ，每个时代对过去同一时期的看法都会略有不同。

text: A university is not a business. More precisely, a not-for-proﬁt college or university is signiﬁcantly diﬀerent than a for-proﬁt business. A university has no owners it is a public trust. Without owners, it has no one to pay dividends to, and no one for whom it must maximise its proﬁts. A business has a single overriding goal: the maximisation of return for the owners. A university has a multiplicity of goals: to foster learning, to create knowledge, and to serve its community.
translations: A university is not a business .大学不是企业。
More precisely, a not-for-profit college or university is significantly different than a for-profit business .更准确地说 ，非营利性学院或大学与营利性企业有很大不同。
A university has no owners it is a public trust.大学没有所有者 ，这是公众的信任。
Without owners , it has no one to pay dividends to , and no one for whom it must maximise its profits .没有所有者 ， 它就没有分红的对象 ，也没有使它能利润最大化的人。
A business has a single overriding goal: the maximisation of return for the owners .企业只有一个首要目标： 为所有者带来最大的回报。
A university has a multiplicity of goals: to foster learning , to create knowledge , and to serve its community.大学有多种目标： 促进学习 ，创造知识并为社区服务。

text: Britain, then, was slower to create and develop a police force than the rest of Europe. France had one long before indeed, the word police is taken from the French. This fact was not unimportant, as the very idea of a police force was seen as foreign as that is, French and particularly undesirable, and was generally regarded as a form of oppression.
translations: Britain , then , was slower to create and develop a police force than the rest of Europe .那时 ，英国的建立和发展警察队伍的速度比欧洲其他地区要慢。
France had one long before indeed , the word police is taken from the French.实际上 ，法国在很早以前就已经把“警察 ”一词取入囊中。
This fact was not unimportant , as the very idea of a police force was seen as foreign as that is , French and particularly undesirable , and was generally regarded as a form of oppression .
这一事实并非无关紧要 ， 因为人们认为警察部队这个概念是外国的 ， 即法国人 ，且尤不可取 ，通常认为这是一种压迫。

text: This study marks the ﬁrst time scientists have linked dike formation to large, damaging earthquakes, and Wauthier is looking back through history for more examples. She says researchers will never be able to predict exactly when an earthquake might strike after a dike intrusion. But at least now, researchers and rift zone residents know they 're not just in for bangs they may also be in for shudders.
translations: This study marks the first time scientists have linked dike formation to large , damaging earthquakes , and Wauthier is looking back through history for more examples .
这项研究标志着科学家们首次将堤防的形成与破坏性大的地震联系起来 ，沃西尔正在回顾历史以寻找更多的例子。
She says researchers will never be able to predict exactly when an earthquake might strike after a dike intrusion .
她说 ，研究人员将永远无法准确预测堤防入侵后何时会发生地震。
But at least now, researchers and rift zone residents know they 're not just in for bangs they may also be in for shudders .
但是至少现在 ，研究人员和裂谷区居民知道他们不仅身在地震巨响中 ，而且可能也位于恐惧战栗中。

text: Study author Samuel Shian, a materials scientist, says this smart glass is cheaper than others, and uses minimal power much less, for example, than something like a curling iron. And since it 's ﬂexible and foldable, he says it could even be used for things like camouﬂage uniforms, to switch, for example, from green and brown to white and grey. "This would be very useful when the background landscape suddenly changes, such as during early snowfall. "
translations: Study author Samuel Shian , a materials scientist , says this smart glass is cheaper than others , and uses minimal power much less , for example , than something like a curling iron .
研究学者 ，材料科学家塞缪尔·施安说 ，这种智能玻璃比其他玻璃便宜 ，并且所消耗的电能 ，如卷发棒等 ，要少。
And since it 's flexible and foldable , he says it could even be used for things like camouflage uniforms , to switch , for example , from green and brown to white and grey.
他说 ， 由于它既灵活又可折叠 ， 因此甚至可以用于伪装成制服之类的东西 ，例如从绿色和棕色切换到白色和灰色。
"This would be very useful when the background landscape suddenly changes , such as during early snowfall. “ 当背景画面突然改变时 （ 例如在初降雪期间） ，将非常有用 。

text: "The caterpillars that feed on trees are trying to match the hatching of their eggs to the timing of bud burst. The caterpillars want to feed on the juiciest and least chemically protected leaves. And it 's not just the caterpillars, of course, that are important. But the knock-on eﬀect is on nesting birds, which are also trying to hatch their chicks at the same time that there 's the maximum number of caterpillars. "
translations: "The caterpillars that feed on trees are trying to match the hatching of their eggs to the timing of bud burst. “ 以树木为食的毛毛虫试图将卵的孵化与树芽萌发的时间相匹配。
The caterpillars want to feed on the juiciest and least chemically protected leaves .毛毛虫要以多汁且无农药的叶片为食。
And it 's not just the caterpillars , of course , that are important.当然 ，重要的不只是毛毛虫。
But the knock-on effect is on nesting birds , which are also trying to hatch their chicks at the same time that there 's the maximum number of caterpillars .
但是 ，连锁反应对筑巢的鸟类产生了影响 ， 它们也在试图在毛毛虫数量达到峰值的同时孵化雏鸟。

text: But they did ﬁnd something that had a much bigger impact on wildlife: habitat quality. The best predictor of wildlife abundance was not human activity, but factors like forest connectivity, nearby housing density, and the amount of adjacent agriculture. The results were published in the Journal of Applied Ecology.
translations: But they did find something that had a much bigger impact on wildlife: habitat quality.但是他们确实发现了一些对野生动植物影响更大的因素： 栖息地质量。
The best predictor of wildlife abundance was not human activity, but factors like forest connectivity, nearby housing density, and the amount of adjacent agriculture .
预测野生生物数量的最佳指标不是人类活动 ，而是诸如森林连通性 ， 附近房屋密度和邻近农业规模之类的因素。
The results were published in the Journal of Applied Ecology.此研究结果发表在《应用生态学杂志》 上。

text: Historically what has been used to estimate bats has been photographic estimates, visual estimates, mark-recapture estimates, and those have been highly prone to bias. Newer technology, like thermal imaging cameras is accurate, but expensive. So at a time of epic bat mortality-due to, for example, the fungal white-nose syndrome that 's wiping out bats in Canada and the U. S. Kloepper says her method might be a cheap, reliable way to determine the most critical caves to save.
translations: Historically what has been used to estimate bats has been photographic estimates , visual estimates , mark- recapture estimates , and those have been highly prone to bias .
从历史来看 ，用于估计蝙蝠的是摄影估计值 ，视觉估计值 ，标志重捕估计值 ，而这些很容易产生偏差。
Newer technology, like thermal imaging cameras is accurate , but expensive .像热像仪这样的较新技术是准确的 ，但价格昂贵。
So at a time of epic bat mortality-due to , for example , the fungal white-nose syndrome that 's wiping out bats in Canada and the U. S.
所以在蝙蝠死亡的史诗之际 ，例如 ， 由于真菌白鼻综合症正在消失的加拿大和美国的蝙蝠
Kloepper says her method might be a cheap , reliable way to determine the most critical caves to save .克洛珀说 ，她的方法可能是一种便宜 ，可靠的方法 ，能够确定出需要保护关键洞穴。

text: In the Middle Ages, the design and use of ﬂags were considered a means of identifying social status. Flags were, therefore, the symbols not of nations, but of the nobility. The design of each ﬂag resembled the "devices "on the noble 's Coat of Arms, and the size of the ﬂags was an indication of how high the owner stood in the nobility.
translations: In the Middle Ages , the design and use of flags were considered a means of identifying social status .在中世纪 ，人们认为标志的设计和使用是识别社会地位的一种手段。
Flags were , therefore , the symbols not of nations , but of the nobility.因此 ，旗帜不是国家的象征 ，而是神圣的象征。
The design of each flag resembled the "devices "on the noble 's Coat of Arms , and the size of the flags was an indication of how high the owner stood in the nobility.
每个旗帜的设计都类似于贵族的纹章上的“装置 ” ，旗帜的大小表明了主人在贵族中的地位。

text: History rubs shoulders and often overlaps with many other areas of research, from myths and epics to the social sciences, including economics, politics, biography, demography, and much else besides. Some histories are almost pure narratives, while others go in for detailed, tightly-focused analyses of, for example, the parish records of a Cornish village in the 16th century.
translations: History rubs shoulders and often overlaps with many other areas of research , from myths and epics to the social sciences , including economics , politics , biography, demography, and much else besides .
历史经常与许多其他研究领域并肩和重叠 ，从神话 ，史诗到社会科学 ，包括经济学 ，政治 ，传记 ，人口统计学以及其他许多领域。
Some histories are almost pure narratives , while others go in for detailed , tightly-focused analyses of , for example , the parish records of a Cornish village in the 16th century.
有些历史几乎是纯粹的叙述 ，而另一些历史则进行了详细 ，重点突出的分析 ，例如对16世纪康沃尔村庄的教区记录的分析。

text: Analysts were impressed by the improvement in margins reported across all regions, apart from the United Kingdom, and said that this reﬂected a clear eﬀort to improve proﬁtability across the business. Although the turnaround is still in its early stages and the valuation looks full, given the challenge of restructuring a complex business, this is certainly an impressive start.
translations: Analysts were impressed by the improvement in margins reported across all regions , apart from the United Kingdom , and said that this reflected a clear effort to improve profitability across the business .
分析师对除英国外的所有地区利润率的改善印象深刻 ，并表⽰这反映了为提高整个业务盈利能力而做出的明显努力。
Although the turnaround is still in its early stages and the valuation looks full , given the challenge of restructuring a complex business , this is certainly an impressive start.
尽管扭亏为盈仍处于早期阶段 ，估值看起来很充分 ，但考虑到重组复杂业务的挑战 ，这无疑是一个令人印象深刻的开始。

text: Not a lot is known about how the transportation of goods by water ﬁrst began. Large cargo boats were being used in some parts of the world up to ﬁve thousand years ago. However, sea trade became more widespread when large sailing boats travelled between ports, carrying spices, perfumes, and objects made by hand.
translations: Not a lot is known about how the transportation of goods by water first began .关于水路运输是如何开始的 ， 目前知之甚少。
Large cargo boats were being used in some parts of the world up to five thousand years ago .五千年前 ，世界某些地区已经在使用大型货船了。
However, sea trade became more widespread when large sailing boats travelled between ports , carrying spices , perfumes , and objects made by hand.
但是 ， 当大型帆船在港口之间穿行 ，携带香料 ，香水和手工制品时 ，海上贸易开始变得更加普遍了。

text: Market research is a vital part of the planning of any business. However experienced you or your staﬀ may be in a particular ﬁeld if you are thinking of introducing a service to a new area. It is important to ﬁnd out what the local population thinks about it ﬁrst.
translations: Market research is a vital part of the planning of any business .市场研究是任何企业计划中至关重要的部分。
However experienced you or your staff may be in a particular field if you are thinking of introducing a service to a new area .
如果你想将服务引入新领域 ，无论你或你的员工在各自领域内经验如何丰富 ，都是如此。
It is important to find out what the local population thinks about it first.重要的是要首先了解当地居民对此的看法。

text: The speaker is a marine biologist who became interested in the Strandlopers, an ancient people who lived on the coastline, because of their connection to the sea. Their way of life intrigued him. As a child he had spent a lot of time by the sea, exploring and collecting things so he began to study them, and discovered some interesting information about their way of life, how they hunted, what tools they used, and so on.
translations: The speaker is a marine biologist who became interested in the Strandlopers , an ancient people who lived on the coastline , because of their connection to the sea .
演讲者是一位海洋生物学家 ，他对斯特兰特卢珀人感兴趣 ，斯特兰特卢珀人是一个生活在海岸线上的古老民族 ，他们与大海息息相关。
Their way of life intrigued him .他们的生活方怯吸引了他。

As a child he had spent a lot of time by the sea , exploring and collecting things so he began to study them , and discovered some interesting information about their way of life , how they hunted , what tools they used , and so on .
小时候 ，他常在海边探索 ，收集东西 ， 因此他开始研究这些人 ，并发现了一些有关他们的生活方怯 ，狩猎方怯 ，使用的工具等有趣的信息。

text: For centuries, Atlantis has been one of the western world 's favourite legends, a tantalising blend of fantasy and mystery. Stories tell of a rich and glorious empire that was lost to the sea, where some hope its ruins still lie, waiting to be discovered.
translations: For centuries , Atlantis has been one of the western world 's favourite legends , a tantalising blend of fantasy and mystery.
几个世纪以来 ，亚特兰蒂斯一直是西方世界最喜欢的传奇人物之一 ，他将幻想与神秘融合在一起。
幻想和神秘的诱人融合。
Stories tell of a rich and glorious empire that was lost to the sea , where some hope its ruins still lie , waiting to be discovered.
故事讲述了一个富裕而光荣的帝国 ，这个帝国已经深藏大海 ，一些人希望它遗迹尤存 ，待人发掘。

text: The audio, which includes more than 1, 000 separate data ﬁles, was captured in the early 1970 s by the late Hetty van de Rijt. She recorded the various screams, barks, and hoo calls made by a group of chimps, including 17 youngsters, living in the Gombe National Park in Tanzania.
translations: The audio , which includes more than 1 , 000 separate data files , was captured in the early 1970 s by the late Hetty van de Rijt.
已故的 Hetty van de Rijt 在 1970 年代初捕获了音频 ，其中包括 1 ,000 多个单独的数据文件。
She recorded the various screams , barks , and hoo calls made by a group of chimps , including 17 youngsters , living in the Gombe National Park in Tanzania .
她记录了一群黑猩猩发出的各种尖叫、 吼叫和呼喊声 ，其中包括 17 只生活在坦桑尼亚 贡贝国家公园的黑猩猩。

text: Dolphins, whales, and porpoises are all social animals, but some species are more sociable than others. This depends on the environment because a species adopts the lifestyle most suitable for this. Among dolphins, forming groups makes it easier for them to ﬁnd food, reproduce and gain knowledge. They are safer, too, because dolphins can communicate danger when there are threats around.
translations: Dolphins , whales , and porpoises are all social animals , but some species are more sociable than others .海豚 ，鲸鱼和海豚都是社交动物 ，但一些物种比其他物种更善于交际。
This depends on the environment because a species adopts the lifestyle most suitable for this .而这取决于环境因素 ， 因为一个物种会采用最能适应环境的生活方怯。
Among dolphins , forming groups makes it easier for them to find food , reproduce and gain knowledge .在海豚中 ，成群结对使他们更容易找到食物 ，繁殖和获取知识。
They are safer, too , because dolphins can communicate danger when there are threats around.它们也更安全 ， 因为当周围有威胁时 ，海豚可以传递危险信号。

text: It 's not that human activities didn 't impact wildlife at all of course. Heavily hunted species, like white-tailed deer, grey squirrels, and raccoons, were photographed somewhat less often in hunted areas. Coyotes showed up more often in hunted areas. While most species didn 't avoid hiding trails, the predators actually preferred them.
translations: It 's not that human activities didn 't impact wildlife at all of course .当然 ，这并不是说人类活动不会对野生动植物产生任何影响。
Heavily hunted species , like white-tailed deer, grey squirrels , and raccoons , were photographed somewhat less often in hunted areas .
在狩猎区能拍摄到的猎物种类繁多 ，例如白尾鹿 ，灰松鼠和浣熊。
Coyotes showed up more often in hunted areas .土狼在狩猎区出现的频率更高。
While most species didn 't avoid hiding trails , the predators actually preferred them .尽管大多数物种都隐藏活动路径 ，但捕食者实际上更喜欢它们。

text: The second group that is particularly vulnerable are night shift workers and the third group that is particularly vulnerable are people with sleep disorders, particularly sleep apnea. One out of three men and one out of six women have sleep apnea. And yet, 85 percent are undiagnosed and untreated. And it more than doubles the risk of crashes.
translations: The second group that is particularly vulnerable are night shift workers and the third group that is particularly vulnerable are people with sleep disorders , particularly sleep apnea .
第二类脆弱群体是夜班工人 ，第三类脆弱群体是患有睡眠障碍 ，尤其是睡眠呼吸暂停的人。
One out of three men and one out of six women have sleep apnea .三分之二的男性和六分之一的女性患有睡眠呼吸暂停。
And yet , 85 percent are undiagnosed and untreated.但是 ，有85％ 的人未接受诊断和治疗。
And it more than doubles the risk of crashes .而且它使睡眠的风险增加了一倍以上。

text: Networking is easy and fun because it taps into this human predilection to talk about ourselves when asked. Consider successful networking as little more than the process of guiding a person to tell you about his life, what he 's doing, the company that employs him, and his current industry.
translations: Networking is easy and fun because it taps into this human predilection to talk about ourselves when asked.网络既简单又有趣 ， 因为它能根据人类的偏好在受访问时展⽰人类自 己。
Consider successful networking as little more than the process of guiding a person to tell you about his life , what he 's doing , the company that employs him , and his current industry.
成功的网络就像指导一个人向你介绍他的生活 ，他在做什么 ，他任职的公司以及他当前的行业 ，类似这样的一个过程。

text: For the purposes of argument, culture is divided into material and non-material, and the speaker 's aim is to show how they both aﬀect each other. Material developments in tools and technology can aﬀect non-material culture, our customs and beliefs, and the other way around. Genetics is used as an example as it has changed the way we think about life, but also our beliefs have aﬀected its rate of development.
translations: For the purposes of argument , culture is divided into material and non-material , and the speaker 's aim is to show how they both affect each other.
从论证的目的来看 ，文化可分为物质文化和非物质文化 ，说话者的目的是表明它们间如何相互影响。
Material developments in tools and technology can affect non-material culture , our customs and beliefs , and the other way around.
工具和技术的实质性发展会影响非物质文化 ， 习俗以及其他方面。
Genetics is used as an example as it has changed the way we think about life , but also our beliefs have affected its rate of development.
以遗传学为例 ， 它改变了我们对生活的看法 ，但我们的信念也影响了其发展速度。

text: Usually, age is determined by physical characteristics, such as teeth or bones. Great, if you have a body. Researchers have tried unsuccessfully to use blood. But in this study, the scientists used immune cells called T-cells. T-cells recognise invaders through receptors that match molecules on bacteria, viruses, even tumours. The cellular activity that produces these receptors also produces a type of circular DNA molecule as a by-product.
translations: Usually, age is determined by physical characteristics , such as teeth or bones .通常 ，年龄是由诸如牙齿或骨骼等物理特征来决定的。
Great , if you have a body.
如果你有一个身体那就太好了。
Researchers have tried unsuccessfully to use blood.研究人员尝试使用血液来研究 ，但失败了。
But in this study, the scientists used immune cells called T-cells .但是在这项研究中 ，科学家使用了名为T细胞的免疫细胞。
T-cells recognise invaders through receptors that match molecules on bacteria , viruses , even tumours . T细胞通过与细菌 ，病毒甚至肿瘤上的分子相匹配的受体识别入侵者。
The cellular activity that produces these receptors also produces a type of circular DNA molecule as a by- product.
产生这些受体的细胞也产生一种环状DNA分子作为副产物。

text: "Thompson recognised and exploited all the ingredients of a successful amusement ride, "writes Judith A. Adams in The American Amusement Park Industry. "His coasters combined an appearance of danger with actual safety, thrilled riders with exhilarating speed, and allowed the public to intimately experience the Industrial Revolution 's new technologies of gears, steel, and dazzling electric lights. "
translations: "Thompson recognised and exploited all the ingredients of a successful amusement ride , "writes Judith A. Adams in The American Amusement Park Industry.
美国娱乐公园产业的朱迪思·亚当斯写道： “ 汤普森认识到并利用了一项成功的游乐设施所需的所有因素。 ”

" His coasters combined an appearance of danger with actual safety, thrilled riders with exhilarating speed , and allowed the public to intimately experience the Industrial Revolution 's new technologies of gears , steel , and
dazzling electric lights .
“他的过山车将危险的外观与实际的安全性结合在一起 ，加上刺激的速度 ，让游客们激动不已 ，使得公众能亲身体验工业革命包括齿轮 ，钢和炫目电灯在内的一些新技术。 ”

text: The tsunamis could provide crucial information about the habitability of ancient Mars. The ﬁrst one occurred when the planet must have been relatively warm and amenable for life, because it carved out backwash channels as it returned to the sea. By contrast, the planet had become much cooler by the time the second tsunami hit, the waters apparently ﬂash- froze after ﬂowing onto the surface.
translations: The tsunamis could provide crucial information about the habitability of ancient Mars .海啸可以提供有关古代火星宜居性的重要信息。
The first one occurred when the planet must have been relatively warm and amenable for life , because it carved out backwash channels as it returned to the sea .
第一次海啸发生的时候 ，地球肯定还是相对温暖和宜居的 ， 因为它在返回大海时就冲刷出了回流渠道。
By contrast , the planet had become much cooler by the time the second tsunami hit , the waters apparently flash-froze after flowing onto the surface .
相比之下 ，第二次海啸来袭时 ，地球会变得凉爽很多 ，水流流入地表后显然会冻住。

text: There are three main interpretations of the English Revolution. The longest lasting interpretation was that the Revolution was the almost inevitable outcome of an age-old power struggle between parliament and crown. The second sees it as a class struggle and a lead-up to the French and other revolutions. Finally, the third interpretation sees the other two as too ﬁxed, not allowing for unpredictability, and that the outcome could have gone either way.
translations: There are three main interpretations of the English Revolution .对于英国革命主要有三种解释。
The longest lasting interpretation was that the Revolution was the almost inevitable outcome of an age-old power struggle between parliament and crown .
最持久的一个解释是 ，革命几乎是议会与王室之间古老的权力斗争的必然结果。
The second sees it as a class struggle and a lead-up to the French and other revolutions .第二个解释认为这是阶级斗争 ，是法国和其他革命的先驱。
Finally, the third interpretation sees the other two as too fixed , not allowing for unpredictability, and that the outcome could have gone either way.
最后 ，第三种解释认为其他两种过于固定 ，没有包含不确定性 ，两种结局都有可能。

text: Reiss took a stab at settling the argument with a meta-analysis, a study of studies, on whether people can really perceive better-than CD quality sound. He analysed data from 18 studies, including more than 400 participants and nearly 13,000 listening tests. Overall, listeners picked out the better-than CD quality track 52.3 percent of the time. Statistically signiﬁcant, if not all that impressive.
translations: Reiss took a stab at settling the argument with a meta-analysis , a study of studies , on whether people can really perceive better-than CD quality sound.
瑞斯试图通过荟萃分析来解释这一论点 ， 即人们是否真的能感知到比CD品质更好的声音。
He analysed data from 18 studies , including more than 400 participants and nearly 13 ,000 listening tests .他分析了18项研究的数据 ，包括400多名参与者和近13 ,000项听力测试。
Overall , listeners picked out the better-than CD quality track 52.3 percent of the time .总体而言 ，52.3％ 的时间听众都选择了优于CD品质的音轨。
Statistically significant , if not all that impressive .在统计学上有意义 ，但没那么令人印象深刻。

text: There are perhaps three ways of looking at furniture: some people see it as purely functional and useful, and don 't bother themselves with aesthetics; others see it as essential to civilised living and concern themselves with design and how the furniture will look in a room-in other words, function combined with aesthetics; and yet others see furniture as a form of art.
translations: There are perhaps three ways of looking at furniture: some people see it as purely functional and useful , and don 't bother themselves with aesthetics;
对家具看法可能有三种： 有些人认为家具纯粹只具备功能性 ，且不会为美学而烦恼。
others see it as essential to civilised living and concern themselves with design and how the furniture will look in a room-in other words , function combined with aesthetics;
其他人则认为这对文明生活至关重要 ，他们关心设计以及家具在房间中的外观 ，换言之 ，功能与美学相结合；
and yet others see furniture as a form of art.还有一些人将家具视为一种艺术形怯。

text: Currently, integration is increasingly needed in the business environment. This need emerges from the eﬃciency and synergy requirements necessary in a complex and turbulent environment. In other words, integration is needed to facilitate coordination, which is again related to the building of competitive advantage.
translations: Currently, integration is increasingly needed in the business environment.当前 ，企业环境越来越需要一体化。
This need emerges from the efficiency and synergy requirements necessary in a complex and turbulent environment.
在复杂而动荡的环境中 ，这种需要产生于必要的效率和协同要求。
In other words , integration is needed to facilitate coordination , which is again related to the building of competitive advantage .
换句话说 ，一体化需要用来促进协调 ，这又与建立竞争优势有关。

text: A recent trend in the entertainment world is to adapt classic works of literature for either TV or movies. One argument is that this is to everyone 's beneﬁt, as it introduces people to works they might otherwise never have, but is rarely done successfully.
translations: A recent trend in the entertainment world is to adapt classic works of literature for either TV or movies .娱乐圈的最新趋势是将经典文学作品改编为电视剧或电影。
One argument is that this is to everyone 's benefit , as it introduces people to works they might otherwise never have , but is rarely done successfully.
一种说法是 ，这对每个人都有好处 ， 因为它向人们介绍了一种作品 ，这种作品他们原本可能从未接触过也很难完全理解。

text: As a historian, if you really want to understand the sensibilities of those who lived in the past, you must be like a novelist and get into the skins of your characters and think and feel as they do. You are asked to imagine what it 's like to be a peasant in mediaeval times, asking the sort of questions a peasant might ask. What the writer is saying is that a historian needs imaginative sympathy with ordinary people in the past.
translations: As a historian , if you really want to understand the sensibilities of those who lived in the past , you must be like a novelist and get into the skins of your characters and think and feel as they do .
作为历史学家 ，如果你真的想了解过去的人们 ，那么就必须像小说家一样 ，深入角色并像他们一样去思考和感受。
You are asked to imagine what it 's like to be a peasant in mediaeval times , asking the sort of questions a peasant might ask.
你可以想象在中世纪成为农民是什么样的 ， 问一些农民会问的问题。
What the writer is saying is that a historian needs imaginative sympathy with ordinary people in the past.作者的意思是 ，历史学家需要有想象力地共情于过去的普通百姓。

text: Many papers you write in college will require you to include quotes from one or more sources. Even if you don 't have to do it, integrating a few quotes into your writing can add life and persuasiveness to your arguments. The key is to use quotes to support a point you 're trying to make rather than just include them to ﬁll space.
translations: Many papers you write in college will require you to include quotes from one or more sources .你在大学撰写的许多论文都要求引用一个或多个文献。
Even if you don 't have to do it , integrating a few quotes into your writing can add life and persuasiveness to your arguments .
即使你不必这样做 ，但在写作中加入一些引用内容也可以给论点增添生气 ，增强说服力。
The key is to use quotes to support a point you 're trying to make rather than just include them to fill space .关键是引用内容来支持你要提出的观点 ，而不仅仅是把它们加进来凑字数。

text: Researchers gathered 160 uncaﬀeinated adults, people who consumed less than 500 milligrammes of caﬀeine a week. These decaf subjects looked at pictures of various objects, then took either a placebo or a pill containing 200 milligrammes of caﬀeine. That 's roughly the amount you 'd get from two cups of coﬀee.
translations: Researchers gathered 160 uncaffeinated adults , people who consumed less than 500 milligrammes of caffeine a week.
研究人员收集了 160 名未摄入咖啡因的成年人 ，他们每周摄入的咖啡因少于 500 毫克。
These decaf subjects looked at pictures of various objects , then took either a placebo or a pill containing 200 milligrammes of caffeine .
这些不含咖啡因的受试者观看了各种物体的图片 ，然后服用安慰剂或含有 200 毫克咖啡因的药丸。
That 's roughly the amount you 'd get from two cups of coffee .这大约是你从两杯咖啡中得到的量。

text: Yellow is the most optimistic colour, yet surprisingly, people lose their tempers most often in yellow rooms and babies cry more often in them. The reason may be that yellow is the hardest colour on the eye. On the other hand, it speeds up metabolism and enhances concentration; think of yellow legal pads and post-it notes.
translations: Yellow is the most optimistic colour, yet surprisingly, people lose their tempers most often in yellow rooms and babies cry more often in them .
黄色是最乐观的颜色 ，但令人惊讶的是 ，人们经常在黄色房间里发脾气 ，而婴儿在黄色房间里哭泣的频率更高。
The reason may be that yellow is the hardest colour on the eye .原因可能是黄色是人眼看来最扎眼的颜色。
On the other hand , it speeds up metabolism and enhances concentration;另一方面 ， 它可以加速新陈代谢 ，提高注意力。
think of yellow legal pads and post-it notes .比如黄色的拍纸本和便利贴。

text: It seems that language appeared from nowhere since no other species has anything resembling human language. However, other animals do possess basic systems for perceiving and producing sounds that enable them to communicate. These systems may have been in place before the appearance of language.
translations: It seems that language appeared from nowhere since no other species has anything resembling human language .
语言似乎无处不在 ， 因为没有其他物种和人类一样拥有语言。
However, other animals do possess basic systems for perceiving and producing sounds that enable them to communicate .
但是 ，其他动物确实拥有一套基本系统 ，这个系统能够让它们感知和接收到用来互相交流的声音。
These systems may have been in place before the appearance of language .这些系统可能在语言出现之前就已经存在了。

text: The student 's reading in his own subject slows down, and his comprehension becomes less secure. He expresses himself slowly and often fails to convey his ideas exactly. He is disappointed to ﬁnd out that under pressure he makes a lot of unnecessary mistakes in areas where he knows the correct language forms. His social relations are diﬃcult as he cannot ﬁnd the right phrase quickly enough to keep a conversation going, so his language often betrays him into dullness, coldness, or worst of all, rudeness. Instead of the students being in control of the language, the language seems now to be in control of the students.
translations: The student 's reading in his own subject slows down , and his comprehension becomes less secure .学生在他自己学科中的阅读速度变慢 ，那么他的理解能力也没那么准确了。
He expresses himself slowly and often fails to convey his ideas exactly.他表达缓慢 ，经常无法准确传达自己的想法。
He is disappointed to find out that under pressure he makes a lot of unnecessary mistakes in areas where he knows the correct language forms .
他很失望地发现 ，在有压力时 ，他明知道正确的语言规范 ，却还是犯了很多不该犯的错误。

His social relations are difficult as he cannot find the right phrase quickly enough to keep a conversation going , so his language often betrays him into dullness , coldness , or worst of all , rudeness .
他的社交关系很困难 ， 因为他不能够迅速地找到正确的词组来进行对话 ， 因此他的语言经常出卖他的本意 ，使他陷入于沉闷 ，冷漠甚至是没礼貌的境地。
Instead of the students being in control of the language , the language seems now to be in control of the students .
似乎不是学生在掌控语言 ，而是语言在掌控学生。

text: In the past, naming English as a separate subject seemed relatively easy. The textbook selected and graded items of language which were put into content and then practised intensively. New items were carefully controlled so that the student could cope quite easily. Now that English is used as a medium of instruction, however, all of this has changed. Unknown items of grammar and vocabulary appear in texts which attempt to explain new and often diﬃcult information. Diﬃculties with the language interact with diﬃculties as regards to the subject matter.
translations: In the past , naming English as a separate subject seemed relatively easy.过去将英语命名为单独的学科似乎相对容易。
The textbook selected and graded items of language which were put into content and then practised intensively.
教科书对语言进行筛选和分级 ，然后将其制作成内容 ，并进行深入练习。
New items were carefully controlled so that the student could cope quite easily.新任务的添加较为谨慎 ， 以便学生可以轻松应对。
Now that English is used as a medium of instruction , however, all of this has changed.由于英语已用作教学语言 ，但所有情况都发生了变化。
Unknown items of grammar and vocabulary appear in texts which attempt to explain new and often difficult information .
一些未知的语法和词汇任务出现在文本中 ，试图解释新的且通常难以理解的信息点。
Difficulties with the language interact with difficulties as regards to the subject matter.导致了语言上的困难与学科问题上的困难相互交织在一起。

text: IT may well change the way you live, yet again. Welcome to the world of mobile commerce, where your hand-held device, it 's a mobile phone, a personal digital assistant or any other wireless application will soon be used for commercial transactions. Sceptical? Consider these facts in Japan, mobile phones are used for location-based services where the mobile service provider ties-up with a host of other players such as restaurants or car rental companies.
translations: IT may well change the way you live , yet again . IT 很可能会再次改变您的生活方怯。

Welcome to the world of mobile commerce , where your hand-held device , it 's a mobile phone , a personal digital assistant or any other wireless application will soon be used for commercial transactions .
欢迎来到移动商务世界 ，您的手持设备 （ 移动电话、个人数字助理或任何其他无线应用程序） 很快将用于商业交易。
Sceptical?持怀疑态度？
Consider these facts in Japan , mobile phones are used for location-based services where the mobile service provider ties-up with a host of other players such as restaurants or car rental companies .
考虑一下日本的这些事实 ，移动电话用于基于位置的服务 ，其中移动服务提供商与餐馆或汽车租赁公司等许多其他参与者合作。

text: The coastal wetlands have environmental and economic importance. Wetlands provide natural wealth. They have important ﬁltering capabilities. As the runoﬀ water passes, they retain excess nutrients and some pollutants. They maintain water ﬂow during dry periods. Thousands of people depend on groundwater for drinking. They act as natural sponges of ﬂood waters and contain soil erosion. They control ﬂoods and save buildings from collapsing during heavy rains. The hardwood-riparian wetlands along the Mississippi River can store sixty days of ﬂoodwater.
translations: The coastal wetlands have environmental and economic importance .沿海湿地具有环境层面和经济层面上的重要性。
Wetlands provide natural wealth.湿地为大自然提供了财富。
They have important filtering capabilities .它们具有重要的过滤功能。
As the runoff water passes , they retain excess nutrients and some pollutants .随着径流水的通过 ， 它们保留了过量的养分和一些污染物。
They maintain water flow during dry periods .它们在干旱时期保持水流。
Thousands of people depend on groundwater for drinking.成千上万的人靠地下水饮用为生。
They act as natural sponges of flood waters and contain soil erosion .它们充当洪水的天然海绵并抑制土壤侵蚀。
They control floods and save buildings from collapsing during heavy rains .它们控制洪水 ，并避免大雨时建筑物倒塌。
The hardwood-riparian wetlands along the Mississippi River can store sixty days of floodwater.密西西比河沿岸的硬木河岸湿地可储存六十天的洪水。

text: Analysts were impressed by the improvement in margins reported across all regions, apart from the United Kingdom, and said that this reﬂected a clear eﬀort to improve proﬁtability across the business. Although the turnaround is still in its early stages and the valuation looks full, given the challenge of turning around such a large and complex business, this is certainly an impressive start.
translations: Analysts were impressed by the improvement in margins reported across all regions , apart from the United Kingdom , and said that this reflected a clear effort to improve profitability across the business .
除英国以外 ，所有地区的利润率的提高都给分析师留下了深刻的印象 ，他们表⽰这反映出努力为提高整个公司的盈利举动。
Although the turnaround is still in its early stages and the valuation looks full , given the challenge of turning around such a large and complex business , this is certainly an impressive start.
尽管转机仍初见起色 ，估值看起来很可观 ，但鉴于要扭转如此庞大和复杂业务的 ，这无疑是一个令人印象深刻的开始。

text: In a genuine republic, the will of the government is dependent on the will of the society, and the will of the society is dependent on the reason of the society. In Federalist 51, for example, James Madison claimed that the extent and structure of the government of the United States make it dependent on the will of the society.
translations: In a genuine republic , the will of the government is dependent on the will of the society, and the will of the society is dependent on the reason of the society.
在真正的共和国中 ，政府的意志取决于社会的意志 ，社会的意志取决于社会的理性。
In Federalist 51 , for example , James Madison claimed that the extent and structure of the government of the United States make it dependent on the will of the society.
比如 ，在《联邦制51》 中 ，詹姆斯·麦迪逊称 ，美国政府的规模和结构使其依赖于社会的意志。

text: In 2005, donor countries agreed on an accord to harmonise their practises. Since then, aid oﬃcials have complained that too little has changed on the ground. Conferences of donors in developing countries still tend to be dominated by a small group of north European governments, with the US often absent.
translations: In 2005 , donor countries agreed on an accord to harmonise their practises . 2005年 ，捐助国商定了一项协议 ， 以统一其做法。
Since then , aid officials have complained that too little has changed on the ground.从那时起 ，援助官员一直抱怨实地变化太小。
Conferences of donors in developing countries still tend to be dominated by a small group of north European governments , with the US often absent.
发展中国家的捐助者会议仍由一小部分北欧政府主导 ，美国经常缺席此次会议。

text: The climate for doing business improved in Egypt more than in any other country last year, according to a global study that revealed a wave of company-oriented reforms across the Middle East. The World Bank rankings, which look at business regulations, also showed that the pace of business reforms in Eastern Europe was overtaking East Asia.
translations: The climate for doing business improved in Egypt more than in any other country last year, according to a global study that revealed a wave of company-oriented reforms across the Middle East.
一项全球性研究显⽰ ，埃及的经商环境比去年任何其他国家都大有改观 ，整个中东地区掀起了以公司为导向的改革浪潮。
The World Bank rankings , which look at business regulations , also showed that the pace of business reforms in Eastern Europe was overtaking East Asia .
世界银行对商业法规的排名也表明 ， 东欧商业改革的步伐已经超过了东亚。

text: One of the unidentiﬁable objects in this study lies just outside Centaurus NGC 5128, an elliptical galaxy located about 12 million light-years from Earth. The other is in a globular cluster of stars found just outside NGC 4636, another elliptical galaxy located 47 million light-years from Earth in the constellation Virgo.
translations: One of the unidentifiable objects in this study lies just outside Centaurus NGC 5128 , an elliptical galaxy located about 12 million light-years from Earth.
这项研究中 ，有一个无法识别的物体位于半人马座NGC 5128外面 ，这是一个椭圆形星系 ，位于距地球约1200万光年的地方。
The other is in a globular cluster of stars found just outside NGC 4636 , another elliptical galaxy located 47 million light-years from Earth in the constellation Virgo .
另一个是在NGC 4636外发现的球状星团中 ， NGC 4636是另一个椭圆形星系 ，位于处女座星座 ，距地球4700万光年。

text: Using more than ﬁfty interviews, award-winning writer Danny Danziger creates a fascinating mosaic of the people behind New York 's magniﬁcent Metropolitan Museum of Art from the aristocratic, acerbic director of the museum, Philippe de Montebello, to the curators who have a deep knowledge and passionate appreciation of their collections, from the security guards to the philanthropists who keep the museum 's ﬁnancial lifeblood ﬂowing.
translations: Using more than fifty interviews , award-winning writer Danny Danziger creates a fascinating mosaic of the
people behind New York 's magnificent Metropolitan Museum of Art from the aristocratic , acerbic director of

the museum , Philippe de Montebello , to the curators who have a deep knowledge and passionate appreciation of their collections , from the security guards to the philanthropists who keep the museum 's financial lifeblood flowing.
获奖作家丹尼·丹兹格经过五十多次的走访 ，为纽约宏伟的大都会艺术博物馆幕后的人们创作了迷人的马赛克画 ，这些人从纽约大都会博物馆的贵族导演菲利普·德·蒙特贝罗 ，到博物馆里资历深厚经验丰富 ，盛赞馆藏的策展人 ，从安保人员到慈善家 ，是他们延续了博物馆的财务命脉。

text: Unions take the power out of the employer 's hands on many issues. There are examples of cases where the workers were engaging in sexual or racial harassment, but were protected by their unions and allowed to keep their jobs. Poor workers and excellent workers often receive the same pay and raise, giving no reason for a person to work harder than necessary at their jobs.
translations: Unions take the power out of the employer 's hands on many issues .在许多问题上 ，工会从雇主手中夺走了决定权。
There are examples of cases where the workers were engaging in sexual or racial harassment , but were protected by their unions and allowed to keep their jobs .
在某些情况下 ，工人参与了性骚扰或种族骚扰 ，但却受工会的保护仍可以继续工作。
Poor workers and excellent workers often receive the same pay and raise , giving no reason for a person to work harder than necessary at their jobs .
差劲的工人和优秀的工人通常同薪同酬 ，就使得一个人没理由去努力工作了。

text: Trade unions originated in Europe during the industrial revolution. Because of the machinery that had become commonplace, skilled labour became less in demand so employers had nearly all of the bargaining power. Employers mistreated the workers and paid them too little for the work they did. Trade unions were organised that would help in the improvement of working conditions.
translations: Trade unions originated in Europe during the industrial revolution .在工业革命期间 ，工会起源于欧洲。
Because of the machinery that had become commonplace , skilled labour became less in demand so employers had nearly all of the bargaining power.
由于机器已变得司空见惯 ，对技术工人的需求就减少了 ， 因此雇主几乎拥有绝对的议价能力。
Employers mistreated the workers and paid them too little for the work they did.雇主虐待工人 ，他们付给工人的工资太少。
Trade unions were organised that would help in the improvement of working conditions .工会得以组建 ， 以帮助改善工人的工作条件。

text: Unlike the United Kingdom, which has taken a relatively restrictive approach on the possession of arms, the United States has taken a more lenient approach. In the United States, three models have evolved regarding the interpretation of the meaning of the right to bear and keep arms as delineated in the Second Amendment.
translations: Unlike the United Kingdom , which has taken a relatively restrictive approach on the possession of arms , the United States has taken a more lenient approach.
与英国不同 ，对持有武器采取相对限制的方法 ，美国则采取更为宽容的方法。
In the United States , three models have evolved regarding the interpretation of the meaning of the right to bear and keep arms as delineated in the Second Amendment.
在美国 ，关于“携带和持有武器的权利 ”含义的解释已经衍生出三种模怯 ，“ 第二修正案 ”中如是说道。

text: Free trade is an economic policy under which the government does not interfere with trade. No tariﬀs are applied to imports or exports, and people are allowed to trade goods and services as they please. Supply and demand dictate the prices for which goods and services sell and are the only factors that determine how resources are allocated to society.
translations: Free trade is an economic policy under which the government does not interfere with trade .自由贸易是政府不干预贸易的一项经济政策。
No tariffs are applied to imports or exports , and people are allowed to trade goods and services as they please .
进口或出口不征收关税 ，人们可以随意买卖商品 ，享受服务。
Supply and demand dictate the prices for which goods and services sell and are the only factors that determine how resources are allocated to society.
供求关系决定了商品和服务的销售价格 ，并且是决定如何向社会分配资源的唯一因素。

text: The border itself between Mexico and United States is fraught with a mix of urban and desert terrain and spans over 1, 900 miles. Both the uninhabited areas of the border and urban areas are where the most drug traﬃcking and illegal crossings take place. Crime is prevalent in urban cities like El Paso, Texas and San Diego, California.
translations: The border itself between Mexico and United States is fraught with a mix of urban and desert terrain and spans over 1 , 900 miles .
墨西哥和美国之间的边界遍布城市和沙漠地形 ，其跨度超过1900英里。
Both the uninhabited areas of the border and urban areas are where the most drug trafficking and illegal crossings take place .
边境无人区和市区都是贩毒和非法越境最多的地方。
Crime is prevalent in urban cities like El Paso , Texas and San Diego , California .在德克萨斯州的埃尔帕索和加利福尼亚的圣地亚哥等城市 ，犯罪现象十分普遍。

text: As far as politics go, the responses are just as varied. Mitigation is common and calls for a reduction of emissions and less reliance on fossil fuels. Coal-burning power plants are now replaced with hydraulic power plants and electric cars are replacing some gasoline eﬃcient cars. Many people, however, feel this is not enough.
translations: As far as politics go , the responses are just as varied. Mitigation is common and calls for a reduction of emissions and less reliance on fossil fuels .
就政治而言 ，应对措施多种多样。
Coal-burning power plants are now replaced with hydraulic power plants and electric cars are replacing some gasoline efficient cars .
减排是普遍现象 ， 它号召减少排放并降低对化石燃料的依赖。 如今水力发电厂取代了燃煤发电厂 ，而电动汽车也正替代节油汽车。
Many people , however, feel this is not enough.然而 ，许多人认为这样做还不够。

text: While the Republican ﬁeld is packed with male candidates, so far, some of the sharpest Clinton critics have come from women. Democrats successfully campaigned on an alleged GOP perpetrated "war on women "in 2012, but faltered in 2014 when they tried the same tactic. With Hillary Clinton as the likely Democratic nominee, the ﬁght for women voters will be a central part of the 2016 campaign.
translations: While the Republican field is packed with male candidates , so far, some of the sharpest Clinton critics have come from women .
虽然共和党遍布男性候选人 ，但到目前为止 ，克林顿最敏锐的批评家中有一些来自女性。
Democrats successfully campaigned on an alleged GOP perpetrated "war on women " in 2012 , but faltered in 2014 when they tried the same tactic .
民主党在2012年成功地开展了一场所谓共和党进行的“ 对妇女的战争 ”的竞选活动 ，但在2014年尝试同样的策略时却步履蹒跚。
With Hillary Clinton as the likely Democratic nominee , the fight for women voters will be a central part of the 2016 campaign .
随着希拉里·克林顿可能成为民主党候选人 ，争取女选民的斗争将成为2016年竞选的核心内容。

text: The Oﬃce of Personnel Management was the target of the attack, but data from nearly every government agency was stolen. U. S. investigators say they believe Chinese hackers were behind the breach.
translations: The Office of Personnel Management was the target of the attack , but data from nearly every government agency was stolen .
人事管理办公室是黑客攻击的目标 ，但几乎每个政府机构的数据都被盗了。
U. S. investigators say they believe Chinese hackers were behind the breach.美国调查人员说 ，他们认为中国黑客是此次攻击的幕后黑手。

text: Global warming is deﬁned as an increase in the average temperature of the earth 's atmosphere. This trend began in the middle of the 20th century and is one of the major environmental concerns of scientists and governmental oﬃcials worldwide. The changes in temperature result mostly from the eﬀect of increased concentrations of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere.
translations: Global warming is defined as an increase in the average temperature of the earth 's atmosphere .全球变暖的定义是地球大气平均温度的升高。
This trend began in the middle of the 20th century and is one of the major environmental concerns of scientists and governmental officials worldwide .
这种趋势始于20世纪中叶 ，是全世界科学家和政府官员关注的主要环境问题之一。
The changes in temperature result mostly from the effect of increased concentrations of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere .
温度的变化主要是受大气中温室气体浓度增加的影响。

text: Introvert, or those of us with introverted tendencies, tends to recharge by spending time alone. They lose energy from being around people for long periods of time, particularly large crowds.
