Extroverts, on the other hand, gain energy from other people. Extroverts actually ﬁnd their energy is sapped when they spend too much time alone. They recharge by being social.
translations: Introvert , or those of us with introverted tendencies , tends to recharge by spending time alone .内向的人 （ 或我们当中有内向倾向的人） 往往会花时间来充实自 己。
They lose energy from being around people for long periods of time , particularly large crowds .他们会因为长时间在人群中而失去精力 ，在人群众多的情况下尤甚。
Extroverts , on the other hand , gain energy from other people .另一方面 ，性格外向的人从别人那里获取能量。
Extroverts actually find their energy is sapped when they spend too much time alone .性格外向的人实际上发现 ， 当他们长时间独处时 ，他们的精力就会被消耗殆尽。
They recharge by being social.因为他们通过社交来充实自 己。

text: The brain is divided into two hemispheres, called the left and right hemispheres. Each hemisphere provided a diﬀerent set of functions, behaviours, and controls. The right hemisphere is often called the creative side of the brain, while the left hemisphere is the logical or analytic side of brain. The right hemisphere controlled the left parts of the body, and the left hemisphere controlled the right side.
translations: The brain is divided into two hemispheres , called the left and right hemispheres .大脑分为两个半球 ，称为左半球和右半球。
Each hemisphere provided a different set of functions , behaviours , and controls .每个半球提供了一组不同的功能、行为和控制。
The right hemisphere is often called the creative side of the brain , while the left hemisphere is the logical or analytic side of brain .
右半球通常被称为大脑的创造性部分 ，而左半球则被称为大脑的逻辑或分析部分。
The right hemisphere controlled the left parts of the body, and the left hemisphere controlled the right side .右半球控制身体的左侧部分 ，左半球控制身体的右侧。

text: Since Plato, philosophers have described the decision-making process as either rational or emotional: we carefully deliberate or we "blink "and go with our gut. But as scientists break open the mind 's black box with the latest tools of neuro science, they 're discovering that this is not how the mind works. Our best decisions are a ﬁnely tuned blend of both feeling and reason, and the precise mix depends on the situation.
translations: Since Plato , philosophers have described the decision-making process as either rational or emotional:
从柏拉图开始 ，哲学家就将决策过程描述为既理性又感性：
we carefully deliberate or we " blink "and go with our gut.
我们三思后行或者任意而为。
But as scientists break open the mind 's black box with the latest tools of neuro science , they 're discovering that this is not how the mind works .
但是 ， 随着科学家们使用最新的神经科学工具打破思维的黑匣子时 ，他们发现这并不是思维的原理。
Our best decisions are a finely tuned blend of both feeling and reason , and the precise mix depends on the situation .
我们的最佳决策是将感性和理性完美地融合在一起-如何巧妙地组合则视情况而定。

text: Cheerful sunny yellow is an attention getter. While it is considered an optimistic colour, people lose their tempers more often in yellow rooms, and babies will cry more. It is the most diﬃcult colour for the eye to take in, so it can be overpowering if overused.
translations: Cheerful sunny yellow is an attention getter.明快的黄色是引人注目的焦点。
While it is considered an optimistic colour, people lose their tempers more often in yellow rooms , and babies will cry more .
尽管它被认为是一种乐观的颜色 ，但人们在黄色房间里发脾气的频率更高 ，而且婴儿哭泣的次数也会变多。
It is the most difficult colour for the eye to take in , so it can be overpowering if overused.它是眼睛最难以接受的颜色 ， 因此如果看多了黄颜色 ， 眼睛可能会受不了。

text: In the fast-changing world of modern healthcare, the job of a doctor is more and more like the job of a chief executive. The people who run hospitals and physicians'practises don 't just need to know medicine. They must also be able to balance budgets, motivate a large and diverse staﬀ and make diﬃcult marketing and legal decisions.
translations: In the fast-changing world of modern healthcare , the job of a doctor is more and more like the job of a chief executive .
在瞬息万变的现代医疗保健世界中 ， 医生的工作越来越像首席执行官了。
The people who run hospitals and physicians ' practises don 't just need to know medicine .
经营医院和执业医师的人不仅需要了解药物 ，还必须能够平衡预算 ，激励庞大而多样化的员工并做出艰难的营销和法律决策。
They must also be able to balance budgets , motivate a large and diverse staff and make difficult marketing and legal decisions .
经营医院和执业医师的人不仅需要了解药物 ，还必须能够平衡预算 ，激励庞大而多样化的员工并做出艰难的营销和法律决策。

text: The development of easy-to-use statistics is being taught and learned. Students can make transformations of variables, create graphs of distributions of variables, and select among statistical analyses all at the click of a button. However, even with these advancements, students sometimes ﬁnd statistics to be an arduous task.
translations: The development of easy-to-use statistics is being taught and learned.学生们正在学习易用的统计数据的开发。
Students can make transformations of variables , create graphs of distributions of variables , and select among statistical analyses all at the click of a button .
学生可以单击按钮进行变量转换 ，创建变量分布图以及在统计分析中进行选择。
However, even with these advancements , students sometimes find statistics to be an arduous task.但是 ， 即使有了这些进步 ，学生有时仍会发现统计数据是一项艰巨的任务。

text: First discovered in 2007, "fast radio burst "continue to defy explanation. These cosmic chirps last a thousandth of a second. The characteristics of the radio pulses suggested that they came from galaxies billions of light-years away. However, new works point to a much closer origin-ﬂaring star within our own galaxy.
translations: First discovered in 2007 , "fast radio burst "continue to defy explanation .于2007年首次发现的“快速电波爆发 ”还是令人难以解释。
These cosmic chirps last a thousandth of a second.这些宇宙里的吱吱声可持续千分之一秒。
The characteristics of the radio pulses suggested that they came from galaxies billions of light-years away.无线电脉冲的特征表明 ， 它们来自数十亿光年远的星系。
However, new works point to a much closer origin-flaring star within our own galaxy.但是 ，新研究指向了更近的来源——我们自己的星系中的恒星。

text: Ever since I remembered, father woke up at ﬁve thirty every morning, made breakfast for us all and read paper with my mother. After that he would go to work. He worked as a writer. It was a long time before I realised he did this for a living.
translations: Ever since I remembered , father woke up at five thirty every morning , made breakfast for us all and read paper with my mother.
从我记事起 ，父亲就每天早上五点半醒来 ，给我们所有人做早饭 ，和妈妈一起读书。
After that he would go to work.然后他去上班。
He worked as a writer.他是一名作家。
It was a long time before I realised he did this for a living.过了很久 ，我才意识到 ，他这样做是为了谋生。

text: Welfare has a special political meaning to the United States because it refers to how the poor receives ﬁnancial aid. In comparison, welfare services are regarded as a universal right in other regions like Europe, where it is believed that all citizens should be able to obtain a minimal level of social support and well-being.
translations: Welfare has a special political meaning to the United States because it refers to how the poor receives financial aid.
福利对美国具有特殊的政治意义 ， 因为它涉及穷人如何获得经济援助。

In comparison , welfare services are regarded as a universal right in other regions like Europe , where it is believed that all citizens should be able to obtain a minimal level of social support and well-being.
相比之下 ，在欧洲等其他地区 ，福利服务被视为一项普遍权利 ，所有公民都应能够获得最低程度的社会支持和福祉。

text: A smoking ban is a public policy that includes criminal laws and health regulations that prohibit smoking in certain public places and workspaces. There are varying deﬁnitions of smoking employed in this legislation. The strictest deﬁnitions deﬁne smoking as being the inhalation of any tobacco substance while the loosest deﬁne smoking as possessing any lit tobacco product.
translations: A smoking ban is a public policy that includes criminal laws and health regulations that prohibit smoking in certain public places and workspaces .
禁止吸烟是一项公共政策 ，其中包括禁止在公共场合及办公场所吸烟的刑法和卫生法规。
There are varying definitions of smoking employed in this legislation .这项立法中对吸烟有不同的定义。
The strictest definitions define smoking as being the inhalation of any tobacco substance while the loosest define smoking as possessing any lit tobacco product.
最严格的定义将吸烟定义为吸入任何烟草物质 ，而最宽松的定义将吸烟定义为持有任何点燃状态的烟草产品。

text: Another administration option is to bake marijuana at a relatively low temperature to kill any dangerous microorganisms and then allow that patient to eat it or drink it. Both of these methods of administration make smoking the drug unnecessary. However, criticism of medical marijuana has also been raised because as a natural plant, it cannot be patented and marketed by pharmaceutical companies and is unlikely to win widespread medical acceptance.
translations: Another administration option is to bake marijuana at a relatively low temperature to kill any dangerous microorganisms and then allow that patient to eat it or drink it.
另一个管理方法是在相对较低的温度下烘烤大⿇以杀死所有有害微生物 ，然后让患者食用或饮用 。
Both of these methods of administration make smoking the drug unnecessary.这两种给药方法都使吸食大⿇成为不必要的举动。

However, criticism of medical marijuana has also been raised because as a natural plant , it cannot be patented and marketed by pharmaceutical companies and is unlikely to win widespread medical acceptance .
但是 ，也有人对医用大⿇提出了批评 ， 因为它是天然植物 ，无法由制药公司获得专利并投入市场 ，并且不太可能获得医学上的广泛认可。

text: Certain types of methodology are more suitable for some research projects than others. For example, the use of questionnaires and surveys is more suitable for quantitative research whereas interviews and focus groups are more often used for qualitative research purposes.
translations: Certain types of methodology are more suitable for some research projects than others .某些类型的方法论比其他方法来说更适合一些研究项目 。
For example , the use of questionnaires and surveys is more suitable for quantitative research whereas interviews and focus groups are more often used for qualitative research purposes .
例如 ， 问卷和调查的使用更适合于定量研究 ，而访谈和焦点小组则更常用于定性研究。

text: In the photo, the wild cat 's huge paws are clamped onto the side of the white safari Jeep in which Chappell was a passenger. Almost as tall as the Jeep on her hind legs, she appears to be forcing her muzzle into the back window.
translations: In the photo , the wild cat 's huge paws are clamped onto the side of the white safari Jeep in which Chappell was a passenger.
在照片中 ，野猫的巨大爪子卡在了白色沙漠吉普车的侧面 ， 当时Chappell正在车上。
Almost as tall as the Jeep on her hind legs , she appears to be forcing her muzzle into the back window.野猫的后腿几乎和吉普车一样高 ，似乎正将嘴罩伸到后窗位置。

text: The insults and criticism were not unexpected. What was surprising was people 's enthusiasm about the competition. Thousands have participated in the discussion.
translations: The insults and criticism were not unexpected.侮辱和批评并不出人意料。
What was surprising was people 's enthusiasm about the competition .令人惊讶的是人们对比赛的热情。
Thousands have participated in the discussion .数千人参与了讨论。

text: The numbers on U.S. student debt, after all, are truly staggering. The average 2015 U.S. university graduate who took out loans to help pay for tuition enters the workforce with 35,000 in student debt. In the U.S., total student debt exceeds 1.15 trillion dollars-dwarﬁng, for instance, the nation 's credit card debt.
translations: The numbers on U.S. student debt , after all , are truly staggering.毕竟 ，美国学生债务的数字属实令人震惊。
The average 2015 U.S. university graduate who took out loans to help pay for tuition enters the workforce with 35 ,000 in student debt.
2015年 ，美国大学贷款上学的毕业生中 ，平均每人在工作后背负35 ,000美元的学生债务。
In the U.S. , total student debt exceeds 1.15 trillion dollars-dwarfing , for instance , the nation 's credit card debt.在美国 ，学生债务总额超过1 . 15万亿美元 ，使得该国的信用卡债务相形见绌。

text: This ﬁnding is understandable in certain cases in spite of its high signiﬁcance; that is because energy eﬃciency of building operation just represents a single aspect of sustainability. By the same token, an energy eﬃcient building with poor building material choices may not be considered sustainable.
translations: This finding is understandable in certain cases in spite of its high significance;尽管这一发现具有很重要的意义 ，但在某些情况下还是可以理解的。
that is because energy efficiency of building operation just represents a single aspect of sustainability.这是因为建筑运行的能源效率仅代表持久性的一个方面。
By the same token , an energy efficient building with poor building material choices may not be considered sustainable .
同样 ，选择劣质建筑材料的节能建筑可能不持久。

text: Three professors from Hamburg University 's medical faculty travelled last month to Ingeborg 's sitting room in East Berlin to test her on the work she carried out in prewar Germany.
translations: Three professors from Hamburg University 's medical faculty travelled last month to Ingeborg 's sitting room in East Berlin to test her on the work she carried out in prewar Germany.
汉堡大学医学院的三位教授上个月前往英格堡在东柏林的起居室 ，对她在战前德国所做的工作进行了测试。

text: Modern buildings have to achieve certain performance requirements, at least to satisfy those of building codes, to provide a safe, healthy, and comfortable environment. However, these conditioned environments demand resources in energy and materials, which are both limited in supply, to build and operate.
translations: Modern buildings have to achieve certain performance requirements , at least to satisfy those of building codes , to provide a safe , healthy, and comfortable environment.
现代建筑必须达到一定的性能要求 ，至少要满足建筑规范的要求 ，才能提供安全 ，健康和舒适的环境。
However, these conditioned environments demand resources in energy and materials , which are both limited in supply, to build and operate .
但是 ，这些特定环境需要能源和材料的资源来建造和运行 ，而能源和材料的供应都受到限制。

text: Moods may also have an eﬀect on how information is processed, by inﬂuencing the extent to which judges rely on pre-existing, internal information, or focus on new, external information. Positive moods promote more holistic and top-down processing style, while negative moods recruit more stimulus-driven and bottom-up processing.
translations: Moods may also have an effect on how information is processed , by influencing the extent to which judges rely on pre-existing , internal information , or focus on new, external information .
情绪还可能通过影响法官依赖预先存在的内部信息或关注新的外部信息的程度来影响信息的处理方怯。
Positive moods promote more holistic and top-down processing style , while negative moods recruit more stimulus-driven and bottom-up processing.
